Our main results show that both ambiguity and underspecification increase model performance in ways that scale with their influence on the language's type-token ratio. However, the accuracy of generating sequences containing ambiguous words or their synonyms decreases compared to other texts. We also show that internal representations of pseudowords reflect disambiguation of pseudo-homonyms, but underspecification of pseudo-hypernyms is maintained during the generative process.
title: Compact Language, Complex Model Shifts: How and Where Ambiguity and Underspecification Affect LLMs
comment: To appear in Proceedings of BlackBoxNLP 2026
title_translated: 简洁语言，复杂模型转变：歧义与不明确性如何影响大语言模型
summary_translated: 我们分析词汇歧义和不明确性对语言模型训练的影响。我们创建人工同音词和人工上位词作为伪词，并分析语言模型在不断增加这些模糊或不明确伪词类型训练量时的生成表现。我们进一步分析模型是否能对模糊或不明确的陈述进行消歧，并首次提供了歧义与消歧在内部如何表征的机制性解释。主要结果表明，歧义和不明确性均以与语言类型-词频比率影响程度成比例的方式提升模型性能。然而，生成包含模糊词语或其同义词的序列的准确性低于其他文本。我们还发现，伪词的内部表示反映了伪同音词的消歧，但伪上位词的不明确性在生成过程中得以维持。

summary: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. CATCH deliberately exposes environmental loopholes and provides execution-based gold labels by comparing success under a vulnerable evaluator with task correctness under an independent audit. It also can control the model's initial hacking tendency through supervised fine-tuning data mixtures and the difficulty of earning rewards through reward designing, enabling systematic comparisons of hacking dynamics and interventions. Experiments show that CATCH can produce diverse RL training trajectories with clear reward hacking, and analyses demonstrate that both initial models and reward difficulties shape the emergence of reward hacking. We further evaluate the effectiveness of different reward hacking detection and mitigation methods. A key finding is that a chain-of-thought monitor initially suppresses hacking, but this protection erodes as the policy model learn to mislead the monitor with code comments. This highlights the need to evaluate hacking mitigations throughout training with CATCH. The source code and resources are publicly released at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH.
title: CATCH: A Controllable Analysis Testbed for Reward Hacking in Coding RL
title_translated: CATCH：代码强化学习中奖励欺骗的可控分析测试平台
summary_translated: 在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，大型语言模型（LLMs）可能利用环境中的漏洞获取高奖励，而无需提升预期能力，即所谓的奖励欺骗。尽管这对训练效率和安全性构成风险，但在训练过程中监测和缓解奖励欺骗仍具挑战性，主要受限于缺乏能重现欺骗行为并可靠识别的测试平台。我们提出了CATCH，一个用于研究代码强化学习中奖励欺骗的可控测试平台。CATCH故意暴露环境漏洞，并通过对比脆弱评估器下的成功情况与独立审计下的任务正确性，提供基于执行的黄金标签。它还能通过监督微调数据混合控制模型的初始欺骗倾向，以及通过奖励设计控制获得奖励的难度，从而实现对欺骗动态和干预措施的系统性比较。实验表明，CATCH能够生成具有明显奖励欺骗的多样化强化学习训练轨迹；分析显示，初始模型和奖励难度均影响奖励欺骗的出现。我们进一步评估了不同奖励欺骗检测与缓解方法的有效性。关键发现是，思维链监控最初能抑制欺骗，但随着策略模型学会用代码注释误导监控器，这种保护作用逐渐减弱。这凸显了需使用CATCH在整个训练过程中评估欺骗缓解措施的有效性。源代码和资源已公开发布于https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH。

summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bridge multimodal understanding and robotic control, advancing the dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing models rely on large Transformers, whose latency and energy costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Through sparse event-driven computation, spiking neural networks offer a promising paradigm for high-performance and energy-efficient computing. Here, we propose the first Spike-driven VLA framework enabling end-to-end direct training for robotic manipulation, which mainly comprises three core components. First, we develop spiking visual and instruction encoders for multimodal perception, encoding visual observations and language instructions into sparse, reliable spike representations for subsequent cross-modal fusion. Then, we introduce Multi-Winner Spike Fusion for instruction-guided scene understanding, using bidirectional top-$k$ winner-take-all spike routing to suppress background interference and yield fused memory. Finally, we propose a Spike Action Chunking Transformer that incorporates spiking cross-attention over the fused memory and the current robot state, enabling efficient end-to-end generation of continuous action chunks for robotic control. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World demonstrate that Spike-driven VLA achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters and lower estimated inference energy than conventional VLA models. This work establishes a foundational framework for neuromorphic VLA modeling, paving the way for future advances in resource-efficient embodied intelligence.
title: Spike-driven Vision-Language-Action Model
title_translated: 脉冲驱动的视觉-语言-动作模型
summary_translated: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型连接多模态理解与机器人控制，推动了具身智能的主流范式。然而，大多数现有模型依赖大型Transformer架构，其延迟和能耗限制了在资源受限平台上的部署。通过稀疏事件驱动计算，脉冲神经网络为高性能、低功耗计算提供了有前景的范式。本文提出首个脉冲驱动的VLA框架，支持机器人操作的端到端直接训练，主要包括三个核心组件：首先，我们开发了脉冲视觉和指令编码器，将视觉观测和语言指令编码为稀疏可靠的脉冲表示，以供后续跨模态融合；其次，引入多胜者脉冲融合机制，采用双向top-k获胜者相争的脉冲路由策略，抑制背景干扰并生成融合记忆；最后，提出脉冲动作分块Transformer，结合融合记忆与当前机器人状态的脉冲交叉注意力，实现高效端到端的连续动作分块生成，用于机器人控制。在LIBERO和Meta-World上的大量实验表明，脉冲驱动的VLA在参数更少、估计推理能耗更低的情况下，实现了与传统VLA模型相当的性能。本工作建立了类脑VLA建模的基础框架，为未来资源高效的具身智能发展铺平道路。

summary: Rechtsrock is a subgenre of rock music that spreads right-wing ideology, often instrumentalized to recruit adolescents into the radical scene. Monitoring institutions counteract this by manually examining and, in some cases, banning extremist content; however, there are border cases that evade regulation. We present a study aimed at determining whether such a case, the band Frei.Wild, should be classified as politically right-leaning or as part of the general German rock genre. We sampled a German rock dataset and created a corpus for right-wing rock to use as reference in this analysis and found that we can confirm the intuitions from previous investigations that Frei.Wild successfully maintains an ambiguity with regard to their political affiliation. However, the tendency is towards the right-wing spectrum. Lexical analyses reveal nationalistic narratives and two high-performing classifiers (up to 97% ROC-AUC score) label more than half of their songs as right-wing extremist. Our analysis provides insight into how computational methods can improve the process of identifying right-wing extremist tendencies in music, especially in borderline cases like Frei.Wild. The code and data are made available for future research.
title: Right-Wing Rock or Just Rock? A Computational Linguistic Analysis of Frei.Wild
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, for code and data see this https URL , to be published in the proceedings of the NLP 4 Positive Impact workshop at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 右翼摇滚还是普通摇滚？对Frei.Wild的计算语言学分析
summary_translated: 右翼摇滚是一种传播右翼意识形态的摇滚音乐子流派，常被用于招募青少年进入极端主义圈子。监管机构通过人工审查甚至在某些情况下禁止极端内容来应对这一问题；然而，存在一些边界案例难以纳入监管。我们开展一项研究，旨在判断乐队Frei.Wild是否应被归类为政治右倾或属于德国普通摇滚流派。我们采集了一个德语摇滚数据集，并构建了右翼摇滚语料库作为分析参考，结果证实了先前研究的直觉：Frei.Wild在政治归属上成功保持了模糊性，但倾向右翼谱系。词汇分析揭示了民族主义叙事，两个高性能分类器（最高达97% ROC-AUC得分）将超过一半的歌曲标记为右翼极端主义。我们的分析展示了计算方法如何改进识别音乐中右翼极端主义倾向的过程，特别是在像Frei.Wild这样的边界案例中。代码和数据已公开，供未来研究使用。

summary: Interpreting properties of LLM-generated data is important for understanding its utility and limitations across learning tasks. In this work, we characterize synthetic data through sample-level learnability, studying variation among LLM families and scales, alongside human-written data as a reference. We first generate synthetic datasets spanning single- and multi-label classification, labeling, and tree prediction tasks. We then derive empirical data distributions from encoder training dynamics for both machine and organic data, and estimate the robustness of these distributions across encoders. Finally, we evaluate how data selection strategies based on these learnability signals affect both data sources differently.
title: Synthetic Data Characterization via Training Dynamics
title_translated: 通过训练动态表征合成数据
summary_translated: 理解大语言模型生成数据的特性对于把握其在各类学习任务中的适用性和局限性至关重要。在本研究中，我们通过样本级可学习性来表征合成数据，考察不同大模型家族和规模之间的差异，并以人类撰写的数据作为参照。我们首先生成涵盖单标签、多标签分类、标注和树预测任务的合成数据集。随后，从编码器训练动态中推导出机器数据与有机数据的经验分布，并估计这些分布对不同编码器的鲁棒性。最后，我们评估基于这些可学习性信号的数据选择策略对两种数据源的不同影响。

summary: Existing full-duplex speech benchmarks cover only subsets of real-time interaction behaviors, often under limited contextual conditions. We introduce DuplexAct-Bench, a bilingual benchmark that systematically covers six complementary behaviors, from interruption and yielding to proactive initiation, active silence, and backchanneling, across Pre-session, In-session, and No-explicit conditions. Across 1,290 English and Chinese streaming trials, we evaluate 12 full-duplex speech systems on both Timing and Content. Results reveal substantial variation across behaviors, conditions, and systems, as well as frequent mismatches between semantic quality and behavioral timing. These findings show that current systems remain far from robustly managing when, whether, and how to participate as real-time interaction unfolds. Project page: https://alitaxky.icu/DuplexAct-Bench/
title: DuplexAct-Bench: Broadening Full-Duplex Speech Evaluation toward Proactive Interaction across Diverse Behavioral Requirements
title_translated: DuplexAct-Bench：面向多样化行为需求的全双工语音评估扩展至主动交互
summary_translated: 现有的全双工语音基准仅覆盖实时交互行为的子集，且通常在有限的情境条件下进行。我们提出DuplexAct-Bench，一个双语基准，系统性地涵盖六种互补行为——从打断与让步到主动发起、主动沉默和反馈回应——贯穿会前、会中和无明确提示三种情境。在1,290次英汉流媒体试验中，我们评估了12个全双工语音系统在时间与内容两个维度的表现。结果显示，不同行为、情境和系统之间存在显著差异，且语义质量与行为时间经常不匹配。这些发现表明，当前系统在实时交互展开时，远未具备稳健地判断何时、是否以及如何参与的能力。项目页面：https://alitaxky.icu/DuplexAct-Bench/

summary: Large language models are strong general-purpose code generators, but executable algorithmic trading remains a demanding specialization target: a model must translate a natural-language strategy specification into correct program logic for a specialized trading framework, execute on historical data, produce trades, and remain semantically faithful to the request. We study two complementary mechanisms for specializing language models for this setting: continued pretraining on algorithmic-trading framework code and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on agent-validated request-to-code pairs. Evaluation is centered on QuantCode-Bench, our 400-task benchmark for Backtrader strategy generation, together with a repository-level SWE-bench-like track. Continued pretraining improves single-turn Judge Pass from 41.5% to 47.5% for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and from 27.8% to 33.0% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. SFT applied after continued pretraining yields a larger gain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reaching 58.2% Judge Pass and 83.5% successful backtests; in agentic evaluation it raises first-turn success from 22.3% to 58.3% and final success after up to 10 turns from 47.5% to 79.5%. Continued pretraining alone improves first-turn agentic success but lowers final success after repair from 47.5% to 32.5%, consistent with degraded instruction following, whereas SFT improves both. We also identify a capability-retention failure: domain specialization degrades parser-conformant structured tool calling, and targeted recovery SFT restores tool-call formatting but not the base checkpoint's repository-level agent performance. The results show that framework-oriented pretraining, validated SFT, and explicit capability-retention evaluation address distinct failure modes in domain-specific executable code generation.
title: QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code
title_translated: QuantCode模型：针对可执行算法交易代码的语言模型专业化
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在通用代码生成方面表现强劲，但可执行的算法交易仍是一个极具挑战性的专业化目标：模型必须将自然语言策略说明转化为特定交易框架下的正确程序逻辑，基于历史数据执行并生成交易，同时保持与请求的语义一致性。我们研究了两种互补机制以实现该场景下的语言模型专业化：在算法交易框架代码上进行持续预训练，以及在代理验证过的请求到代码对上进行监督微调（SFT）。评估围绕我们提出的400任务基准QuantCode-Bench展开，用于Backtrader策略生成，并包含一个仓库级别的类似SWE-bench的评测路径。持续预训练使Qwen3.5-397B-A17B的单轮Judge Pass率从41.5%提升至47.5%，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B则从27.8%提升至33.0%。在持续预训练后应用SFT，对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B带来更大提升，达到58.2%的Judge Pass率和83.5%的成功回测率；在代理评估中，首轮成功率从22.3%提升至58.3%，经过最多10轮修复后的最终成功率从47.5%提升至79.5%。仅持续预训练虽能提升首轮代理成功率，但会降低修复后的最终成功率（从47.5%降至32.5%），这与指令遵循能力下降一致；而SFT则同时改善两者。我们还发现一种能力保留失败现象：领域专业化会损害解析器合规的结构化工具调用能力，针对性恢复SFT虽可恢复工具调用格式，但无法恢复基线检查点在仓库级别代理上的性能。结果表明，面向框架的预训练、经验证的SFT以及显式的能力建设评估，能够分别解决特定领域可执行代码生成中的不同失效模式。

summary: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial texts.We jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial dataset. The code for $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/daleel_2026_Arabic-Argumentative-Discourse-Mining}{\faGithub~TTLab at Daleel 2026}}$
title: TTLab at Daleel 2026: STAR-Ar, Sequence Tagging for Argument Recognition in Arabic
comment: Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026 Daleel-2026 shared task
title_translated: TTLab在Daleel 2026中的表现：阿拉伯语论点识别的序列标注方法
summary_translated: 论点挖掘（AM）是自然语言处理中的关键任务，但在阿拉伯语中仍严重资源匮乏。本文介绍了$	esttt{STAR-Ar}$，一种用于阿拉伯语论点话语检测与分类的BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，作为我们在Daleel 2026——首次阿拉伯语论点挖掘共享任务中的系统。该任务要求在辩论和社论文本中识别并分类论点性话语单元（ADUs）。我们采用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，将这两个目标联合建模为一个词级序列标注任务，结合上下文Transformer嵌入与结构化转移约束，以支持精确的跨度检测。$	esttt{STAR-Ar}$在验证集上取得72.69的F1分数，在测试集上达到73.7。我们的领域分析显示，仅在社论数据上训练的模型表现不如在辩论数据上训练的模型，这一差异主要归因于社论数据集规模较小。$	esttt{STAR-Ar}$的代码已公开于${	ext{https://github.com/ENTAILab/daleel_2026_Arabic-Argumentative-Discourse-Mining}}$。

summary: Specialized models encode task-oriented behavior, but transferring that behavior to a general language model usually requires training, distillation, or representation alignment. We study whether such ability can instead be transferred directly at the parameter level. We apply two existing training-free heterogeneous merging methods, previously shown to transfer knowledge between general language models, to specialist-to-general transfer, projecting a specialist donor into the recipient's shape and interpolating backbone parameters without gradient updates or semantic alignment. Intersection-Merge (IM) injects a prefix-aligned donor slice matching the recipient shape, while Activate-Prune-Merge (APM) uses forward-pass activation statistics to select which donor dimensions to retain before injection. Across embedding, reranking, reward modeling, and MoE code-specialist transfer, both methods improve the general recipient, showing that simple heterogeneous merging can move capabilities across diverse specialist roles.
title: Exploring Heterogeneous Model Merging Approach for Complex Knowledge Transfer
title_translated: 探索异构模型融合方法以实现复杂知识迁移
summary_translated: 专用模型编码了任务导向的行为，但将这种行为迁移到通用语言模型通常需要训练、蒸馏或表示对齐。我们探讨是否可以绕过这些步骤，直接在参数层面实现能力迁移。我们应用两种现有的无需训练的异构融合方法，这些方法此前已被证明可在通用语言模型间迁移知识，将其应用于从专用模型到通用模型的迁移，通过将专用捐赠者投影到接收者的结构中，并在不进行梯度更新或语义对齐的情况下插值主干参数。交集融合（IM）注入与接收者结构对齐的捐赠者前缀片段，而激活-剪枝-融合（APM）则利用前向传播的激活统计量选择保留哪些捐赠者维度后再注入。在嵌入、重排序、奖励建模及MoE代码专用模型迁移等多个任务中，两种方法均提升了通用接收者的表现，表明简单的异构融合即可在多样化的专用角色间传递能力。

summary: A common formalism for constraining the output of autoregressive text generation models involves lexical constraints, words or phrases which are required to occur in the generated text. DFA-constrained beam search and grid beam search are two widely used paradigms for decoding from autoregressive models while enforcing lexical constraints. As the former approach requires a number of forward passes exponential in the number of constraint tokens, it is often dispreferred to the latter, which requires only linearly many forward calls. However, while grid beam search achieves an exponential speedup, it does so in a manner which does not treat all of the constraints equally. In this paper, we demonstrate that grid beam search is biased to incorporate easier-to-satisfy constraints first, leaving harder constraints to the end of the sequence. This contrasts with DFA-constrained beam search, which exhibits no such bias. To address this shortcoming, we propose fair grid beam search, a modification to grid beam search which avoids this bias while still requiring only linearly many forward passes. Experimentally, we confirm grid beam search's bias on two constrained generation tasks, finding significant differences in how it orders constraint tokens as compared to DFA-constrained beam search and fair grid beam search. Furthermore, we find that fair grid beam search not only fixes grid beam search's bias, but finds higher-probability strings in the process.
title: Making Grid Beam Search Less Greedy
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
title_translated: 让网格束搜索不再那么贪婪
summary_translated: 一种常见的约束自回归文本生成模型输出的形式化方法是引入词汇约束，即要求生成文本中必须包含某些词语或短语。DFA约束束搜索和网格束搜索是两种广泛使用的自回归模型解码范式，用于强制执行词汇约束。由于前者在约束词数量上需要指数级的前向传播次数，因此通常被后者取代，后者仅需线性数量的前向调用。然而，尽管网格束搜索实现了指数级加速，其方式并未平等地对待所有约束。本文证明，网格束搜索倾向于优先满足较易满足的约束，而将更难的约束留到最后。这与DFA约束束搜索无此偏差形成对比。为解决这一缺陷，我们提出公平网格束搜索，一种修改版的网格束搜索，可在仅需线性前向调用的前提下避免该偏差。实验验证了网格束搜索在两个约束生成任务上的偏差，发现其对约束词的排序与DFA约束束搜索及公平网格束搜索存在显著差异。此外，我们发现公平网格束搜索不仅消除了偏差，还能在过程中找到更高概率的字符串。

summary: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain frozen. Composability regularization transfers the semantic geometry of textual requirements into prompt space, enabling inference-time blending and reweighting. Across two practical continual alignment settings, Ready2Blend is the only frozen-backbone method that matches post-training-based alignment methods, reaching $93.1$-$98.5\%$ of a joint-training reference with competitive retention, while requiring only a few prompt tokens and up to $4.3\times$ less training time. Its modular design further enables weighted personalization and order-free composition without retraining. Code will be released upon acceptance.
title: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts
title_translated: Ready2Blend：从自然语言指令到可组合的对齐提示
summary_translated: 持续对齐要求大语言模型在不遗忘已有行为的前提下适应新需求。自然语言指令具有灵活性和可组合性，但仅提供间接控制；而后训练方法虽能提供更强的适应性，却需重复参数更新。我们提出Ready2Blend，结合自然语言的灵活性与学习到的对齐机制。AlignFormer将每个需求映射为存储在模块化提示库中的固定长度对齐提示，而主干网络和先验提示保持冻结。可组合性正则化将文本需求的语义几何结构转移到提示空间，实现在推理时的混合与权重调整。在两个实际的持续对齐场景中，Ready2Blend是唯一能达到后训练对齐方法性能的冻结主干方法，其表现达到联合训练参考模型的93.1%-98.5%，且具备良好记忆保留能力，仅需少量提示令牌，训练时间最多减少4.3倍。其模块化设计还支持加权个性化和无序组合，无需重新训练。代码将在接受后发布。

summary: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify (arXiv:2507.07505). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. Blaise keeps the documents themselves and passes the model only the section a question needs. On a recall test with 100 facts hidden in a 97,000-token corpus (Gemma 4 31B), Taliesin alone let the model attend to the whole corpus and answered 98 of 100 on llama.cpp at 3.0 s and 572 J per question, against 10 of 100, 9.3 s and 2,754 J for the same model without Galahad, which could hold only the last 12,000 tokens. With Blaise added, the model read about 668 tokens per question and answered 100 of 100 on all three runtimes at 0.59-0.64 s and 200-213 J; a tuned RAGFlow pipeline answered 77. Storing the corpus is a one-time cost of about 100 s and 28 kJ, whose energy is recovered after 13 questions. Restored state is bit-identical: all 262,144 output logits matched after restart, rehydration and hot-load. Galahad worked with all 30 models we tested under vLLM, and it fails closed: any load that does not pass its checks is recomputed. Together these results move LLM serving from stateless to stateful inference.
title: Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost
title_translated: 突破计算上限：Galahad中的字节精确记忆使LLM阅读成为一次性开销
summary_translated: Transformer语言模型每token执行的计算量是有限的，近期Vishal Sikka（前Infosys CEO）的研究指出这一限制决定了模型能够执行或验证的任务范围（arXiv:2507.07505）。我们探讨了在该上限之下，有多少计算预算被用于模型已处理过的工作。当前服务是无状态的：当模型回答关于同一文档的第二个问题时，会从第一个token重新计算文档的注意力状态。在七个真实世界数据集上，98.7%的提示token都是模型已经读过的文本。我们提出Galahad，一个适用于vLLM、SGLang和llama.cpp的记忆层，使这一阅读过程变为一次性开销。Taliesin保存文本块的键值（KV）状态，并在后续请求中若遇到相同字节则直接加载，而非重新计算。Blaise则保存文档本身，仅向模型传递问题所需的部分。在包含100个事实的97,000 token语料库的召回测试中（Gemma 4 31B），仅使用Taliesin时，模型可访问整个语料库，在llama.cpp上以3.0秒和572焦耳/问题答对98题；而未使用Galahad的相同模型只能保留最后12,000 tokens，仅答对10题，耗时9.3秒，消耗2,754焦耳。加入Blaise后，模型每问题仅需读取约668 token，三套运行环境均答对100题，耗时0.59–0.64秒，能耗200–213焦耳；调优后的RAGFlow管道仅答对77题。存储语料库的一次性开销约为100秒和28千焦，其能量在13个问题后即可回收。恢复的状态为比特级完全一致：重启、重载和热加载后，全部262,144个输出logits均匹配。Galahad在我们测试的所有30个模型中均与vLLM兼容，且具备失败关闭机制：任何不通过检查的加载都会被重新计算。这些结果共同推动LLM服务从无状态推理迈向有状态推理。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities but are often costly to access through commercial APIs, while small language models (SLMs) are easier to deploy locally yet remain weaker in reasoning. This capability-deployment gap has motivated LLM-SLM collaboration, which aims to improve SLM reasoning using LLM capabilities while preserving the deployment advantages of SLMs. Existing approaches mainly follow two paradigms. Knowledge distillation uses LLM-generated answers and reasoning trajectories to train SLMs offline, but requires parameter updates and additional training. Alternatively, online collaboration routes difficult problems to an LLM or leverages LLM-generated guidance and corrections when an SLM encounters difficulties. Although effective, online collaboration requires repeated LLM access. Moreover, the guidance produced for a particular problem is discarded after inference and cannot benefit subsequent problems involving similar reasoning states. In the paper, we focus on a more constrained setting in which the LLM is accessed only offline, the SLM parameters remain fixed, and online inference is performed solely by the SLM. To this end, we propose Reusable Latent Correction (RLC), which converts one-off natural-language guidance from a black-box LLM into persistent corrective experiences in the hidden space of an SLM. RLC stores these experiences in an external bank and retrieves them according to the SLM's current reasoning state, enabling the SLM to reuse LLM-derived corrections during inference without any online LLM calls. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and SLM scales show that RLC consistently improves SLM reasoning without parameter updates or online LLM calls. Code is available at https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction.
title: Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models
title_translated: 离线指导，在线推理：复用LLM反馈以增强小语言模型
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）具备强大的推理能力，但通过商业API访问成本高昂；小型语言模型（SLMs）易于本地部署，但在推理能力上仍较弱。这种能力与部署之间的差距催生了LLM-SLM协作范式，旨在利用LLM的能力提升SLM推理性能，同时保留SLM的部署优势。现有方法主要遵循两种范式：知识蒸馏通过LLM生成的答案和推理轨迹离线训练SLM，但需要参数更新和额外训练；另一种是在线协作，将难题路由至LLM或在SLM遇到困难时利用LLM提供的指导与修正。尽管有效，但在线协作需重复调用LLM，且针对特定问题生成的指导在推理后即被丢弃，无法惠及后续具有相似推理状态的问题。本文聚焦于更受限的场景：仅离线访问LLM，SLM参数保持固定，所有在线推理均由SLM独立完成。为此，我们提出可复用潜在修正（RLC），将来自黑箱LLM的一次性自然语言指导转化为SLM隐藏空间中的持久修正经验。RLC将这些经验存储在外部记忆库中，并根据SLM当前的推理状态进行检索，使SLM在推理过程中无需任何在线LLM调用即可复用LLM生成的修正。在多个推理基准和不同规模的SLM上的实验表明，RLC在不进行参数更新或在线调用的情况下持续提升了SLM的推理能力。代码已公开于https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction。

summary: A concept subspace's effect on model behavior does not establish how it relates to the output readout. We introduce a two-sided geometric diagnostic that measures an extracted subspace's overlap with the dominant right-singular directions of the unembedding matrix, evaluated against output-oriented positive controls. Given an extracted basis, the raw diagnostic requires only model weights. Our testbed is the Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspace (FARS), a ten-dimensional basis extracted from eighteen reasoning concepts expressed in six surface forms. Across nine rank-matched estimators and twenty-six models, four activation-derived concept estimators carry only 0.38--0.80% mean energy in the top-ten readout span. Final-layer PCA carries 3.56%, exceeding FARS in 25 of 26 models. A same-layer next-token control, evaluated using a fitted linear translator for depth matching, carries approximately thirteen times more energy than FARS, with separation in all 25 tested models. Re-extracting FARS on ten disjoint concepts yields 62--100% cross-format retrieval across twenty-four generative models, demonstrating transfer of the extraction procedure rather than a fixed basis. A complementary four-model, three-seed intervention study finds model-dependent source-directed effects that remain well below full-vector replacement. Together, the geometry and intervention controls distinguish concept structure from dominant readout directions while limiting claims of causal sufficiency.
title: Concept Subspaces Compute Beyond the Logit Lens: A Weights-Only Test for Locating Representations Upstream of Readout
comment: 54 pages. Substantially revised preprint: new title, expanded model coverage, readout-geometry controls, supplementary intervention and transfer experiments, revised interpretation, updated figures and author list
title_translated: 概念子空间超越logit视角：一种仅依赖权重的上游表示定位测试
summary_translated: 一个概念子空间对模型行为的影响并不能说明其与输出读出的关系。我们引入一种双向几何诊断方法，测量提取的子空间与解码矩阵主导右奇异方向的重叠度，基于面向输出的正向控制进行评估。给定一个提取的基底，原始诊断仅需模型权重即可完成。我们的测试平台是格式无关推理子空间（FARS），一个从十八个推理概念在六种表面形式下提取的十维基底。在九个秩匹配估计器和二十六个模型中，四种由激活导出的概念估计器在顶层读出跨度中的平均能量仅为0.38%–0.80%。最终层PCA的能量为3.56%，在25/26个模型中超过FARS。同层下一个token控制（使用拟合线性译码器进行深度匹配）的能量约为FARS的十三倍，且在所有25个测试模型中均显著分离。在十个不相交概念上重新提取FARS，跨格式检索率在二十四款生成模型中达到62%–100%，证明了提取过程的可迁移性，而非固定基底。一项互补的四模型三种子干预研究发现，模型依赖性的源导向效应存在，但远低于全向量替换水平。几何与干预控制共同区分了概念结构与主导读出方向，同时避免了对因果充分性的过度宣称。

summary: An agent that moves must recognise a place from a viewpoint it has never seen. We introduce 4MT-VLM, a dataset of procedurally generated landscapes, each rendered across five stimulus modes that remove appearance cues while holding layout fixed: shape and colour, shape only, colour only, bare terrain peaks with no objects, and a valley viewpoint that puts the peaks on the horizon. The last condition is commonly used in clinics to probe hippocampal function in human patients. We test this benchmark across sixteen different open and closed-source models and report 4AFC performance, a measure which is also used to grade human participants. We observe that models identify a place from the studied viewpoint but lose it once the camera moves, dropping below the 25% chance level at 135° where a human observer scores 85%. Frontier models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6) answer only 39% and 31% of rotated trials correctly, recovering to 85% and 55% only when distractors are moved more than 30 meters apart. Our benchmark demonstrates that while current VLMs possess rudimentary cognitive maps, their spatial resolution remains fundamentally too coarse to maintain a stable, 3D understanding of the world once the viewpoint changes.
title: 4MT-VLM: How Coarse Is a VLMs Cognitive Map?
title_translated: 4MT-VLM：视觉语言模型的认知地图有多粗糙？
summary_translated: 一个移动的智能体必须能从从未见过的视角识别一个位置。我们引入4MT-VLM，一个程序生成景观的数据集，每个景观在五种刺激模式下渲染，以去除外观线索但保持布局不变：形状与颜色、仅形状、仅颜色、无物体的裸露地形峰顶，以及将峰顶置于地平线处的山谷视角——后者常用于临床中探测人类患者的海马功能。我们在十六个开源与闭源模型上测试该基准，报告4AFC性能，该指标也用于评估人类参与者的表现。我们观察到，模型能从研究视角识别位置，但一旦摄像头移动便迅速丢失，当视角旋转至135°时性能降至25%随机水平，而人类观察者得分仍高达85%。前沿模型（Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6）在旋转试验中仅正确回答39%和31%，只有当干扰物间距超过30米时才分别恢复至85%和55%。本基准表明，尽管当前VLM具备初步认知地图，但其空间分辨率仍过于粗糙，无法在视角变化后维持稳定的三维世界理解。

summary: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. Against Claude Sonnet, the panel retains a median 93% of its Cohen's $κ$ and gives up only 2.9 points of balanced accuracy on average; read as paired differences, it clearly improves on one benchmark and clearly worsens on three (only two by a non-negligible margin), leaving four unresolved. At a sixty-fourth of the frontier's inference price, the operative expense is a one-time in-domain calibration on 50--100 labelled records. The panel is also competitive with purpose-trained detectors on their home benchmarks (within 1.3 accuracy points of GPT-4o and 1.9 of the LLM-AggreFact leader), and beats the strongest one we reran by 6 points on our grounded sets. Whether aggregation pays depends on the members themselves: where several capable members err on different items, the panel improves on its best judge and approaches the frontier; where one dominates, the stacker recovers the leader, and only there does the frontier remain materially ahead. Both conditions are read off the calibration set at no further cost, so a cheap panel can stand in for a frontier one wherever this audit admits it.
title: RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection

title_translated: RAIM：鲁棒聚合廉价模型用于幻觉检测
summary_translated: 自动评估忠实性日益依赖大型语言模型作为裁判，然而最可靠的裁判是专有的前沿模型，成本高且不适合高吞吐量监控。我们探究是否可以由一组廉价的开源权重裁判（4–9B）聚合而成的团队替代前沿模型，这种替代的代价是什么，以及何时值得这样做。我们提出RAIM，一种对成员相关错误具有鲁棒性的聚合方案，结合交叉拟合的堆叠逻辑回归与可接受性检验，该检验基于成员自身输出判断聚合是否优于其最佳成员，并保持在前沿裁判的可及范围内。我们在八个忠实性基准上使用来自八个不同家族的十个裁判实例化RAIM。与Claude Sonnet相比，该团队在中位数上保留了93%的Cohen's $κ$，平均仅损失2.9点平衡准确率；以配对差异衡量，它在一个基准上明显改善，在三个基准上明显恶化（仅两个非可忽略），其余四个未决。其操作成本仅为前沿模型推理价格的六十四分之一，且只需一次域内校准（50–100条标注记录）。该团队在专用检测器的主场基准上也具有竞争力（与GPT-4o相差1.3点准确率，与LLM-AggreFact领先者相差1.9点），并在我们的接地数据集上比最强的重跑模型高出6点。聚合是否划算取决于成员本身：当多个有能力的成员在不同项目上出错时，团队表现优于其最佳成员并接近前沿模型；当某一成员主导时，堆叠器可恢复该领导者，此时前沿模型仍具实质性优势。这两种情况均可通过校准集读取，无需额外成本，因此只要审计允许，廉价团队即可在任何地方替代前沿模型。

summary: Argument structure prediction (ASP) constructs complete argument structures from discourse by identifying argumentative units and their relations. While recent work has explored diverse approaches---including unified neural models, multi-step pipelines, and prompt-based large language models (LLMs)---their relative trade-offs remain under-explored, particularly in dialogical settings.   We present a systematic evaluation of ASP under strict schema constraints, comparing supervised fine-tuning and prompt-based LLMs across single- and multi-step task architectures, generating complete argument structures from dialogical input end-to-end. We benchmark them on three diverse dialogical corpora adapted from Inference Anchoring Theory into bipolar argument structures. Under a shared evaluation framework, we assess predictive performance, cross-domain generalization, schema compliance, and computational efficiency. Our results show that ASP remains a challenging task, with identifying argumentative relations emerging as the primary bottleneck, largely due to the implicit and context-dependent nature of dialogical argumentation. To facilitate future research, we release our data processing pipeline and end-to-end modeling framework for computational ASP on dialogical corpora.
title: Argument Structure Prediction in Online Conversations: A Comparative Study of Modeling Paradigms and Task Architectures

title_translated: 在线对话中论点结构预测：建模范式与任务架构的比较研究
summary_translated: 论点结构预测（ASP）通过识别论辩单元及其关系，从话语中构建完整的论点结构。尽管近期研究探索了多种方法——包括统一神经模型、多步流水线和基于提示的大语言模型（LLMs）——但这些方法之间的权衡仍缺乏充分探讨，尤其是在对话场景中。本文在严格的模式约束下对ASP进行了系统性评估，比较了监督微调与基于提示的LLMs在单步与多步任务架构中的表现，实现了从对话输入端到端生成完整论点结构。我们在三个源自推理锚定理论并转化为二元论点结构的多样化对话语料库上进行基准测试。在统一评估框架下，我们评估了预测性能、跨领域泛化能力、模式合规性以及计算效率。结果表明，ASP仍是一项具有挑战性的任务，识别论辩关系成为主要瓶颈，这主要归因于对话式论辩的隐含性和上下文依赖性。为促进未来研究，我们发布了用于对话语料库计算ASP的数据处理流程和端到端建模框架。

summary: Trustworthy Legal AI requires systems that can answer legal questions while grounding their responses in authoritative sources. However, existing Vietnamese legal benchmarks provide limited coverage of real-world legal consultations. We introduce \textbf{ViLegalExpert}, a large-scale benchmark constructed from authentic citizen--lawyer consultations, containing over \textbf{172K} questions across \textbf{34 legal domains}, together with professional answers and expert-verified legal evidence. ViLegalExpert supports legal information retrieval, extractive QA, and abstractive QA. Experiments with representative retrieval methods and language models reveal substantial challenges in evidence retrieval and grounded answer generation. While pretrained models perform strongly on QA, hybrid retrieval achieves the best retrieval performance. These results demonstrate the difficulty of mapping naturally expressed legal questions to authoritative provisions and establish ViLegalExpert as a challenging benchmark for reliable Vietnamese Legal AI.
title: ViLegalExpert: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Vietnamese Legal Retrieval and Question Answering from Real-World Consultations
title_translated: ViLegalExpert：面向真实法律咨询的越南语法律检索与问答大规模基准
summary_translated: 可信的法律AI系统需要能够在权威来源的基础上回答法律问题。然而，现有的越南语法律基准在真实法律咨询方面的覆盖范围有限。我们引入了	extbf{ViLegalExpert}，一个基于真实公民-律师咨询构建的大规模基准，包含超过	extbf{172K}个问题，涵盖	extbf{34}个法律领域，并配有专业答案和专家验证的法律证据。ViLegalExpert支持法律信息检索、抽取式问答和抽象式问答。对代表性检索方法和语言模型的实验揭示了在证据检索和基于依据的答案生成方面存在显著挑战。尽管预训练模型在问答任务上表现强劲，但混合检索方法在检索性能上表现最佳。这些结果表明，将自然表达的法律问题映射到权威条文存在困难，并确立了ViLegalExpert作为可靠越南语法律AI的挑战性基准。

summary: Deep research tasks require agents to navigate large knowledge spaces, synthesize evidence across many sources, and adapt their plans as findings emerge. Directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based multi-agent systems suit this setting because they support parallel execution and isolate each sub-task within a focused dependency context. Yet existing DAG-based agents instantiate a task-level plan before execution and repair the graph only after failures or missing evidence are observed. This Plan-then-Patch strategy is brittle for deep research: the system commits most strongly when its evidence is weakest, and later revisions waste computation on branches that should not have been planned. We propose DAGent, a DAG-based multi-agent framework with Evaluate-then-Grow incremental planning: an Orchestrator grows the task graph one batch at a time, conditioning each expansion on confidence and uncertainty signals from completed nodes. A hierarchical context layer propagates compact QueryDocs by default while preserving full execution traces for on-demand recall. The recorded DAG topology admits structural RL signals that outcome-only recipes cannot define; DAGRPO, a GRPO adaptation, injects topology-conditioned credit on Executor rollouts and a structural compliance regularization on Orchestrator plans. Across BrowseComp-Plus, GAIA, and xbench-DeepSearch, DAGent surpasses the strongest open-source baseline by 5.3 / 5.8 / 2.0 points at the Qwen3-235B-A22B scale, and the lead replicates across four open-source backbones and extends to GPT-5 at 327K context. At the Qwen3-8B scale, DAGRPO improves over a same-budget outcome-only GRPO baseline by 3.0 average Pass@1 points. A same-architecture comparison shows that evidence-conditioned planning reaches higher accuracy at lower per-task token, tool-call, and step footprints than its Plan-then-Patch counterpart. Code: https://github.com/hanwenliu6825/DAGent
title: DAGent: Evaluate-then-Grow Planning for Deep Research Agents
title_translated: DAGent：用于深度研究智能体的评估-增长型规划
summary_translated: 深度研究任务要求智能体在庞大的知识空间中导航，综合多个来源的证据，并根据发现动态调整计划。基于有向无环图（DAG）的多智能体系统适合此场景，因其支持并行执行，并将每个子任务隔离在聚焦的依赖上下文中。然而，现有DAG-based智能体在执行前即实例化任务级计划，仅在失败或缺失证据时才修复图结构。这种先计划后修补的策略在深度研究中显得脆弱：系统在证据最薄弱时投入最大，后续修订则浪费计算资源在本不应规划的分支上。我们提出DAGent，一种具有评估-增长型增量规划的DAG-based多智能体框架：协调器逐批扩展任务图，每次扩展均基于已完成节点的置信度和不确定性信号。分层上下文层默认传播紧凑的QueryDocs，同时保留完整的执行轨迹以供按需回溯。记录的DAG拓扑结构可提供结果仅有的配方无法定义的结构化强化学习信号；DAGRPO（GRPO的改进版本）在执行者回放中注入拓扑条件化的信用分配，并在协调者计划中加入结构合规性正则化。在BrowseComp-Plus、GAIA和xbench-DeepSearch上，DAGent在Qwen3-235B-A22B规模下超越最强开源基线5.3 / 5.8 / 2.0分，该领先优势在四个开源骨干网络上复制，并延伸至GPT-5（327K上下文）。在Qwen3-8B规模下，DAGRPO相比同预算的结果仅GRPO基线平均提升3.0 Pass@1分。相同架构对比显示，基于证据的规划在更低的任务token、工具调用和步骤开销下达到更高准确率，优于其先计划后修补的对应方法。代码：https://github.com/hanwenliu6825/DAGent

summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has attracted growing interest as a promising approach to improve the reasoning ability of language models. Without external rewards nor a separate stronger teacher, the self-teacher with privileged information could provide dense signals on student's trajectories. However, its behavior in language reasoning remains unclear, with reported outcomes ranging from modest gains to behavioral collapse. In this work, we diagnose OPSD for mathematical reasoning across models spanning 0.6B--8B parameters. We conduct controlled experiments and token-level analyses to fully delve into OPSD. We point out that teacher's signal is shaped by reasoning-mode alignment and the complete teacher prefix, rather than by privileged semantics alone. OPSD improves reasoning only in narrow compatibility regimes. Otherwise, it produces ineffective length growth, stable degradation, or behavioral collapse. Token-level analysis shows that teacher's signal is not stable and does not predict downstream performance. Based on these results, we argue that OPSD is a sensitive algorithm rather than a generally reliable reasoning-improvement post-training method.
title: Diagnosing On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Language Models
title_translated: 诊断基于策略的自蒸馏在推理语言模型中的应用
summary_translated: 基于策略的自蒸馏（OPSD）作为一种提升语言模型推理能力的有前景方法，日益受到关注。它无需外部奖励或独立的更强教师模型，而是利用拥有特权信息的自教师为学生轨迹提供密集信号。然而，其在语言推理中的行为仍不清晰，已有报告结果从微弱提升到行为崩溃不等。本文针对0.6B至8B参数范围内的多种模型，对数学推理中的OPSD进行了诊断。我们通过受控实验和逐标记分析深入探究OPSD机制。研究指出，教师信号由推理模式对齐和完整教师前缀决定，而非仅由特权语义决定。OPSD仅在狭窄兼容范围内提升推理能力；否则会导致无效的长度增长、稳定退化或行为崩溃。逐标记分析表明，教师信号不稳定且无法预测下游性能。基于此，我们认为OPSD是一种敏感算法，而非普遍可靠的推理增强后训练方法。

summary: Human intelligence relies heavily on learned intuition: recognising patterns and judging situations without explicitly unfolding every intermediate step. We introduce Bongard, an open-weight System One model that treats machine intuition as an independent capability to design and train. A T5Gemma 2 4B-4B encoder-decoder separates reading the evidence from making judgments. The encoder reads the state bidirectionally together with the question instructions, and separate decoder branches share this encoding, so many judgments about the same situation require only one reading of the state. A trained head returns probabilities over the supplied candidates without generating text. Training proceeds in three stages, from supervised judgments to semantic relationships to action outcomes, and each stage updates all 7.09 billion trainable parameters on one Blackwell GPU. Joint-embedding post-training raises accuracy on held-out rephrasings from 75.7% to 85.9%. A sandbox stage then learns outcome distributions from action rollouts and exact oracles, raising accuracy on a frozen sandbox panel from 50.6% to 64.8%. On DecisionBench, the final model reaches 78.05% accuracy over 23,900 decisions and ranks fourth of 61 systems in the public comparison. On one RTX PRO 6000, its median latency is 36 ms for short requests, and 32 questions about one state take 221 ms. Bongard demonstrates that machine intuition can be systematically trained via representation learning and outcome feedback, providing an open, efficient alternative for high-throughput decision workloads.
title: Bongard: Training Machine Intuition
comment: Technical report, 28 pages, 7 figures. Model weights: this https URL
title_translated: Bongard：训练机器直觉
summary_translated: 人类智能高度依赖于习得的直觉：在不显式展开每一步中间过程的情况下识别模式并判断情境。我们引入Bongard，一个开放权重的System One模型，将机器直觉视为可独立设计与训练的能力。一个T5Gemma 2 4B-4B编码器-解码器将阅读证据与做出判断分离。编码器双向读取状态及问题指令，而多个解码分支共享该编码，因此对同一情境的多项判断只需一次状态读取。训练头返回候选项的概率分布，无需生成文本。训练分为三个阶段：从监督判断到语义关系，再到行动结果，每个阶段均在一个Blackwell GPU上更新全部70.9亿可训练参数。联合嵌入后训练使未见重述样本的准确率从75.7%提升至85.9%。随后的沙盒阶段通过行动回放和精确或acles学习结果分布，使冻结沙盒面板的准确率从50.6%提升至64.8%。在DecisionBench上，最终模型在23,900个决策中达到78.05%的准确率，在61个系统的公开对比中排名第四。在单张RTX PRO 6000上，其短请求中位延迟为36毫秒，对同一状态的22个问题耗时221毫秒。Bongard证明了机器直觉可通过表示学习和结果反馈系统性地训练，为高吞吐量决策工作负载提供了一个开放且高效的替代方案。

summary: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate CrossFit, our main method: it partitions the proposer's source documents into groups A and B; questions generated from A are scored by an auxiliary solver trained only on B, and vice versa. The cross-fitted agreement determines proposer reward, so a same-source pseudo-label cannot be reproduced through the feedback solver, while the original solver's update rule is unchanged. Rerunning the loop with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, MSV reduces false-agreement mass from 6.1% to 5.7% and from 8.8% to 7.2%, whereas CrossFit reduces it to 3.0% and 3.7%. Replaying identical proposals with source-excluded feedback further reduces false agreement to 0.4% and 0.1%, isolating feedback ancestry from curriculum changes. Across seven downstream search benchmarks, CrossFit improves average performance over standard coupled self-evolution by 8.8 and 8.4 points and over Search-R1 by 8.7 and 7.8 points at 4B and 9B.
title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
comment: 21 pages. Equal contribution: Meijia Chen, Hao Li, Zheng Lu
title_translated: 虚假边界：诊断并缓解自演化搜索智能体中的共作弊问题
summary_translated: 自演化搜索智能体通过联合优化生成问题的提议者和回答问题的求解器来构建自身的训练课程。这种闭环引入了一种我们称之为共作弊的故障模式：提议者和求解器在共享错误上逐渐达成一致，导致内部奖励提升但外部正确性未同步增长。对源证据的事后审计显示，随着自演化轮次的增加，共作弊现象愈发严重，伪标签正确率停滞甚至下降，尽管环内训练信号持续改善。最直接的缓解方法是在训练前验证提议：我们提出多样本验证（MSV），即在同一模型上分别使用和不使用源信息各查询三次，以决定任务准入并替换不可靠的伪标签。MSV部分减少了虚假一致性，但仍存在大量残留共作弊，且每候选任务需额外生成六次标注。这一局限促使我们提出主要方法CrossFit：将提议者的源文档分为A组和B组；从A组生成的问题由仅在B组上训练的辅助求解器评分，反之亦然。交叉拟合的一致性决定提议者奖励，因此同源伪标签无法通过反馈求解器重现，而原始求解器的更新规则保持不变。在Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3.5-9B上重新运行循环，MSV将虚假一致质量从6.1%降至5.7%，从8.8%降至7.2%；而CrossFit则分别降至3.0%和3.7%。在排除源信息的反馈下重播相同提议，虚假一致性进一步降至0.4%和0.1%，从而将反馈来源与课程变化隔离。在七个下游搜索基准测试中，CrossFit相较于标准耦合自演化分别提升8.8和8.4分，相较于Search-R1提升8.7和7.8分。

summary: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.
title: Beyond Text: LLM-Based Dimensional Emotion Evaluation in Multimodal Dialogue
title_translated: 超越文本：基于大语言模型的多模态对话连续维度情感评估
summary_translated: 对话中的情感识别已得到广泛研究，但将大语言模型（LLMs）应用于多模态对话中连续维度的情感评估仍处于探索阶段。我们提出一种基于LLM的框架，在IEMOCAP数据集上执行离散情感识别和Valence-Arousal-Dominance（VAD）维度评估，采用SpeechCueLLM方法将声学线索转化为自然语言描述。我们在零样本提示、少样本提示和LoRA微调三种设置下评估了来自LLaMA、GPT和Qwen系列的六种模型。尽管GPT模型规模更大，但LoRA微调后的LLaMA模型在两项任务上均显著优于提示工程的GPT模型，我们将其归因于领域适应而非模型容量。我们最佳模型在IEMOCAP上达到Valence CCC 0.7822，创下新纪录。消融实验表明，文本化声学描述对小型模型有明显提升（加权F1提升3.5至3.6），但对最大模型贡献甚微，说明声学线索在语言能力受限时价值更高。VAD各维度的表现不对称性与IEMOCAP标注者之间的共识层级高度一致。

summary: Legal language models require reward signals that capture not only answer correctness but also the multidimensional quality of legal responses. Existing reward methods, however, often rely on coarse-grained holistic judgments, providing limited domain specificity and interpretability. We introduce LexReward, a taxonomy-driven framework for legal reward modeling. LexReward characterizes legal response quality along three complementary dimensions: Style, covering lexical and syntactic quality; Element, assessing legal subjects, facts, statutes, and decisions; and Chain, evaluating the order, completeness, correctness, and non-redundancy of legal reasoning. For each dimension, we develop rubrics that specify evaluation criteria and quality levels. The resulting rewards are used to construct pairwise preference data for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and reward-model training. Experiments show that the rubric-based rewards reliably distinguish legal responses of different quality and that DPO training on the preference data improves performance across all three dimensions. The learned reward models, LexRM, also support effective downstream optimization: each dimension-specific reward model improves policy performance in its corresponding dimension through reinforcement learning, without requiring reference answers at reward time. Dimension-wise analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed taxonomy and reward construction.
title: LexReward: A Taxonomy-Driven Reward Framework for Legal Language Models
title_translated: LexReward：面向法律语言模型的分类驱动奖励框架
summary_translated: 法律语言模型需要捕捉不仅答案正确性，还包括法律回应多维质量的奖励信号。然而，现有奖励方法常依赖粗粒度的整体判断，缺乏领域特异性和可解释性。我们提出LexReward，一种基于分类体系的法律奖励建模框架。LexReward从三个互补维度刻画法律回应质量：风格（涵盖词汇与句法质量）、要素（评估法律主体、事实、法规及判决）和链条（评估法律推理的顺序、完整性、正确性与非冗余性）。针对每个维度，我们制定了明确的评价标准与质量等级。由此产生的奖励用于构建直接偏好优化（DPO）和奖励模型训练所需的成对偏好数据。实验表明，基于评分卡的奖励能可靠地区分不同质量的法律回应，且在偏好数据上进行DPO训练可全面提升三个维度表现。所学习的奖励模型LexRM也支持有效的下游优化：每个维度专用的奖励模型通过强化学习在对应维度上提升策略性能，无需在奖励时刻提供参考答案。维度分析进一步验证了所提分类体系与奖励构建的有效性。

summary: Test-time reasoning systems often respond to failure by restarting or revising the latest step, even when an earlier decision caused the error. We introduce CORE, a search controller that requests a certified conflict core from a verifier, backjumps to the latest decision in that core, and caches the conflict to avoid repeating it. Under sound verification, finite branching and depth, and exhaustive proposals, the uncapped search is complete and never prunes a valid solution. On 2,000 planted graph-coloring instances with matched proposals and an exact verifier, CORE reduces median verifier calls by 39.8% at 30 variables and 35.0% at 36 variables relative to chronological repair; caching further improves on backjumping alone. Across five reasoning tasks, CORE achieves 75.9% mean success with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 84.2% with Qwen3-8B, compared with 72.5% and 81.8% for Tree of Thoughts. It also uses fewer verifier calls and generated tokens on both backbones. These results show the value of using certified failure explanations to direct language-model search.
title: CORE: Conflict-Oriented Reasoning Elimination for Verifiable Language-Model Search
title_translated: CORE：面向可验证语言模型搜索的冲突导向推理消除方法
summary_translated: 测试时推理系统在失败时常通过重启或修改最新步骤应对，即使错误源于更早决策。我们引入CORE，一种搜索控制器，它向验证器请求一个经认证的冲突核心，回跳至该核心中最新的决策点，并缓存该冲突以避免重复。在满足验证可靠性、有限分支与深度以及全面提案的前提下，无上限搜索是完备的，且永不剪枝有效解。在2,000个预设图着色实例上，使用匹配提案与精确验证器，CORE相比时间顺序修复方法在30变量时减少39.8%的验证器调用，36变量时减少35.0%；缓存机制进一步提升了回跳效果。在五个推理任务中，CORE在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上实现75.9%的平均成功率，在Qwen3-8B上达84.2%，分别高于Tree of Thoughts的72.5%和81.8%。同时，CORE在两种骨干模型上均使用更少的验证器调用和生成token。这些结果凸显了利用经认证的失败解释来引导语言模型搜索的价值。

summary: A large language model (LLM) can rate depression severity directly from a social media post or mark which clinical criteria the post shows and let code turn the count into a label. The latter is easier to audit because a clinician can check each marked criterion. We compare these approaches on two Reddit corpora using three LLMs (from 9B to frontier scale) and two questionnaires (PHQ-9, BDI-II), and measure agreement with quadratic weighted kappa. For the two frontier models, criteria extraction scores above chain-of-thought on one corpus only when its decision thresholds are fitted on labeled data. Neither model's gain is significant, with or without recalibrating chain-of-thought on the same labels. With thresholds fixed a priori from PHQ-9's criteria, extraction shows no gain on either corpus, even where models mark over two criteria per post. The 9B model behaves differently on a corpus from depression communities. It labels most posts severe, whether prompted directly or with chain-of-thought, while the a priori rule beats both without labels. After chain-of-thought is recalibrated on the same labels, no significant gap remains, consistent with a calibration effect. Yet higher ordinal agreement does not ensure better detection of severe cases. PHQ-9 criteria extraction misses most severe posts, and moving from direct prompting to chain-of-thought and then to extraction increases misses in nearly all comparisons. On the primary corpus, a relabeled stress dataset, a model using that dataset's own features, including word counts from the text, is not significantly different from frontier criteria extraction under the a priori rule.
title: Structure vs. Chain-of-Thought: Evaluating LLM Criteria Extraction for Depression Severity

title_translated: 结构 vs. 思维链：评估大语言模型在抑郁严重程度判别中的标准提取能力
summary_translated: 大语言模型可直接从社交媒体帖子中评定抑郁严重程度，或标记出帖子中体现的临床标准，再由代码将计数转为标签。后者更易审计，因为临床医生可逐项核查标记的标准。我们在两个Reddit语料库上比较这两种方法，使用三款大语言模型（从9B到前沿规模）和两种量表（PHQ-9、BDI-II），以二次加权kappa衡量一致性。对于两款前沿模型，仅当其决策阈值在标注数据上拟合时，标准提取才在其中一个语料库上优于思维链方法。无论是否对思维链进行再校准，模型增益均不显著。在固定PHQ-9标准的先验阈值下，标准提取在任一语料库上均无优势，即使模型每篇帖子标记超过两个标准。9B模型在抑郁社区语料库上的行为不同：无论直接提示还是使用思维链，均将多数帖子标记为严重，而先验规则在无标签情况下优于两者。在对思维链进行同一批标签再校准后，差异不再显著，符合校准效应。然而更高的序数一致性并不保证更优的严重病例检测。PHQ-9标准提取会遗漏大多数严重帖子，从直接提示到思维链再到标准提取，几乎所有比较中漏检情况都增加。在主语料库——一个重新标注的压力数据集上，使用该数据集自身特征（包括文本词数）的模型，与先验规则下的前沿标准提取相比，无显著差异。

summary: Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Naive iterative refinement can easily overfit a small set of test cases, producing fragile games with unresolved bugs, missing behaviors, and poor generalization to broader player interactions. We introduce RSIGame, an autonomous agentic game development framework with recursive self-improvement. RSIGame organizes development into complementary local and global loops. Concretely, a local explore-diagnose-improve loop broadly explores the executable game, diagnoses and prioritizes discovered issues, and performs evidence-grounded revision, where an evolving checklist continually accumulates new testing and improvement guidance. A global loop tracks overall quality, preserves the best checkpoint, and detects saturation or regression over long-horizon development. Beyond test-time improvement, RSIGame further internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training. Across 140 GameCraft-Bench tasks, two game engines, and five generators, RSIGame consistently improves game quality under matched development budgets. Notably, experience internalization enables Qwen3.8-27B to reach 61.38 on Godot and 58.53 on Phaser, exceeding GPT-5.5 one-shot scores while reducing Qwen's generation tokens by 11 times.
title: RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement
title_translated: RSIGame：基于递归自我改进的自主智能体游戏开发
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的最新进展使得自动游戏生成变得日益可行，但要可靠地将生成的游戏提升至可玩版本以上仍具挑战性。简单的迭代优化容易对少量测试用例过拟合，导致生成的游戏脆弱、存在未解决的漏洞、缺失行为，并且在更广泛的玩家交互中泛化能力差。我们提出了RSIGame，一种具有递归自我改进能力的自主智能体游戏开发框架。RSIGame将开发过程组织为互补的局部和全局循环。具体而言，局部探索-诊断-改进循环广泛探索可执行游戏，诊断并优先处理发现的问题，并进行基于证据的修订，其中一个不断演进的检查清单持续积累新的测试与改进指导。全局循环则跟踪整体质量，保留最佳检查点，并检测长期开发中的饱和或退化现象。除了运行时改进，RSIGame还通过训练将成功的开发经验内化到生成器中。在140个GameCraft-Bench任务、两种游戏引擎和五种生成器上，RSIGame在相同开发预算下持续提升了游戏质量。值得注意的是，经验内化使Qwen3.8-27B在Godot上达到61.38分，在Phaser上达到58.53分，超过了GPT-5.5的一次性得分，同时将Qwen的生成token数量减少了11倍。

summary: AI reviewers can assign different judgments to manuscripts that report the same science in different wording, potentially rewarding rhetorical optimization over scientific improvement. We formulate Rhetorical Robustness as the joint requirement of stability across content-preserving rewrites and discrimination across papers. We introduce RobustReview, a controlled full-manuscript benchmark with 1,260 manuscript versions, and evaluate 30 reviewer configurations. The benchmark reveals false robustness, where low rewrite sensitivity coincides with score collapse across papers, and shows that human alignment and rhetorical robustness rank reviewers differently. Moreover, the evaluated content-focused prompting protocol does not consistently improve robustness across backbones. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SciCore, a dual-branch reviewer that averages a full-manuscript judgment with a judgment based on an extracted, structured science core. This design combines manuscript-level assessment with a content-normalized view intended to reduce rhetorical sensitivity. In our primary GPT-5.5 comparison, SciCore achieves a leading joint stability-discrimination profile among the benchmarked reviewers while maintaining competitive human alignment. These results identify rhetorical robustness as a distinct evaluation target and demonstrate the potential of science-core review to improve it.
title: A Missing Piece for Trustworthy AI Reviewers: From Benchmarking Rhetorical Robustness to SciCore Review
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures, 20 tables. Accepted (Oral) at AI-Native Academia @ NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 可信AI评审的关键缺失环节：从修辞鲁棒性基准到SciCore评审
summary_translated: AI评审者可能对以不同措辞报告相同科学内容的手稿给出不同判断，从而可能奖励修辞优化而非科学改进。我们将修辞鲁棒性定义为在保持内容不变的重写下保持稳定，同时在不同论文间具备区分能力的联合要求。我们引入RobustReview，一个包含1,260个手稿版本的受控全手稿基准，并评估了30种评审配置。该基准揭示了虚假鲁棒性现象——低重写敏感性与跨论文分数崩溃同时出现，并表明人类对齐与修辞鲁棒性对评审者的排名不同。此外，所评估的内容导向提示协议并未在所有模型架构上一致提升鲁棒性。基于这些发现，我们提出SciCore，一种双分支评审系统，它将完整手稿的判断与基于提取出的结构化科学核心的判断进行平均。该设计结合了手稿层面的评估与内容归一化的视角，旨在降低修辞敏感性。在主要的GPT-5.5对比实验中，SciCore在基准评审者中实现了领先的联合稳定性-区分度表现，同时保持了有竞争力的人类对齐水平。这些结果将修辞鲁棒性识别为一个独立的评估目标，并展示了科学核心评审在改善该目标方面的潜力。

summary: EVICALC, our system for the DocSem shared task, achieved 8.61% joint accuracy on 1,730 tasks in the official final test evaluation. It reads a PDF, selects a passage, asks a language model to write an arithmetic expression, and evaluates that expression in local code. Saved intermediate results support inspection of failures. A separate public-validation run achieved 92.17% answer accuracy and 1.00 evidence F1. The configurations and metrics differ, so these scores are not a controlled comparison. Our manual, post-hoc analysis is descriptive: in one inspected case, optical character recognition (OCR) and block grouping merged the relevant passage into another block, and the system answered from unrelated text. An exploratory study of reading page images on 100 documents returned evidence identifiers for only 22 documents. These descriptive findings motivate further evaluation; they do not establish the causes of the overall score.
title: Evidence First, Arithmetic Second: A System Report and Failure Analysis for DocSem
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted as a shared-task system paper at DocInsights 2026, co-located with EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 证据优先，算术其次：DocSem系统的报告与失败分析
summary_translated: 我们在DocSem共享任务中提出的系统EVICALC，在官方最终测试评估的1,730个任务上取得了8.61%的联合准确率。该系统读取PDF文件，选择一段文本，让语言模型编写算术表达式，并在本地代码中评估该表达式。保存的中间结果支持对失败案例的检查。一次独立的公开验证运行达到了92.17%的答案准确率和1.00的证据F1值。由于配置和指标不同，这些分数无法构成受控比较。我们的手动后验分析是描述性的：在一个被检查的案例中，光学字符识别（OCR）和块分组将相关段落错误合并到了另一个块中，系统从无关文本中作答。对100份文档的页面图像阅读探索性研究仅在22份文档中返回了有效的证据标识符。这些描述性发现促使进一步评估；它们并未确立整体得分偏低的根本原因。

summary: LLM services are billed per token and context windows are measured in tokens, yet the number of tokens needed for the same content varies across languages. We measure this token premium on seven tokenizers of widely used 2026 models (OpenAI o200k, Llama 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3/V4, Gemma 3, Mistral Tekken, and the Claude generation-5 tokenizer via Anthropic's counting API) on NTREX-128 (124 non-English reference translations) and on the Universal Declaration of Human Rights for regional languages. French requires 31% to 58% more tokens than English, whereas Simplified Chinese ranges from 5% fewer to 40% more and is cheaper than French on six of the seven tokenizers. Regional and overseas languages of France pay roughly 1.6 to 3.3 times the English count. We discuss how history re-sending, tiered pricing and fixed context windows amplify the absolute gap in agentic use. In a controlled experiment (BPE, Europarl, 50k vocabulary), adding French to tokenizer training data quickly reduces the premium, with diminishing returns and a growing cost for English. Finally, we present Baracoda FR v1.2, a byte-level BPE prototype with Tekken's vocabulary size. On a final test of six corpora never consulted during design, with a protocol declared fixed beforehand, it uses 11.5% fewer tokens than Tekken on French and 3.7% fewer on English; results hold after removing test sentences overlapping the training data and with an equal ordinary-token budget. It is worse on other languages and, at comparable vocabulary size, does not outperform CroissantLLM. These are segmentation results only; effects on model quality and task cost remain to be shown.
title: The Invisible Language Tax: Token Premiums of French and Regional Languages in 2026 LLM Tokenizers, and a French-Optimized Prototype
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code, tokenizer, per-sentence counts and controls: this https URL (commit fc8a736)
title_translated: 隐形语言税：2026年大模型分词器中法语及地区语言的token溢价，以及法语优化原型
summary_translated: 大模型服务按token计费，上下文窗口也以token衡量，但相同内容在不同语言中所需的token数量存在差异。我们测量了七种广泛使用的2026年模型分词器（OpenAI o200k、Llama 3、Qwen3、DeepSeek V3/V4、Gemma 3、Mistral Tekken，以及通过Anthropic计数API获取的Claude generation-5分词器）在NTREX-128（124个非英语参考翻译）和法国地区语言的《世界人权宣言》上的token溢价。法语所需token比英语多31%至58%，而简体中文则在六种分词器上比英语便宜，范围为5%减少至40%增加。法国的地区及海外语言支付的token数约为英语的1.6至3.3倍。我们讨论了历史重传、分级定价和固定上下文窗口如何放大智能体使用中的绝对差距。在一项受控实验中（BPE，Europarl，50k词汇量），将法语加入分词器训练数据能快速降低溢价，但收益递减且英语成本上升。最后，我们提出Baracoda FR v1.2，一个基于字节的BPE原型，采用Tekken的词汇量。在六份从未用于设计阶段的语料库的最终测试中，其在法语上比Tekken少用11.5%的token，在英语上少用3.7%；即使移除与训练数据重叠的测试句，且在同等普通token预算下，结果依然成立。它在其他语言上表现较差，且在相当词汇量下未能超越CroissantLLM。这些仅为分词结果；对模型质量与任务成本的影响仍有待验证。

summary: Reasoning models often continue generating after their answers have settled. Settle learns when to stop from answer stability in completed traces. It trains the existing end-of-reasoning token while keeping other predictions close to the base model, and requires only ordinary decoding at inference. On MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B, Settle reduces token count by 40% with a 0.5-percentage-point decrease in accuracy. It gains 6.16 percentage points over supervised fine-tuning on the same traces shortened at their first stable answer, at nearly identical token counts. Its stopping score predicts whether a correct answer will remain correct. Settle extends the accuracy-token-count Pareto frontier of the evaluated stopping methods.
title: Settle: Learning When to Stop Reasoning
title_translated: Settle：学习何时停止推理
summary_translated: 推理模型常常在答案已确定后仍继续生成。Settle通过已完成推理轨迹中的答案稳定性来学习何时停止。它在不改变其他预测的前提下，训练现有的推理结束token，且推理时仅需常规解码。在使用Qwen3-4B的MATH-500数据集上，Settle将token消耗减少40%，准确率下降0.5个百分点。相较于监督微调，在相同缩短至首次稳定答案的轨迹上，Settle获得了6.16个百分点的提升，且token消耗几乎相同。其停止评分能够预测正确答案是否会保持正确。Settle扩展了所评估停止方法的准确率-token消耗帕累托前沿。

summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own generated responses using feedback from the same model conditioned on privileged information. On mathematical reasoning, the original OPSD study finds that stylistic tokens can dominate the training signal over math-related tokens, and that pointwise clipping of the forward KL objective stabilizes training. Pointwise clipping caps each vocabulary-wise forward KL term at a fixed threshold before summing over the vocabulary. Follow-up studies have adopted this clipping, but its effect on training has not been directly examined. In matched training runs differing only in whether clipping is applied, we observe that clipped runs produce substantially more repetitions that persist to the end of the response than their unclipped counterparts. We trace this failure to the clipped objective. We prove that the clipped objective can fail to correct the student toward the teacher and can instead push clipped and unclipped token probabilities away from its teacher. Our training runs agree with this analysis: inside repetitions, the clipped student places less probability than its teacher on leaving the repetition, and more on continuing it, whereas the unclipped runs stay close to their teachers.
title: When Clipping Reverses Correction: Failure Dynamics of Pointwise Forward-KL On-Policy Self-Distillation
title_translated: 当截断反转修正：点对点前向KL在策略自蒸馏中的失败动态
summary_translated: 在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中，学生模型通过自身生成的响应并结合包含特权信息的同一模型反馈进行训练。在数学推理任务中，原始研究发现，风格化标记会主导训练信号，超过与数学相关的标记；而点对点截断前向KL目标可稳定训练过程。点对点截断在词汇层面将每个前向KL项限制在固定阈值内，再对词汇求和。后续研究采用了该截断方法，但其对训练的实际影响尚未被直接检验。在仅是否应用截断不同的匹配训练运行中，我们观察到使用截断的运行产生显著更多的重复内容，并持续存在于响应末尾，而未截断的对照组则表现更优。我们追溯这一失败源于截断目标。我们证明，截断目标可能无法正确引导学生向教师模型靠拢，反而使截断与未截断的词概率偏离教师模型。我们的训练结果与此分析一致：在重复内部，截断的学生模型在离开重复状态上的概率低于教师模型，而在继续重复上的概率更高，而未截断的运行则始终接近其教师模型。

summary: Demographic fairness gaps in automatic speech recognition are almost always reported from a single training run. We fine-tune the Q-former projector and LoRA adapters of a speech LLM at five audio compression factors and six random seeds, holding the encoder, base decoder, data and decoding fixed, and evaluate every run on Common Voice and Fair-Speech. At 460 h of clean LibriSpeech, the seed moves fairness metrics more than compression does on most demographic axes. A balanced 3x3 decomposition attributes 85.3% of the variation in Fair-Speech ethnicity normalized gap to the seed against 8.3% to compression (p = 0.009), though compression explains more on age and gender. Held-out LibriSpeech word error rate spreads by 0.04 points across those seeds while Common Voice spreads by 8.57, so these are not failed runs, and the effect survives controlling for accuracy and dropout. Scaling and diversifying the adaptation set to 960 h damps the effect but does not remove it. On Fair-Speech ethnicity, two single-run systems must differ by more than 0.30 in normalized gap to exceed seed variability.
title: Fairness Beyond a Single Run: Training-Seed Variability in Speech LLM Adaptation
title_translated: 公平性超越单次运行：语音大模型适配中的训练种子变异性
summary_translated: 自动语音识别中的群体公平性差距几乎总是基于单次训练运行报告。我们微调了语音大模型的Q-former投影器和LoRA适配器，在五种音频压缩因子和六种随机种子下进行实验，保持编码器、基础解码器、数据集和解码方式不变，并在Common Voice和Fair-Speech上评估每次运行。在460小时纯净LibriSpeech数据上，种子对大多数人口统计维度的公平性指标影响大于压缩因子。一个平衡的3x3分解显示，Fair-Speech种族标准化差距的85.3%变异来自种子，而压缩仅贡献8.3%（p=0.009），尽管压缩在年龄和性别上解释更多。在保留的LibriSpeech词错误率上，不同种子间差异为0.04个百分点，而Common Voice差异达8.57，说明这些并非失败运行，且该效应在控制准确率和丢弃率后依然存在。将适配集扩展至960小时虽减弱了该效应，但未消除。在Fair-Speech种族方面，两个单次运行系统必须在标准化差距上相差超过0.30才能超过种子变异性。

summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. However, growing evidence shows that models' CoT often fails to reflect their internal computations and can be changed without affecting their final answers. In this work, we measure and improve the alignment between the reasoning described in an LLM's CoT and what it computes internally. We propose CoT-Interpretability Alignment (CIA), a metric that measures the agreement between a model's CoT traces and its internal reasoning strategies as detected by interpretability tools. We evaluate CIA on three tasks (two-hop question answering, hint intervention, and integer multiplication) across three LLMs, finding that LLMs exhibit limited alignment across all tasks (44.8-75.9%). We then experiment with improving CIA via post-training, setting both the task accuracy and parametric faithfulness signals as a reward. Experiments show that we can substantially improve CoT parametric faithfulness while maintaining or improving the task accuracy. We provide rich analysis, such as their generalization patterns. Our work provides both a framework for auditing CoT parametric faithfulness and a pathway toward making models' explicit reasoning more trustworthy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro.
title: Making LLMs Say What They Think: Measuring and Improving CoT-Interpretability Alignment
title_translated: 让大模型说出它所想：测量与提升思维链可解释性对齐
summary_translated: 思维链（CoT）常作为大语言模型（LLMs）得出答案过程的代理。然而越来越多的证据表明，模型的CoT往往不能反映其内部计算，且可在不改变最终答案的情况下被修改。本文旨在测量并提升LLM的CoT描述与内部推理策略之间的对齐程度。我们提出CoT可解释性对齐（CIA）度量，用于衡量模型CoT轨迹与其内部推理策略（由可解释性工具检测）之间的一致性。我们在三个任务（双跳问答、提示干预、整数乘法）和三个LLM上评估CIA，发现所有任务中LLM的对齐程度有限（44.8%-75.9%）。随后我们通过后训练改进CIA，同时将任务准确率和参数忠实度信号作为奖励。实验表明，我们可以在保持或提升任务准确率的同时显著提高CoT的参数忠实度。我们提供了丰富的分析，如泛化模式。本工作既提供了一种审计CoT参数忠实度的框架，也为使模型显式推理更具可信度指明了路径。代码与数据见https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro。

summary: Working agents need to read diverse files, coordinate tools, and produce deliverables. Training such agents requires tasks built on many real files with verifiable results, but few pipelines exist to synthesize this kind of data. Existing pipelines either generate files with models, which lack realism and diversity, or build tasks on real files without task-specific verifiers, leaving result quality unchecked. We introduce GraphForge, an evidence-graph based framework that grounds both the task and its verification in real files. Starting from occupation-grounded seeds for controlled diversity, GraphForge assembles a workspace of real files for each seed and builds an evidence graph over their relations. Since the task statement and rubrics are both derived from this graph, task requirements are backed by the workspace files and each criterion is anchored to the files needed to verify it. An initial rollout further tests executability, and a revision agent repairs the task and rubrics against the original files before trajectories are collected. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 GraphForge trajectories brings GDPVal to 1445.7 (+65.7) under OpenHands, and Workspace-Bench-Lite and SpreadsheetBench II to 63.7 (+7.7) and 24.0 (+13.7) under Claude Code. Rejection fine-tuning on the SFT model's own rollouts, with candidates selected by the evidence-anchored rubrics, yields further improvements on all three benchmarks, suggesting that the rubrics provide a useful selection signal. The data and models are available.
title: GraphForge: Training Working Agents with Graph-Anchored Workspace Synthesis
title_translated: GraphForge：基于图锚定工作区合成的训练工作智能体
summary_translated: 工作智能体需要读取多种文件、协调工具并生成交付成果。训练此类智能体需要基于真实文件且结果可验证的任务，但目前缺乏有效的数据合成管道。现有方法要么用模型生成文件，缺乏真实性和多样性；要么基于真实文件构建任务，但无特定任务验证器，导致结果质量无法保障。我们提出GraphForge，一种基于证据图的框架，将任务及其验证均锚定于真实文件。从职业相关的种子出发以实现可控多样性，GraphForge为每个种子组装一组真实文件的工作区，并构建它们之间的关系证据图。由于任务说明和评分标准均源自该图，任务需求由工作区文件支持，每项标准都锚定于所需验证的文件。初步部署进一步测试可执行性，修订智能体在收集轨迹前根据原始文件修复任务和评分标准。在2,169条GraphForge轨迹上微调Qwen3.6-27B，使GDPVal在OpenHands下达到1445.7（+65.7），Workspace-Bench-Lite和SpreadsheetBench II分别达到63.7（+7.7）和24.0（+13.7）（使用Claude Code）。对SFT模型自身回滚结果进行拒绝微调，候选样本由证据锚定的评分标准选择，进一步提升了三个基准的表现，表明评分标准提供了有效的筛选信号。数据与模型已公开。

summary: Finding a relevant paper is not the same as producing a verifiable answer from it. LitTraceQA requires canonical paper identifiers, exact evidence at the page or object level, and typed answers that match the evaluator. We call the separation between source access and scorer-visible correctness the grounding contract gap. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the official 71-question test set, including 0.9728 paper F1, 0.6847 evidence F1, 0.9800 multiple-choice accuracy, 0.5423 table-row F1, and 0.3508 macro cell accuracy. On 11 public-development table records, a clean baseline and coordinate-aware visual fill obtain row F1 of 0.291 and 0.411, respectively; this diagnostic comparison includes fallback outputs and is not an official-test claim. Remaining errors chiefly concern locator, observation-unit, row-key, and source-value identity.
title: TRACE: Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction for LitTraceQA
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
title_translated: TRACE：目标感知检索、属性化证据与合同约束提取用于LitTraceQA
summary_translated: 找到相关论文并不等同于从中生成可验证的答案。LitTraceQA要求提供规范的论文标识符、页面或对象级别的精确证据，以及与评估者匹配的类型化答案。我们将源访问与评估者可见正确性之间的分离称为‘接地合同差距’。TRACE——目标感知检索、属性化证据与合同约束提取——通过目标分组检索、独立类型化证据定位、多模态表格提取、基于模式的表格构建及闭合失败验证来解决这一差距。它通过段落、对象、别名、引用和密集表示索引27,487篇论文，同时保留每个信号背后的问题目标。对于表格，TRACE在提取数值前预测观测单元，并使用评估者兼容的键归一化组装行。经审计的精选干净轨道成果在官方71题测试集上得分为0.760613，包括0.9728的论文F1、0.6847的证据F1、0.9800的多项选择准确率、0.5423的表格行F1和0.3508的宏单元准确率。在11个公开开发表格记录上，干净基线与坐标感知视觉填充分别获得行F1为0.291和0.411；此诊断对比包含回退输出，非官方测试声明。剩余错误主要涉及定位器、观测单元、行键和源值身份识别问题。

summary: End-to-end accuracy on compositional tasks records how often MLLMs fail, but cannot distinguish whether a failure reflects an intrinsic deficit in the targeted capability or a cascading error from an upstream prerequisite. We propose a causal decomposition framework that isolates these two failure modes through controlled interventions on the prerequisite dependencies of each task. Our capability metrics (NC, IC, RC) score each task under unassisted, correct, or incorrect prerequisites to diagnose where failures arise; contribution metrics (N-Score, S-Score), adapted from probabilities of causation, quantify each prerequisite's necessity and sufficiency to determine why. We instantiate the framework in CADET, a diagnostic benchmark of 10 composite tasks decomposed into 46 unit tasks with over 33,000 human-annotated questions spanning perception, spatial, temporal, and cognitive categories. Diagnosing frontier MLLMs with our framework uncovers systematic patterns that end-to-end accuracy obscures. Capability-wise, supplying correct prerequisites eliminates 54\% of errors on cognitive tasks, lifting them from weakest to above spatial and temporal. Prerequisite-wise, causal contributions are concentrated in a few critical prerequisites, and supplying the single most important one alone captures 84\% of the gain from supplying all prerequisites.
title: Where MLLMs Fail and Why: Causal Task Decomposition for Capability Failure Diagnosis
title_translated: MLLMs 失效之处及其原因：能力失败诊断的因果任务分解
summary_translated: 在组合任务上的端到端准确率记录了 MLLMs 的失败频率，但无法区分失败是源于目标能力的内在缺陷，还是上游前提条件的级联错误。我们提出了一种因果分解框架，通过控制每个任务的前提依赖关系来隔离这两种失败模式。我们的能力度量（NC、IC、RC）在无辅助、正确或错误前提条件下对每个任务进行评分，以诊断失败来源；贡献度量（N-Score、S-Score）基于因果概率进行调整，量化每个前提条件的必要性和充分性以确定原因。我们在 CADET 中实现了该框架，这是一个包含 10 个复合任务、分解为 46 个单元任务的诊断基准，涵盖超过 33,000 个由人工标注的问题，涉及感知、空间、时间与认知类别。使用该框架对前沿 MLLMs 进行诊断，揭示了端到端准确率所掩盖的系统性模式。从能力角度看，提供正确前提可消除 54% 的认知任务错误，使这些任务的表现从最弱提升至高于空间和时间任务水平。从前提角度看，因果贡献集中在少数关键前提上，仅提供最重要的一个前提即可获得全部前提供应时 84% 的性能提升。

summary: Scaling attention parameters can improve language model quality, but retaining full token histories makes additional heads costly at long contexts. Furthermore, since attention retrieves and combines contextual information, parameter scaling should also support longer contexts. We therefore ask whether attention parameter scaling can directly enable efficient and effective context scaling. We introduce NAMOH, an architecture-native sparse attention mechanism that activates $K$ of $H$ heads per token. Each head retains only its assigned tokens and performs causal attention within this subsequence. Head selection thus jointly determines active parameters and available context without scanning the full history. Under balanced assignments, increasing $H$ at fixed $K$ shortens head histories and reduces per-token key-value (KV) access without increasing total KV storage. We further support head-relative rotary position embeddings to shorten positional spans within routed subsequences, aiming to mitigate position-induced attention noise. Experiments show that NAMOH can outperform fully activated models with the same total parameters, while enabling more efficient long-context inference than smaller dense models with matched active parameter counts. It remains compatible with GQA and existing sparse attention mechanisms. We hope this work offers a new path for scaling attention, with parameter scaling directly enabling context scaling.
title: Scaling Parameter and Context in Attention: Native Sparse Attention from Mixture-of-Head
title_translated: 注意力机制中参数与上下文的扩展：来自头混合的原生稀疏注意力
summary_translated: 扩大注意力参数可以提升语言模型质量，但保留完整的 token 历史会使更多注意力头在长上下文场景下变得昂贵。此外，由于注意力机制需要检索和整合上下文信息，参数扩展也应支持更长的上下文。因此我们探讨注意力参数扩展是否能直接实现高效且有效的上下文扩展。我们提出了 NAMOH，一种架构原生的稀疏注意力机制，每 token 激活 $K$ 个头中的 $H$ 个。每个头仅保留其分配的 token，并在此子序列内执行因果注意力。头的选择同时决定了活跃参数数量和可用上下文，无需扫描完整历史。在均衡分配下，固定 $K$ 时增加 $H$ 可缩短头的历史长度，并减少每个 token 的键值（KV）访问次数，而不会增加总 KV 存储量。我们进一步引入头相对旋转位置嵌入，以缩短路由子序列内的位置跨度，旨在缓解位置引起的注意力噪声。实验表明，NAMOH 在相同总参数量下优于全激活模型，同时在长上下文推理效率上超过参数量更小的密集模型。该方法与 GQA 和现有稀疏注意力机制兼容。我们希望这项工作为注意力扩展提供一条新路径，使参数扩展直接支持上下文扩展。

summary: Model-attribution classifiers can often identify which language model produced a text, making model-specific writing patterns a signal of provenance. Accurate attribution on unmodified text, however, does not show whether the prediction still identifies the original source after deliberate rewriting. We formulate this problem as targeted fingerprint transfer: rewriting one model's output so that attribution classifiers assign it to a chosen target model. We study summarization, where different models receive the same document and express the same underlying content, providing a controlled setting for conditional generation. We introduce ForgePrint, a search-then-distil framework that first searches for rewrites that move attribution toward a target fingerprint, then distils the selected rewrites into a one-pass 4B Student model. On CNN/DM, the Student reaches 70.2% target success rate, outperforming both its Teacher (54.1%) and the strongest of six published rewriting baselines (39.3%), against held-out classifiers that are never queried by the attack. It also reaches 68.3% target success when transferring summaries from an open model toward chosen commercial models. These results show that fingerprint detectability should not be conflated with source authenticity, and that text-only attribution can provide misleading evidence of model identity under targeted rewriting, even when it is accurate on unmodified text.
title: Forging LLM Authorship Fingerprints with Targeted Rewriting
comment: 31 pages, 7 figures, 25 tables. Project page: this https URL
title_translated: 通过定向重写伪造 LLM 作者指纹
summary_translated: 模型归属分类器通常能够识别文本由哪个语言模型生成，使得模型特有的写作模式成为出处信号。然而，在未修改文本上的准确归属并不能说明在刻意重写后，预测是否仍能识别原始来源。我们将此问题形式化为定向指纹迁移：重写一个模型的输出，使归属分类器将其归为选定的目标模型。我们研究摘要任务，不同模型接收同一文档并表达相同底层内容，为条件生成提供了受控环境。我们提出 ForgePrint，一种搜索-蒸馏框架，首先搜索能使归属向目标指纹转移的重写方案，然后将选中的重写结果蒸馏成单次通过的 4B 学生模型。在 CNN/DM 数据集上，学生模型达到 70.2% 的目标成功率，优于其教师模型（54.1%）以及六种已发表重写基线中的最强者（39.3%），且攻击从未查询过保留的分类器。当将开放模型的摘要转移到选定商业模型时，该模型仍达到 68.3% 的目标成功率。这些结果表明，指纹可检测性不应与源真实性混淆，即使在未修改文本上归属准确，文本仅有的归属也可能在定向重写下提供误导性的模型身份证据。

summary: With the rapid growth of Arabic NLP, several models, datasets and benchmarks have been reported. This paper asks whether approaches developed for majority languages like English can be adapted to Arabic tasks. We adapt an English aspect-based sentiment analysis framework to Arabic classification tasks and present the adaptation as BARRAC: Brainstorming Alignment and Replaced Representation learning for ArabiC tasks. BARRAC replaces consumer-review attribute pools with Arabic linguistic devices and markers for dialectal sentiment, sarcasm, and dialect identification, and replaces noisy self-training with two-stage training. Evaluated on five Arabic dialect datasets, BARRAC achieves a mean macro-F1 of 63.93\%, outperforming the best few-label SOTA by 3\%, and outperforming GPT-4o on four out of five tasks. Error analysis provides insights into remaining challenges. These results demonstrate that adapting task-specific approaches is a promising direction for Arabic NLP alongside adapting models, datasets and benchmarks.
title: BARRAC: Adaptation of an English Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis Approach for Classification Tasks in Arabic Dialects
title_translated: BARRAC：面向阿拉伯语方言分类任务的英语方面情感分析方法适配
summary_translated: 随着阿拉伯语自然语言处理的快速发展，已有多个模型、数据集和基准被报道。本文探讨了为英语等主流语言开发的方法能否适配阿拉伯语任务。我们将英语方面的情感分析框架适配至阿拉伯语分类任务，并提出 BARRAC：用于阿拉伯语任务的头脑风暴对齐与替换表示学习。BARRAC 将消费者评论属性池替换为阿拉伯语语言工具和标记，用于方言情感、讽刺和方言识别，并用两阶段训练替代有噪声的自训练。在五个阿拉伯语方言数据集上评估，BARRAC 达到平均宏 F1 为 63.93%，优于最佳少量标签 SOTA 模型 3%，并在四个任务上超越 GPT-4o。错误分析揭示了现存挑战。这些结果表明，适配特定任务方法是阿拉伯语 NLP 的一个有前景方向，与模型、数据集和基准的适配并行发展。

summary: While multi-agent and model collaboration algorithms gain traction to combine the strengths of diverse Large Language Models (LLMs), existing systems remain bottlenecked on pre-defined and hand-crafted model pools.
