In this work, we investigate the problem of model selection in multi-LLM systems. We propose and systematically evaluate a taxonomy of 9 selection algorithms ranging from diversity of model descriptions, capability-aware behavioral diversity, and LLM-based recruiters. We conduct extensive experiments across two candidate pools of 10 and 32 models, deployed in four model collaboration algorithms, and evaluated across tasks spanning math, coding, QA, and reasoning. Results demonstrate that successful selection algorithms greatly outperform random or heuristics-based teams such as merely selecting the models with top individual performance, by up to 36.1% across settings. Specifically, capability- and training-based selection strategies alleviate selection variance and achieve the best performance, which we recommend to employ before deploying real-world multi-LLM systems. Further analysis reveals that larger candidate pools pose greater challenges to shallow selection heuristics, while algorithms grounded in interacting with candidate models and understanding model capability robustly filter out misaligned, unsafe models, as well as generalizing to novel, out-of-distribution tasks. Together, we establish that principled and informed team selection is critical and present strong model selection algorithms for assembling effective multi-LLM systems.
title: You're Hired: Strategic Model Selection for LLM Collaboration
title_translated: 你被录用：LLM 协作中的战略模型选择
summary_translated: 尽管多智能体和模型协作算法日益流行，用于结合多种大型语言模型（LLMs）的优势，但现有系统仍受限于预定义且手工设计的模型池。在本研究中，我们探讨多 LLM 系统中的模型选择问题。我们提出并系统评估了涵盖 9 种选择算法的分类体系，包括模型描述多样性、能力感知的行为多样性，以及基于 LLM 的招聘者。我们在两个包含 10 和 32 个模型的候选池中进行了广泛实验，部署于四种模型协作算法，并在数学、编程、问答和推理等任务上进行评估。结果表明，成功的选择算法在所有设置中均显著优于随机或基于启发式的方法（如仅选择个体表现最优的模型），性能提升最高达 36.1%。具体而言，基于能力和训练策略的选择方法有效缓解了选择方差，取得了最佳性能，我们建议在实际部署多 LLM 系统前采用此类策略。进一步分析显示，更大的候选池对浅层选择启发式构成更大挑战，而基于与候选模型交互并理解模型能力的算法能稳健过滤不匹配、不安全的模型，并泛化至新颖的、分布外的任务。综上所述，我们确立了有原则且知情的团队选择至关重要，并提出了强大的模型选择算法，用于构建高效的多 LLM 系统。

summary: Terminal agents rely on self-verification to assess and correct their solutions as they solve tasks through interaction with command-line environments. Yet how trustworthy such self-verification is remains poorly understood. To investigate this question systematically, we introduce a diagnostic framework that identifies the first complete solution in each trajectory, determines whether it is objectively correct, and uses this ground truth to quantify the agent's subsequent verification and recovery behavior. Applying it to ten terminal agents on TerminalBench2.1, we find that verification is nearly universal after a complete candidate is formed, yet only 61.43\% of incorrect candidates are detected and only 49.36\% of detected errors are successfully repaired. These results show that the main weakness in self-verification lies not in initiating verification, but in detecting and repairing errors. Motivated by these findings, we propose Student-Conditioned Verification Distillation (SCVD), which lets the student first produce a candidate solution and distills a stronger teacher's subsequent verification and recovery from the same interaction context. Across three Qwen3.5 backbones, SCVD improves \textsc{Pass@1} on TerminalBench2.1 by 9.74--16.85 percentage points over the corresponding base models and by 4.49--8.61 points over the standard full-trajectory distillation, while avoiding the pronounced out-of-distribution degradation of full-trajectory distillation on SWE-bench Verified.
title: Can Terminal Agents Trust Their Own Verification? Diagnosing and Improving Self-Verification
title_translated: 终端智能体能信任自己的验证吗？诊断与改进自我验证
summary_translated: 终端智能体依赖自我验证来评估并修正其在命令行环境交互中解决任务时的解决方案。然而，这种自我验证的可信度仍不明确。为系统性地研究这一问题，我们引入了一种诊断框架，该框架识别每条轨迹中的首个完整解，并判断其是否客观正确，利用此真实情况量化智能体后续的验证与恢复行为。在TerminalBench2.1上的十种终端智能体上应用该框架后发现，一旦形成候选解，几乎都会进行验证，但仅有61.43%的错误候选被检测到，且仅49.36%的检测到的错误得以成功修复。结果表明，自我验证的主要弱点不在于启动验证，而在于错误的检测与修复。基于此发现，我们提出学生条件验证蒸馏（SCVD），让学生首先生成候选解，并从相同交互上下文中蒸馏出更强教师的后续验证与恢复能力。在三个Qwen3.5骨干模型上，SCVD在TerminalBench2.1上的Pass@1指标相比对应基线模型提升9.74–16.85个百分点，相比标准全轨迹蒸馏提升4.49–8.61个百分点，同时避免了全轨迹蒸馏在SWE-bench Verified上的显著分布外退化。

summary: Large language models deployed as personalized assistants must reason over long, evolving interaction histories. However, in long-term dialogue reasoning, relevant evidence is scattered across sessions, preferences may be revised over time, and standard long-context training fails to address these challenges under data scarcity and prohibitive computational costs. We propose StateTree, a data-driven RL method that constructs a challenging auxiliary task from scarce dialogues with verifiable ground truth. StateTree augments multi-session dialogues with a tree-structured path-tracing task: key-value records are embedded across sessions to form a binary tree. Solving the task requires the model to traverse from root to leaf by retrieving records across sessions and comparing timestamps to resolve branches, then recover the hidden target question among distractor leaves. We apply curriculum RL training progressively increasing tree depth and introduce a compositional variant whose edges carry step-level reasoning fragments, training the model to compose partial cues into coherent queries. Trained on 10K-token contexts, StateTree generalizes to 128K tokens without full-length RL costs and exhibits capabilities including cross-session retrieval, temporal reasoning, knowledge update, and compositional multi-hop reasoning. StateTree outperforms both SFT and RL-based baselines while preserving short-context general reasoning. StateTree-7B achieves gains up to +23.60% on LongMemEval (128k), and StateTree-14B reaches 59.00% accuracy on LongMemEval, surpassing QwenLong-L1-32B (45.20%).
title: StateTree: Enhancing Long-Term Dialogue Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: StateTree：通过强化学习增强长期对话推理
summary_translated: 作为个性化助手部署的大语言模型必须对长期、动态演变的交互历史进行推理。然而，在长期对话推理中，相关证据分散于多个会话中，偏好可能随时间变化，而标准的长上下文训练在数据稀缺和计算成本高昂的情况下难以应对这些挑战。我们提出StateTree，一种数据驱动的强化学习方法，从稀疏对话中构建具有可验证真实答案的挑战性辅助任务。StateTree通过树状路径追踪任务增强多会话对话：将关键值记录跨会话嵌入形成二叉树。解决该任务需要模型通过跨会话检索记录并比较时间戳以解析分支，最终从干扰叶节点中恢复隐藏的目标问题。我们采用课程式强化学习逐步增加树的深度，并引入一种组合变体，其边携带步骤级推理片段，训练模型将部分线索组合成连贯查询。在10K-token上下文上训练后，StateTree可泛化至128K token而无需完整的强化学习开销，展现出跨会话检索、时间推理、知识更新和组合多跳推理等能力。StateTree优于SFT和基于RL的基线模型，同时保持短上下文通用推理能力。StateTree-7B在LongMemEval（128k）上最高提升23.60%，StateTree-14B在LongMemEval上达到59.00%准确率，超过QwenLong-L1-32B（45.20%）。

summary: Uncontrolled repetition can prolong autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) and enable resource consumption attacks. Prior analyses of repetitive generation have identified strongly activated features in intermediate and late layers. However, how uncontrolled repetition activity emerges and develops before becoming prominent in these layers remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate this question primarily in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which support a richer set of uncontrolled repetitions through both visual and textual inputs. We propose Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC), a method that identifies and localizes anomalies associated with repetition from residual dynamics during generation. TRC compares attention and multilayer perceptron writes to the residual stream across generated tokens to identify patterns associated with repetition. It then selectively suppresses coordinates in the residual stream at the identified layer. Experiments show that TRC effectively mitigates uncontrolled repetition, reducing loop rates by 57\% on average. Our analysis further shows that repetition semantics emerge in shallow layers and propagate through the residual stream, disrupting normal representations. TRC also generalizes to large language models (LLMs) and large reasoning models (LRMs), where it consistently captures analogous repetition dynamics and achieves effective mitigation. Our work broadens the study of repetitive generation from its prominent internal representations to earlier opportunities for intervention, providing insights for mitigating resource consumption attacks.
title: Uncovering Uncontrolled Repetition through Residual Stream Dynamics
title_translated: 通过残差流动态揭示不受控重复
summary_translated: 不受控重复会延长大语言模型（LLMs）的自回归生成过程，并可能引发资源消耗攻击。以往对重复生成的分析已识别出中间层和晚期层中强烈激活的特征。然而，这些层中显著出现的重复活动之前是如何产生和发展仍缺乏充分理解。本文主要在支持通过视觉和文本输入实现更丰富不受控重复的大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中研究这一问题。我们提出逐标记残差比较（TRC）方法，通过生成过程中的残差流动态识别并定位与重复相关的异常。TRC比较生成标记间注意力和多层感知机对残差流的写入，以识别与重复相关的模式，随后选择性抑制所识别层中的残差流坐标。实验表明，TRC有效缓解了不受控重复，平均降低循环率57%。进一步分析显示，重复语义在浅层即已出现，并通过残差流传播，破坏正常表示。TRC也适用于大语言模型（LLMs）和大推理模型（LRMs），在其中持续捕捉类似的重复动态并实现有效缓解。本工作将重复生成的研究从其显著的内部表征扩展到更早的干预机会，为缓解资源消耗攻击提供了新见解。

summary: Understanding multi-perspective alternative narratives requires identifying how their information agrees, conflicts, or differs across sources. Existing work on cross-text relations largely focuses on categorizing relations between predefined text pairs, such as entailment or contradiction, rather than directly extracting such information from full narratives. To address this gap, we introduce Overlap-Unique-Conflict (OUC) extraction, a cross-narrative task that extracts all overlapping, conflicting, and unique clauses from two narratives. To support this study, we construct a benchmark of approximately 22K narrative pairs and 140K OUC instances spanning factual, argumentative, and political discourse. Evaluating 14 open-source LLMs (0.6B-35B), we find that unique information is far easier to extract than overlap and conflict: the strongest model, Gemma-4-31B, reaches only 61.13% F1-score on overlap and 48.58% on conflict, against more than 75% on unique. Further diagnostic analysis reveals that this difficulty does not stem from relation recognition alone, but rather from a failure to pair and extract the corresponding clauses from full narratives, especially in smaller models. Nevertheless, learning these extractions with task-specific supervision narrows the gap considerably: a fine-tuned Qwen-3-8B gains 15-28% absolute over its baseline and surpasses models roughly four times its size (e.g., Qwen-3.6-35B) on several tasks. Even so, overlap and conflict remain well below satisfactory, leaving cross-narrative clause extraction an open challenge.
title: Overlap, Unique and Conflict: Can LLMs Extract What They Can Recognize?
title_translated: 重叠、唯一与冲突：大语言模型能否提取它们能识别的内容？
summary_translated: 理解多视角替代叙事需要识别不同来源间信息的重叠、冲突或差异。现有跨文本关系研究大多聚焦于预定义文本对之间的关系分类，如蕴含或矛盾，而非直接从完整叙事中提取此类信息。为填补这一空白，我们引入重叠-唯一-冲突（OUC）提取任务，从两个叙事中提取所有重叠、冲突和唯一的子句。为支持此项研究，我们构建了一个约22,000个叙事对和14万个OUC实例的基准数据集，涵盖事实性、论辩性和政治性话语。评估14个开源大语言模型（0.6B–35B）后发现，唯一信息的提取远比重叠和冲突容易：最强模型Gemma-4-31B在重叠上的F1得分为61.13%，冲突为48.58%，而唯一信息则超过75%。进一步诊断分析表明，这种困难并非仅源于关系识别，而是由于无法配对并从完整叙事中提取相应子句，尤其在小型模型中更为明显。然而，通过特定任务监督进行学习可显著缩小差距：微调后的Qwen-3-8B在多个任务上绝对提升15–28%，甚至超越约四倍大小的模型（如Qwen-3.6-35B）。即便如此，重叠和冲突的性能仍远未达到满意水平，表明跨叙事子句提取仍是开放挑战。

summary: Block drafters for speculative decoding are commonly trained on corpora written by external models, where a single off-policy token invalidates supervision for all subsequent slots in a block. Existing approaches discard these divergent slots, resulting in severe supervision loss. To resolve this problem while preserving the training corpus, we propose a rollout-based training framework that recovers full supervision through two complementary components. The first component, Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR), replaces corpus labels with distributions from greedy target rollouts, restoring valid supervision across all predicted slots. The second component, In-Rollout Anchors (IRA), places draft blocks directly inside these rollouts to expose the drafter to target-generated context, reusing precomputed rollout features at no additional target cost. Across fixed vision-language and text corpora, our framework increases greedy accepted length by up to 36.5% over DFlash and consistently outperforms erasing baselines. Notably, a single epoch of our method surpasses the best erase schedules. After three epochs, it matches the acceptance length of training on target-regenerated responses. These results show that our framework provides an effective and compute-efficient approach for training speculative drafters on fixed corpora without modifying the original text. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ALR-IRA.
title: Recovering Off-Policy Supervision for Speculative Decoding
title_translated: 恢复非策略监督以用于推测解码
summary_translated: 推测解码中的块草稿器通常在外部模型生成的语料库上训练，其中单个非策略标记会导致整个块中所有后续槽位的监督失效。现有方法丢弃这些分歧槽位，导致严重监督损失。为在保留原始训练语料库的同时解决此问题，我们提出一种基于回放的训练框架，通过两个互补组件恢复完整监督。第一个组件——锚点标签重标注（ALR），用贪婪目标回放生成的分布替换语料库标签，从而在所有预测槽位恢复有效监督。第二个组件——回放内锚点（IRA），将草稿块直接置于这些回放中，使草稿器暴露于目标生成的上下文，复用预先计算的回放特征而无需额外目标开销。在固定视觉语言和文本语料库上，我们的框架使贪婪接受长度相比DFlash提升高达36.5%，并始终优于擦除基线。值得注意的是，单个训练周期的效果即超过最佳擦除调度方案。经过三个周期后，其接受长度达到在目标重生成响应上训练的水平。结果表明，该框架为在固定语料库上训练推测草稿器提供了一种高效且计算节省的方法，无需修改原始文本。代码已公开于 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ALR-IRA。

summary: We study training LLM judges from natural language feedback, especially for subjective tasks where the verdict depends strongly on which evaluation criteria the judge invokes and how it weighs them. The dominant approach, outcome-supervised RL (e.g., GRPO), credits every token in the rollout with a single scalar determined only by the accuracy of the final verdict, providing no separate credit at the criterion-choice tokens and ignoring the rich language feedback (e.g., preference rationales) that naturally accompanies preference labels. Self-Distillation (SD) is one natural way to use this language feedback: the same model, conditioned on this feedback, acts as a teacher providing dense, position-level supervision. However, not all positions carry equally useful signal. Using the per-position entropy shift between teacher and student, we identify two regimes: context sharpening, where the teacher concentrates probability on a particular feedback-aligned criterion expression, and context spreading, where the teacher distributes probability across multiple feedback-aligned alternatives. We interpret these patterns as follows: sharpening encourages memorization of a particular criterion expression, whereas spreading promotes semantic understanding by preserving these alternatives. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce position masking based on the entropy shift that retains the lower tail of the entropy-shift distribution. Experiments show that masking higher-entropy-shift positions improves out-of-distribution generalization over naive SD. The resulting self-distilled judges outperform judges trained with outcome-supervised RL by 2-9 percentage points on the evaluated subjective subcategories, while remaining competitive on objective ones.
title: Training LLM Judges from Language Feedback via Position-Selective Self-Distillation
title_translated: 通过位置选择性自蒸馏从语言反馈中训练大语言模型裁判
summary_translated: 我们研究了从自然语言反馈中训练大语言模型裁判的方法，尤其针对主观任务，其中判断结果强烈依赖于裁判所采用的评估标准及其权重。主流方法（如基于结果监督的强化学习，例如GRPO）将回放过程中每个标记的贡献归因于一个仅由最终判断准确率决定的标量，无法对标准选择标记给予单独评价，并忽略了伴随偏好标签出现的丰富语言反馈（如偏好理由）。自蒸馏（SD）是一种自然利用这些语言反馈的方式：同一模型在反馈条件下作为教师，提供密集的位置级监督。然而，并非所有位置都携带等效信息。通过分析教师与学生之间各位置的熵变化，我们识别出两种模式：上下文锐化（教师集中概率于特定反馈对齐的标准表达）和上下文扩散（教师在多个反馈对齐的替代方案间分配概率）。我们解释为：锐化促进对特定标准表达的记忆，而扩散则通过保留多种替代方案促进语义理解。受此不对称性的启发，我们引入基于熵变化的位点掩码策略，保留熵变化分布的低尾部分。实验表明，掩码高熵变化位置可提升模型在分布外场景下的泛化能力。经自蒸馏训练的裁判在评估的主观子类别上比基于结果监督强化学习训练的裁判表现高出2-9个百分点，同时在客观任务上仍保持竞争力。

summary: Steering large language models typically relies on linear, context-independent interventions in activation space, an assumption that recent work has challenged and that can induce an information bottleneck when a fixed representation must encode many behavioral distinctions. We introduce MetaSteer, a method that learns nonlinear interventions with context-dependent effects and applies them to attention projection matrices, producing activation effects that vary with the input context by construction and requiring no linear concept-geometry assumption. Framed as preference-based optimization, MetaSteer is trained once on a pooled preference corpus and transferred zero-shot to unseen concepts and out-of-distribution contexts. We find that, despite using low-rank adapters, MetaSteer induces structured, context-dependent changes in hidden-state trajectories while partially preserving aspects of their local trajectory dynamics, including velocity and curvature. We evaluate MetaSteer on three controlled text-generation benchmarks and three agentic settings across multiple model families and scales. MetaSteer matches or outperforms strong task-specific steering baselines on most aggregate comparisons in the zero-shot regime. Across the evaluated settings, stronger text-generation steering is associated with stronger agentic steering performance. We further discuss geometric trajectory effects, capability retention, and safety considerations raised by transferable steering.
title: MetaSteer: Context-Conditioned, nonlinear Steering via Attention-Projection Adaptation
comment: Preprint. Code and pretrained model checkpoints will be released shortly
title_translated: MetaSteer：通过注意力投影适配实现上下文条件化的非线性引导
summary_translated: 通常的大型语言模型引导方法依赖于激活空间中的线性、上下文无关干预，这一假设近期受到挑战，且当固定表征需编码多种行为差异时可能引发信息瓶颈。我们提出MetaSteer，一种学习具有上下文依赖效应的非线性干预的方法，将其应用于注意力投影矩阵，从而在构造上使激活效果随输入上下文变化，并无需依赖线性概念几何假设。以基于偏好的优化框架进行训练，MetaSteer在合并的偏好语料库上一次性训练后，即可零样本迁移至未见概念和分布外上下文。尽管使用低秩适配器，MetaSteer仍能诱导隐藏状态轨迹中结构化的、上下文相关的改变，同时部分保留其局部轨迹动态特性（如速度和曲率）。我们在三个受控文本生成基准和跨多个模型家族与规模的三个代理设置中评估MetaSteer。在零样本设定下，MetaSteer在多数聚合比较中表现匹配或优于强任务特定引导基线。在评估设置中，更强的文本生成引导能力与更强的代理引导性能相关。我们进一步讨论了轨迹的几何效应、能力保留以及可转移引导带来的安全考量。

summary: Long-form subtitle translation requires reasoning over discourse and cultural context spanning episodes or entire series, while maintaining consistent terminology and style. Existing single-LLM methods are largely sentence-level, and multi-agent systems often use static workflows that do not adapt to scene complexity or production context. We propose SMART, a Self-evolving Multi-Agent system for long-foRm subtitle Translation. During test-time training, SMART builds persistent series-level memory and translates a subset of sentences through a dynamic router and Mixture-of-Agents layer with tools for terminology verification, subtitle constraint validation, and contextual retrieval. A judge-refiner loop scores candidates and uses textual critiques to update agent prompts and routing policies without retraining the underlying LLMs. During test-time inference, the evolved configuration translates the remaining series. We also introduce Subtitle Arena, covering 14 genres, 2--198 episodes per series, production years 1959--2023, and 15 target locales, together with SubMQM, a subtitle-adapted MQM framework with seven dimensions and 19 error categories. SMART achieves the best overall MQM score in all 15 Subtitle Arena directions, reducing average penalty by 6.9% over the strongest competing agent system. On the public MuSC benchmark, SMART obtains the best model result across all four language pairs and also achieves the best human-evaluation result, with an overall score of 4.50/5.
title: Breaking Babel: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Long-Form Subtitle Translation
title_translated: 打破巴别塔：用于长篇字幕翻译的自演化多智能体系统
summary_translated: 长篇字幕翻译需要对跨越剧集甚至整部系列的语篇和文化背景进行推理，同时保持术语和风格的一致性。现有单大模型方法大多局限于句子级别，而多智能体系统常采用静态工作流，无法适应场景复杂度或制作上下文。我们提出SMART——一种用于长篇字幕翻译的自演化多智能体系统。在测试时训练阶段，SMART构建持久的系列级记忆，通过动态路由器和混合智能体层翻译部分句子，配备术语验证、字幕约束校验和上下文检索工具。一个裁判-优化循环对候选结果评分，并利用文本批评更新智能体提示和路由策略，无需重新训练底层大模型。在测试时推理阶段，演化后的配置完成剩余系列的翻译。我们还引入Subtitle Arena，涵盖14种类型、每部系列2–198集、制作年份1959–2023、15个目标语境，以及SubMQM——一种适配字幕的MQM框架，包含七个维度和19个错误类别。SMART在Subtitle Arena所有15个方向上均取得最佳整体MQM得分，平均惩罚降低6.9%。在公开的MuSC基准上，SMART在所有四个语言对中取得最佳模型结果，并在人类评估中获得最高分（4.50/5）。

summary: Privacy redaction must remove personal information while preserving relationships expressed in text. We develop a multilingual named-entity tagger with fine-grained distinctions supporting varied redaction policies and methods for cheaply learning additional distinctions. We fine-tune a multilingual encoder with an affine span-tagging head on frontier-model annotations in 35 languages, replay mapped human gold with coverage-aware masking so unannotated types are not treated as negatives, and repair subword boundaries with a learned +/-1-character adjustment. On 1,283 human-gold test segments in seven languages, best measured redaction F1 is 88.8, against 69.1 for published GLiNER2 with 11 unrepresentable types excluded from its task (68.8 without that exemption), 67.8 for GLiNER2 adapted to the new training data, 57.3 for Microsoft Presidio and 35.8 for the best published OpenAI Privacy Filter fine-tune. Adding about 50,000 annotated training sentences and increasing human-gold replay improves exact typed-span F1 from 74.5 to 76.3 on Ont3, our 31-type frontier-annotated NER evaluation of 1,201 development segments. Mapped-gold replay alone raises human-gold F1 by ten points without loss on frontier-annotated text; boundary adjustment adds 1.7 exact typed-span F1 points on Ont3. Local LLMs fitting on a single 96-GB GPU underperformed as prompted annotators and frozen encoders, with encoding 30-95 times slower than XLM-R inference and prompted annotation roughly 180-1,100 times slower in the evaluated configurations. The encoder architecture delivers 4.9 times GLiNER2's CPU throughput. We release code, prompts and training recipes, with data-acquisition scripts and source links.
title: Strong Multilingual Privacy Tagging at Encoder Speed
comment: 46 pages, 23 figures. Includes supplementary appendices. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026 cycle
title_translated: 以编码器速度实现强大的多语言隐私标记
summary_translated: 隐私去标识必须移除个人信息，同时保留文本中表达的关系。我们开发了一种支持细粒度区分的多语言命名实体标记器，适用于不同去标识策略，并提出了低成本学习额外区分的方法。我们在35种语言的前沿模型标注数据上微调一个多语言编码器，采用仿射跨度标记头，通过覆盖感知掩码重播映射的人工黄金数据，避免未标注类型被误当作负例，并通过学习的±1字符调整修复子词边界。在七种语言的1,283个人工黄金测试片段上，最佳测量的去标识F1得分为88.8，远超已发表的GLiNER2（排除11种不可表示类型后为69.1，不含该豁免为68.8），GLiNER2在新训练数据上的适配版本为67.8，Microsoft Presidio为57.3，最佳公开OpenAI隐私过滤器微调版本为35.8。增加约5万条标注训练句并提升人工黄金数据重播，使Ont3（我们31类前沿标注NER评估，含1,201个开发片段）的精确类型跨度F1从74.5提升至76.3。仅使用映射黄金重播即提升人工黄金F1达十个百分点，且不损失前沿标注文本表现；边界调整在Ont3上额外提升1.7个精确类型跨度F1点。本地大模型在单个96GB GPU上运行的表现不如提示标注者和冻结编码器，编码速度比XLM-R慢30-95倍，提示标注则慢180-1,100倍。编码器架构的CPU吞吐量是GLiNER2的4.9倍。我们发布了代码、提示和训练配方，以及数据获取脚本和源链接。

summary: Yorùbá is a tonal language in which contour tones pose persistent orthographic challenges. These are especially notable for personal names and lexical items whose conventional spellings avoid vowel lengthening that would otherwise provide a host syllable for the second tone. A particular concern is a class of names in which the conventional spelling does not just omit tonal information but inverts the meaning of said name, sometimes asserting the opposite of what the name intends. This paper describes the problem, illustrates the inadequacy of current solutions, and proposes the adoption of the caron and circumflex marks. These are symbols with precedent in Yorùbá phonological scholarship since Olmsted (1951), used as orthographic conventions on single vowels to encode rising and falling contour tones, making them accessible for the first time through standard keyboard input and computational text processing. The proposal is supported by an implementation in the WriteYoruba keyboard and the TTSYoruba speech synthesizer, whose architecture and listener evaluation are reported separately (Tubosun et al., 2026).
title: Marking Contour Tones in Yorùbá
comment: Under review at the 12th World Congress of African Linguistics (WOCAL 12)
title_translated: 在约鲁巴语中标记轮廓音调
summary_translated: 约鲁巴语是一种声调语言，其中轮廓音调带来持续的正字法挑战。这在人名和词汇项中尤为显著，其传统拼写避免元音延长，否则会为第二个音调提供宿主音节。一个特别问题是某些名字的传统拼写不仅省略音调信息，甚至反转名称含义，有时表达与原意相反的内容。本文描述了该问题，展示了现有解决方案的不足，并提议采用锐符（caron）和 circumflex 符号。这些符号在约鲁巴语语音学研究中已有先例（自Olmsted, 1951年起），作为单个元音上的正字法惯例，用于编码升调和降调轮廓音调，首次使这些音调可通过标准键盘输入和计算文本处理实现。该提议得到了WriteYoruba键盘和TTSYoruba语音合成器实现的支持，其架构和听觉评估结果另文报告（Tubosun et al., 2026）。

summary: As natural language drives more applications, language models increasingly run inside programs as decision components: the program sends them the current state and acts on the returned decision until a newer one arrives. When evidence changes during inference, a decision correct for its own state can stay in force after that state has passed, as when a call recorder keeps running after a customer starts reading out a card number; untimed (offline) accuracy counts such an error as correct. We introduce StreamDecisionBench (SDB), which evaluates the decision in force at every instant and attributes every erroneous instant to judgment, latency or both. Its scenarios stream evidence in four application families, with reference decisions computed from public rules by executable code. We summarize in-force accuracy across update intervals of 1-5 s by its normalized area under the curve on a logarithmic time axis, giving equal weight to equal multiplicative ranges. Across six settings of four hosted models, this score stays within 2.9 points of the scenario-wise product of untimed accuracy and an oracle's integrated timing score. Reasoning improves judgment, but at low effort latency costs Luna and Terra, two GPT models we also evaluate without reasoning, 38.8 and 42.8 points relative to untimed accuracy; a faster component with weaker judgment attains a similar integrated score to Terra without reasoning. The aggregate and family curves show where these tradeoffs change, making the evaluation's time-scale dependence visible.
title: StreamDecisionBench: Evaluating Decisions in Force on Evolving Language Streams
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: StreamDecisionBench：评估动态语言流中的决策
summary_translated: 随着自然语言驱动更多应用，语言模型越来越多地作为决策组件嵌入程序中：程序发送当前状态给模型，并根据返回的决策执行动作，直到新决策到来。当推理过程中证据发生变化时，针对旧状态正确的决策可能在状态已过期后仍持续生效，例如通话录音在客户开始读取卡号后仍继续运行；这种情况下，非定时（离线）准确率会将此类错误视为正确。我们提出StreamDecisionBench（SDB），用于评估每一时刻在执行中的决策，并将每个错误时刻归因于判断力或延迟，或两者兼有。其场景以四种应用类别流式输入证据，参考决策通过可执行代码从公开规则计算得出。我们通过在对数时间轴上计算归一化曲线下面积，总结1-5秒更新间隔内的在役准确率，使相等的乘法范围获得同等权重。在四个托管模型的六个设置中，该得分与场景级的非定时准确率和理想模型集成时间得分的乘积相差不超过2.9分。推理提升了判断力，但代价是延迟成本：Luna和Terra两个GPT模型在无推理情况下分别比非定时准确率低38.8和42.8分；一个更快但判断力较弱的组件在无推理情况下也能达到与Terra相似的综合得分。聚合曲线和类别曲线揭示了这些权衡的变化点，使评估的时间尺度依赖性变得清晰。

summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly tackle complex tasks through interactive, long-horizon exchanges with users, while existing benchmarks generally assume that users always accurately and sufficiently communicate a fixed intent. However, this oracle communication assumption rarely holds in practice: users may miscommunicate, change their goals, and run out of patience. We define this task setting as Interactive Intent Alignment, where agents must recover and continuously track the user's current intent despite imperfect communication and evolving goals. To study this setting, we introduce Drift-Bench++, a principled benchmark construction pipeline for verified executable tasks with controlled misalignment and intent shifts, along with an interaction protocol featuring finite patience, diverse simulated users, and silent interaction-conditioned shifts. We further develop GRIP, a comprehensive evaluation protocol covering task grounding, user realism, inquiry effectiveness, and adaptation to evolving intent. Across diverse environments, models, and interaction conditions, stronger interaction consistently helps but remains far from oracle performance; Validation on deployed ProdAgent sessions further shows that the modeled failures are prevalent and consequential in deployment. By providing a unified, executable benchmark for interactive intent alignment, Drift-Bench++ offers a foundation for evaluating and advancing agents under realistic communication and evolving intent.
title: Beyond Oracle Communication: Benchmarking Interactive Intent Alignment Under Miscommunication and Evolving User Intent
title_translated: 超越理想通信：在误传与用户意图演变下的交互意图对齐基准测试
summary_translated: 现代大语言模型代理越来越多地通过与用户进行交互式、长周期的交流来完成复杂任务，而现有基准通常假设用户始终能准确且充分地传达固定意图。然而，这一理想通信假设在实践中很少成立：用户可能沟通失误、目标发生变化，或失去耐心。我们将此任务设定定义为交互意图对齐，要求代理在存在不完美沟通和不断变化的目标的情况下，持续恢复并追踪用户的当前意图。为研究这一设定，我们引入Drift-Bench++，一种基于可验证可执行任务、可控对齐偏差和意图漂移的基准构建流程，以及包含有限耐心、多样化模拟用户和静默交互条件下的意图变化的交互协议。我们进一步开发GRIP，一个涵盖任务基础、用户真实性、提问有效性及适应意图演变的全面评估协议。在多种环境、模型和交互条件下，更强的交互能力始终有益，但仍远未达到理想性能；对部署的ProdAgent会话的验证表明，建模中的失败在实际部署中普遍存在且后果严重。通过提供一个统一、可执行的交互意图对齐基准，Drift-Bench++为在真实通信和动态意图下评估和推进智能体奠定了基础。

summary: Skills are external artifacts that Large Language Models (LLMs) consume at inference time to improve their performance on specialized domains by incorporating relevant procedural and domain knowledge. Expert-authored skills are expensive to produce, and the resulting artifacts are not optimized for the specific model that consumes them, whose failure modes can vary with version, scale and training. In addition, emerging tasks may fall outside the scope of existing skill libraries, creating a need to develop new skills before curated training data become available. Recent works have explored automated skill optimization through reflection, but they require a curated, in-distribution training set, which users might not always have. To address these limitations, we present Prompt2Skill, a framework that builds skills from natural-language task description alone. From the prompt, the system derives a task specification, discovers or synthesizes datasets, and refines the skill in a closed loop of reflective editing. Across four domains spanning question answering, reading comprehension, spreadsheet manipulation, and mathematical reasoning, Prompt2Skill consistently outperforms the direct prompting baseline, achieving an average improvement of 10.8 across open-source and frontier models.
title: Prompt2Skill: Unsupervised Skill Optimization From Natural Language Instructions
title_translated: Prompt2Skill：从自然语言指令中无监督优化技能
summary_translated: 技能是大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理时消耗的外部工具，通过整合相关程序性知识和领域知识来提升其在特定领域的表现。专家编写的技能成本高昂，且生成的成果并未针对具体使用模型进行优化，而不同版本、规模和训练方式的模型其失效模式也各不相同。此外，新兴任务可能超出现有技能库的范围，导致在有精选训练数据之前必须先开发新技能。近期工作探索了通过反思实现自动化技能优化，但需要精心筛选的分布内训练集，而用户未必总能获取。为解决这些局限，我们提出Prompt2Skill框架，仅基于自然语言任务描述构建技能。系统从提示中推导出任务规范，发现或合成数据集，并在反思编辑的闭环中不断优化技能。在涵盖问答、阅读理解、电子表格操作和数学推理四个领域的实验中，Prompt2Skill始终优于直接提示基线，在开源和前沿模型上平均提升10.8分。

summary: Constantly evolving real-world knowledge necessitates models to be updated continuously. Especially in medicine, as clinical evidence changes over time, outdated knowledge can pose safety risks. Existing evaluations of knowledge integration focus on factual recall, offering limited insight into whether newly integrated knowledge is actually usable. Our benchmark MedKIT (Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer) provides a granular evaluation of how models integrate and apply knowledge under realistic sequences of clinical updates. Each instance corresponds to a factual update derived from clinical evidence, paired with targeted probes that assess transfer across lexical variation, relational transformations, compositional reasoning, and open-ended operationalization, as well as locality tests for knowledge preservation. Using MedKIT, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 knowledge integration strategies across 5 diverse models, including both general-purpose and medical LLMs. Our results reveal a consistent gap between recall and usable knowledge: while most methods achieve strong gains on the original update task and under lexical variation, relational generalization is limited, and no method yields meaningful improvements on compositional or operational tasks. These findings highlight a fundamental challenge in knowledge integration and position MedKIT as a testbed for developing methods that make newly integrated knowledge more consistently usable across tasks and contexts.
title: MedKIT: Evaluating Knowledge Integration and Generalization in Large Language Models
title_translated: MedKIT：评估大语言模型中的知识整合与泛化能力
summary_translated: 不断演进的真实世界知识要求模型持续更新。特别是在医学领域，随着临床证据随时间变化，过时的知识可能带来安全风险。现有知识整合评估主要关注事实回忆，难以揭示新整合知识是否真正可用。我们的基准MedKIT（医学知识整合与迁移）提供了对模型在真实临床更新序列下如何整合和应用知识的细粒度评估。每个实例对应一个源自临床证据的事实更新，配以针对性探测，评估跨词汇变异、关系变换、组合推理、开放式操作化以及知识保留的局部性测试。利用MedKIT，我们对12种知识整合策略在5种不同模型（包括通用和医学专用LLM）上进行了大规模实证研究。结果揭示了回忆与可用知识之间的一致性差距：尽管大多数方法在原始更新任务和词汇变异下取得显著提升，但关系泛化能力有限，且无任何方法在组合或操作任务上带来有意义的改进。这些发现凸显了知识整合中的根本挑战，并将MedKIT定位为开发使新整合知识在各类任务和情境中更一致可用的方法的试验平台。

summary: Language models increasingly use architectures that vary attention span and positional encoding across layers, such as applying RoPE with sliding-window attention and NoPE with global attention (SWA NoPE). However, how these choices shape in-context retrieval remains unclear. To study this question, we take a mechanistic view, tracing how positional encoding (PE) choice shapes the internal mechanisms models use for in-context retrieval. Across 22 open-weight models spanning eight families, we find that standard RoPE models rely primarily on positional retrieval, while PE hybrids shift toward semantic retrieval. We further show on a controlled pre-training ablation that confining positional encoding to local layers produces this semantic shift, degrading representations of positional information. Finally, we show that the reported long-context gains of PE hybrids mask a retrieval trade-off: SWA NoPE improves over RoPE on multiple-target retrieval and QA, but degrades when distinguishing competing keys. We show that these behavioral differences better track the mechanism shift from positional toward semantic mechanisms than a uniform improvement in long-context retrieval.
title: Shifting Mechanisms: How Positional Encoding Choice Shapes In-Context Retrieval
title_translated: 机制转变：位置编码选择如何塑造上下文检索行为
summary_translated: 语言模型越来越多地采用在不同层间变化注意力跨度和位置编码的架构，例如在滑动窗口注意力中使用RoPE，而在全局注意力中使用NoPE（SWA NoPE）。然而，这些选择如何影响上下文检索机制尚不明确。为研究这一问题，我们采取机制视角，追踪位置编码（PE）选择如何塑造模型内部用于上下文检索的机制。在涵盖八个模型家族的22个开源权重模型中，我们发现标准RoPE模型主要依赖位置检索，而PE混合模型则转向语义检索。我们进一步通过受控预训练消融实验表明，将位置编码限制在局部层会导致这种语义转变，同时削弱位置信息的表征能力。最后，我们发现PE混合模型报告的长上下文优势掩盖了检索权衡：SWA NoPE在多目标检索和问答任务上优于RoPE，但在区分竞争性键值时表现下降。这些行为差异更准确地反映了从位置机制向语义机制的转变，而非对长上下文检索的统一提升。

summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive LLMs by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce drafting latency by proposing multiple tokens at once. However, these tokens are predicted independently, so a single early error causes prefix verification to discard the rest of the draft, even when it contains useful downstream predictions. We introduce DEdit, a diffusion-based drafter that can not only draft by conventional parallel unmasking but also iteratively edit its draft through token-to-token predictions. Through editing, later predictions can serve as bidirectional context for repairing earlier errors and extending the accepted prefix. To teach the model to repair errors while preserving correct predictions, we propose ProposalMix, a training scheme that mixes draft predictions with ground-truth tokens based on first-pass confidence during training. Across seven benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, DEdit achieves the highest macro-average token acceptance and speedup among the evaluated drafters, reaching macro-average speedups of $5.72\times$ and $5.97\times$ over autoregressive generation under greedy decoding, respectively. Further analysis shows that acceptance improves with more editing passes and wider drafting windows, and that ProposalMix halves harmful edits that shorten the accepted prefix. Moreover, restricting the editor to causal attention lowers acceptance, especially on highly predictable outputs, indicating that future context is a key source of these gains.
title: DEdit: Iterative Draft Editing for Speculative Decoding
title_translated: DEdit：用于推测解码的迭代草稿编辑
summary_translated: 推测解码通过轻量级草稿模型并行提出token，由目标模型验证以加速自回归大语言模型。基于扩散的草稿模型通过一次性提出多个token进一步降低了草稿延迟。然而，这些token是独立预测的，单个早期错误就会导致前缀验证失败，即使后续包含有用的预测。我们提出了DEdit，一种基于扩散的草稿模型，不仅能通过传统的并行去掩码方式生成草稿，还能通过token-to-token预测进行迭代编辑。通过编辑，后期预测可作为双向上下文修复早期错误并扩展被接受的前缀。为在训练中教会模型修复错误同时保留正确预测，我们提出了ProposalMix训练方案，根据首次通过的置信度混合草稿预测与真实token。在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上的七个基准测试中，DEdit在所有评估草稿模型中实现了最高的宏平均token接受率和加速比，分别达到自回归生成下贪婪解码的5.72倍和5.97倍加速。进一步分析表明，接受率随编辑次数增加和草稿窗口变宽而提升，且ProposalMix将有害编辑（缩短接受前缀）减少了一半。此外，限制编辑器仅使用因果注意力会降低接受率，尤其在高度可预测输出上，表明未来上下文是这些性能提升的关键来源。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that reason over clinical records must track changes in a patient's state while preserving the history needed to understand them. Simply accumulating memories leaves it unclear which information still applies, whereas overwriting earlier memories can erase evidence needed to reconstruct treatment history and clinical trajectories. We introduce STAM, a state-transition-aware memory framework that records state changes as new clinical entries arrive. STAM combines semantic retrieval with typed clinical relations to identify affected memories, maintaining current information in Active and superseded or resolved information in History. At read time, a query-dependent gate selectively serves historical memory. Across four longitudinal clinical benchmarks, we evaluate STAM with downstream question answering, direct state-maintenance diagnostics, and comparisons at approximately matched context lengths.
title: Personalized State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical Agents
title_translated: 面向临床智能体的个性化状态转移感知记忆
summary_translated: 能够推理临床记录的大语言模型（LLM）智能体必须跟踪患者状态的变化，同时保留理解所需的历史信息。简单地累积记忆会导致难以判断哪些信息仍适用；而过度覆盖早期记忆则可能抹去重建治疗史和临床轨迹所需的证据。我们提出了STAM，一种状态转移感知的记忆框架，当新的临床条目到达时记录状态变化。STAM结合语义检索与类型化临床关系来识别受影响的记忆，将当前信息保留在活跃区，已过期或已解决的信息存入历史区。在读取时，查询依赖的门控机制选择性地提供历史记忆。我们在四个纵向临床基准上评估了STAM，涵盖下游问答、直接状态维持诊断以及在近似匹配上下文长度下的对比实验。

summary: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment.
title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy
title_translated: KlinikeBench：超越诊断准确性的语言模型评估
summary_translated: 大多数临床基准仅基于完整病历描述评估语言模型的诊断准确性。但在临床实践中，患者以不同方式呈现信息，医生必须获取相关病史并确定所需检查项目后才能做出诊断。因此，仅凭诊断准确率无法判断智能体是否收集了必要信息或进行了适当的临床评估。此外，现有基准缺乏专业临床医生的验证。为填补这一空白，我们引入KlinikeBench，一个包含333个由临床医生撰写的任务的基准，每个任务提供独立沙盒环境，包括虚拟患者、临床工具和特定任务的成功标准。超过35名临床医生参与了病例编写和基准评估。在一项实证研究中，临床医生对模拟对话的平均质量评分高于参考对话（改编自真实对话）。在每个任务中，语言模型有固定的回合预算，需与患者沟通、询问相关病史、请求检查、遵守行动约束并记录最终诊断。我们分别对这些步骤及整体表现进行评分。在31个模型和7个模型家族中，表现最佳的模型（如GPT-6-astra和Claude Opus 5）在任务中的成功率不足30%，尽管其诊断准确率高达90.7%。部分模型通过与患者交流受益，另一些模型虽从完整病历中诊断良好，但在对话中表现显著下降。总体而言，KlinikeBench为评估完整的临床交互提供了测试平台，并揭示了诊断准确率与交互式临床评估表现之间存在显著差距。

summary: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.
title: The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It
title_translated: 背景暴露了围绕智能体的世界对其造成的代价
summary_translated: 智能体基准测试通常在静态世界中进行。但实际部署的智能体工作于他人也会改变的世界中——有人发消息要求将资金转至其他地方，或订单确认要求智能体回复门禁代码。我们提出BACKDROP，旨在探究智能体在理想世界中的能力有多少能在这种动态世界中保持。BACKDROP在给定任务及其执行环境的基础上，在世界中逐一或同时植入四种日常危害：权限（他人的消息是否能覆盖用户指令？）、注入（记录中植入的文本是否会引导智能体？）、边界（请求是否会将其拉入未授权的应用程序？）、故障（写入失败但未说明是否成功，智能体是否在重试前检查？）。指令和正确终态保持不变，每种危害对应一个问题。在3,678种变体和16个模型上，当四种危害全部存在时，平均通过率从69.5%降至31.3%；最强模型降幅最大（如Claude Fable 5.1从96.6%降至56.0%）。智能体已学会抵抗注入文本，但常遵从其他未经授权的请求。在四种危害共存且植入文本传达到智能体的前提下，46.4%的运行中智能体遵循了他人消息，20.3%受到注入文本影响。该差距在所有16个模型中均一致。BACKDROP形式化了这些差距，并表明任务世界中的得分是真实世界性能的上限。

summary: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.
title: Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing
title_translated: 政策条件化的AI使用检测：学术出版中的证据框架
summary_translated: 主要学术会议和期刊现在发布了关于作者、审稿人及领域主席如何使用AI的详细规则，这些规则因角色、任务和需披露内容而异。通常提出的AI检测工具实际上衡量的是文本是否由AI模型撰写，而非是否符合规定。我们认为这一目标与会议和期刊所面临的决策不一致，因此提出政策条件化的AI使用检测，一种用于评估人类-AI协作流程是否符合既定规则的证据框架。该框架将政策明确作为输入。推理报告假设、证据、校准机制和不确定性，而非简单的“检测到AI”等结论。评估基于可复现的流水线构建合规与非合规工作流基准，并报告在预设假阳性率下的真正阳性率。我们以同行评审为例，即使在合理的违规率下，强操作点的检测器仍会标记更多合规作者而非违规者。因此，该框架也明确了会议必须实施的措施：结构化披露、尊重审稿人保密性的批准工具路由，以及可申诉的发现路径。在此框架下，检测器不是作者身份分类器，而是一种可审计的程序，其错误率由会议预先设定并可辩护。

summary: Access to real-world information is often noisy and fragmented. Constructing a coherent narrative from such fragments requires models to reconstruct missing spans within a broader storyline, commonly referred to as text infilling, while preserving consistency with both the local context and the global storyline. Despite using text infilling as a pre-training objective in many Large Language Models (LLMs), their actual performance on real-world narrative infilling remains underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a multi-domain benchmark of ~9.2K instances for narrative infilling, constructed by masking one to three sentences across four narrative types: encyclopedic text, commonsense stories, news articles, and visual narratives. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 20 instruction-tuned open-source LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters across varying levels of instruction specificity and reasoning guidance. Outputs are assessed using standard automatic metrics and a qualitative framework covering five narrative dimensions. Results show that model scale does not reliably predict infilling quality: Gemma-2-2B achieves the highest qualitative score (4.02/5), outperforming models over ten times larger, including DeepSeek-Qwen-32B (3.77/5, 6.6%) and LLaMA-3.3-70B (3.71/5, 8.3%). We further find that explicit reasoning offers limited benefits as chain-of-thought reasoning yields only a marginal improvement (+0.6%). Additionally, short narratives and domain characteristics emerge as stronger predictors of task difficulty than infill position alone for narrative infilling in current LLMs.
title: Evaluating Whether LLMs Can Reliably Connect the DOTs?
title_translated: 大语言模型能否可靠地连接碎片信息？
summary_translated: 现实世界的信息往往杂乱且碎片化。从这些片段中构建连贯的叙事需要模型重建更广泛故事线中的缺失部分，这通常被称为文本补全，同时保持与局部上下文和全局故事线的一致性。尽管许多大型语言模型（LLMs）在预训练中使用文本补全作为目标，但其在真实叙事补全任务上的实际表现仍缺乏深入研究。本文通过构建一个包含约9200个实例的多领域基准数据集，填补了这一空白，该数据集涵盖四种叙事类型：百科类文本、常识故事、新闻文章和视觉叙事，通过遮蔽其中一到三句话来生成任务。我们利用该基准评估了20个指令微调的开源LLM，参数规模从15亿到700亿不等，覆盖不同指令明确度和推理引导水平。输出通过标准自动指标和涵盖五个叙事维度的定性框架进行评估。结果表明，模型规模并不能可靠预测补全质量：Gemma-2-2B在定性评分上达到最高分（4.02/5），优于参数量超过十倍的DeepSeek-Qwen-32B（3.77/5，6.6%）和LLaMA-3.3-70B（3.71/5，8.3%）。我们还发现，显式推理带来的收益有限，链式思维推理仅带来微弱提升（+0.6%）。此外，短篇叙事和领域特征比补全位置本身更能预测当前LLMs在叙事补全任务中的难度。

summary: Representing scientific papers as points in a space lets us search for similar papers and inquire about how fields relate to one another and drive innovation. Beyond search, the vector space of papers invites generation: mixing papers through simple vector operations creates new points, mirroring combinatorial novelty, the recombination of existing ideas into new ones. However, a mixed point often represents an idea no paper has yet realized, with no papers nearby to identify the idea. We propose representing each paper by a LoRA adapter generated by the Doc-to-LoRA hypernetwork. Every point in the space, including mixtures, thus represents a large language model (LLM) open to questions and instructions in natural language. On papers from the American Physical Society (APS), we instruct the LLM at the average of each subfield to name the field in a few words and obtain labels closer to the official names than the labels of five baselines, as judged by word overlap and a panel of five LLM judges. We also ask the LLMs at points between two APS papers to write an abstract and obtain descriptions shifting from one paper to the other in step with the mixing weight. While Doc-to-LoRA is trained for generation, a small invertible transform makes the embeddings competitive for search, on par with SPECTER2 and EmbeddingGemma and close to SBERT. Because the transform is invertible, every point in the transformed space still maps back to an LLM. The embeddings thus serve both search and generation, enabling researchers to question the idea at any point in the space as a starting point for generating new ideas.
title: Doc2LoRA Provides Decodable Representations of Scientific Ideas
comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code: this https URL
title_translated: Doc2LoRA为科学思想提供可解码的表示
summary_translated: 将科学论文表示为空间中的点，使我们能够搜索相似论文，并探究各领域之间的关系及其如何推动创新。除了搜索之外，论文向量空间还支持生成：通过简单的向量运算混合论文，可以生成新点，模拟组合性创新——即现有思想的重新组合形成新思想。然而，混合点通常代表尚未有论文实现的思想，且附近没有相关论文来识别该思想。我们提出使用由Doc-to-LoRA超网络生成的LoRA适配器来表示每篇论文。空间中的每个点（包括混合点）都对应一个可接受自然语言提问和指令的大语言模型（LLM）。在来自美国物理学会（APS）的论文上，我们指导子领域平均点处的LLM用几个词命名该领域，获得的标签在词重叠和五名LLM评委评估下，比五个基线方法更接近官方名称。我们还要求位于两篇APS论文之间的点处的LLM撰写摘要，结果描述随混合权重逐步从一篇论文转向另一篇。尽管Doc-to-LoRA旨在用于生成，但一个小的可逆变换使其嵌入在搜索任务上具有竞争力，性能与SPECTER2和EmbeddingGemma相当，接近SBERT。由于变换可逆，变换空间中的每个点仍可映射回一个LLM。因此，这些嵌入既可用于搜索也可用于生成，使研究人员能够在空间中任意一点提出问题，作为生成新思想的起点。

summary: Conversational safety evaluations often test language models with a single harmful prompt, even though real-world systems interact with users through long, adaptive conversations. This study examines whether models continue to respond safely when an adversarial user persists across multiple turns. We evaluate three open-weight, instruction-tuned models on two harmful prompts across different conversation lengths and random seeds. In each setting, a second language model acts as a persistent adversarial user, while a safety classifier labels every response as safe or unsafe. Across all model-prompt combinations, first-turn safe-response rates ranged from 85% to 100%. By depth 11, they dropped to 38-61%, and by depth 101, to 15-44%. This decline appeared across models and continued well beyond the short interactions typically used in multi-turn safety evaluations. These results provide proof-of-concept evidence that strong single-turn safety does not necessarily persist during sustained adversarial interaction. They highlight the need for long-horizon evaluations and conversation-level safeguards that account for risk accumulating across turns.
title: Evaluating Language Model Safety Across Long Adversarial Conversations
title_translated: 评估大语言模型在长对抗对话中的安全性
summary_translated: 对话安全性评估通常仅使用单一有害提示测试语言模型，而现实系统与用户通过长期、自适应的对话进行交互。本研究考察当对抗性用户持续多轮交互时，模型是否仍能保持安全响应。我们在两个有害提示下，对三个开源指令微调模型在不同对话长度和随机种子条件下进行评估。在每种设置中，第二个语言模型充当持续的对抗性用户，而安全分类器对每个响应标记为安全或不安全。在所有模型-提示组合中，首轮安全响应率介于85%至100%之间；到第11轮时下降至38%-61%，到第101轮时降至15%-44%。这种下降现象在所有模型中均出现，并远超通常用于多轮安全评估的短期交互。这些结果提供了概念验证证据：强单轮安全性并不必然在持续对抗交互中维持。这凸显了长周期评估和对话级防护机制的必要性，以应对多轮交互中风险的累积。

summary: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. The shared task is organized into two main tasks, each comprising two subtasks, for a total of four subtasks. Task 1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, 10 of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging under distribution shift, with the winning team achieving AUC-ROC test scores of 0.772 and 0.767 for Subtasks 1.1 and 1.2, respectively. For Task 2, the winning team achieved scores of 0.882 and 0.857 in the Islamic and general-knowledge subtasks, respectively, under assisted evaluation.
title: Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification
title_translated: Halluscoring 2026：首个关于大语言模型幻觉检测与答案验证的共享任务
summary_translated: 我们介绍HalluScoring 2026，一项针对阿拉伯语问答中幻觉检测与事实验证的共享任务，评估在具有挑战性的泛化场景下的表现。该共享任务分为两大任务，每项包含两个子任务，共四个子任务。任务1评估二元幻觉检测，分别考虑对未见问题的泛化（子任务1.1）和由未见大语言模型生成的回答的泛化（子任务1.2）。任务2将评估扩展至检测之外，要求系统还需从六个相关候选答案中识别出正确的事实答案，涵盖伊斯兰知识（子任务2.1）和通用知识（子任务2.2）。该任务基于两个阿拉伯语数据集：HalluScore和HalluTruthQA。共有13支队伍参与共享任务，其中10支提交了系统描述论文。任务1的结果显示，在分布偏移下幻觉检测依然具有挑战性，优胜团队在子任务1.1和1.2上的AUC-ROC测试得分分别为0.772和0.767。在任务2中，优胜团队在伊斯兰知识和通用知识子任务中分别取得0.882和0.857的得分（辅助评估下）。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents for multi-step decision-making, yet transfer poorly to unseen environments. World-model methods address this by training agents to predict future observations, at the cost of additional training and errors that compound when predictions are used for planning. However, for LLM agents operating in digital environments, much of this world knowledge is already internalized during pretraining, which shifts the problem from acquiring it to eliciting it. We argue that typical post-training provides little pressure for such elicitation, since supervision under a single goal at each visited state inadvertently drives policies to rely on superficial contextual habits. We introduce EVOKE, a post-training method that supplies this pressure through goal diversity at fixed states. Motivated by theory showing that an agent competent across diverse goals must encode a world model recoverable from its action preferences, EVOKE holds the environment state and interaction history fixed and ranks the same candidate actions under alternative goals, forcing action preferences to change, so that a policy relying on contextual habits or single-goal correlations cannot order them correctly. This implicitly elicits the policy's pretrained world knowledge to inform decisions. We evaluate EVOKE across diverse tasks in three backbones, demonstrating improved task performance, unseen environment generalization, and data efficiency. We further conduct controlled analyses to better understand what drives these gains. These findings offer a new perspective on eliciting internalized world knowledge for transferable action through direct decision supervision.
title: EVOKE: Eliciting World Knowledge in Agents for Transferable Decision-Making
comment: 19 pages. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL ; Models: this https URL
title_translated: EVOKE：激发智能体中的世界知识以实现可迁移决策
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作多步决策智能体，但在未见过的环境中迁移能力较差。世界模型方法通过训练智能体预测未来观测来解决此问题，但代价是额外的训练开销以及预测错误在规划中累积的问题。然而，对于在数字环境中运行的LLM智能体而言，大量世界知识已在预训练阶段内化，因此问题已从获取知识转变为如何有效激发这些知识。我们认为，典型的后训练过程对这种激发施加的压力很小，因为在每个访问状态下的单一目标监督会无意中促使策略依赖表面化的上下文习惯。我们提出EVOKE，一种通过在固定状态下引入目标多样性来施加压力的后训练方法。受理论启发，一个能在多种目标下表现良好的智能体必须编码可从其动作偏好中恢复的世界模型。EVOKE在固定环境状态和交互历史的前提下，对相同候选动作在不同目标下进行排序，强制动作偏好发生变化，从而使依赖上下文习惯或单一目标关联的策略无法正确排序。这隐式地激发了策略中预训练的世界知识，以支持决策。我们在三种骨干模型的多样化任务上评估EVOKE，展示了任务性能提升、未见环境泛化能力增强以及数据效率提高。我们还进行了受控分析，以更好地理解这些提升的驱动因素。这些发现为通过直接决策监督激发内化世界知识以实现可迁移行动提供了新视角。

summary: The performance ceiling of an LLM team is constrained not only by individual model capabilities, but also by inter-member error resonance and predictive differences. Although heterogeneous teaming is often observed to be effective in practice, existing approaches lack complementarity metrics that are computable, interpretable, and optimizable, leaving team composition to rely on heuristics. We propose a heterogeneity-driven team selection framework that performs offline profiling to characterize individual capability along with two complementary signals: one captures decorrelation in error patterns to reduce co-failures, while the other measures divergence in predictive behavior to capture strategy diversity. We formulate team selection as a standardized quality--complementarity combinatorial objective and apply an efficient greedy search to select a small team from a candidate pool. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms quality-only baselines under controlled candidate pools and team sizes, establishing reusable selection principles for multi-LLM systems.
title: Which Models Work Well Together? Measuring Heterogeneity for LLM Team Selection
title_translated: 哪些模型搭配效果更好？基于异质性的大语言模型团队选择度量
summary_translated: 大语言模型团队的性能上限不仅受单个模型能力的制约，还受到成员间错误共振和预测差异的影响。尽管实践中常观察到异质性组合的有效性，但现有方法缺乏可计算、可解释且可优化的互补性度量，导致团队构成仍依赖启发式方法。我们提出一种基于异质性的团队选择框架，通过离线分析刻画各模型的能力，并引入两种互补信号：一是捕捉错误模式的去相关性以减少共同失败，二是衡量预测行为的差异性以体现策略多样性。我们将团队选择建模为标准化的质量-互补性组合优化目标，并采用高效的贪心搜索从候选池中选出小规模团队。在多个基准上的实验表明，我们的框架在控制候选池和团队规模的情况下，持续优于仅考虑质量的基线，为多大语言模型系统建立了可复用的选择原则。

summary: In this paper we propose NinaXander, a series of composed language models obtained by connecting layers of frozen language models from different architecture families with a single trained shared-latent adapter. A composed model runs the first layers of one model, converts the resulting intermediate representation once with the adapter, and then runs the remaining layers of the other model. Once the adapter is trained, several composed models that connect at different layers are obtained without retraining. Using the recurrent RWKV-4-Raven-7B and the Transformer-based Tulu-Pythia-6.9b, abbreviated as RWKV and Pythia, this study examines whether frozen models from different families can be recombined post hoc. The composed models answered multiple-choice questions, and those whose generations we examined produced syntactically well-formed text. The configuration that combines the first 5 layers of Pythia with the remaining 27 layers of RWKV reduced the Transformer key-value (KV) cache by 84.4% with accuracy not significantly different from that of RWKV alone. In multiple-choice accuracy, however, no composed model matched the parent model Pythia, and language-modeling performance decreased sharply on WikiText, a corpus of Wikipedia articles outside the training domain. The correspondence between intermediate representations was also obtained in one favorable case, with a shared tokenizer, the same depth, and the same hidden width, and does not show that the models share a general semantic space.
title: NinaXander: Feasibility and Limits of Composing Frozen Language Models Across Architecture Families via a Shared Latent Space
title_translated: NinaXander：通过共享潜在空间跨架构家族组合冻结语言模型的可行性与局限性
summary_translated: 本文提出NinaXander，一种通过单一训练的共享潜在适配器连接来自不同架构家族的冻结语言模型层而形成的组合模型系列。组合模型先运行一个模型的前几层，再通过适配器将中间表示转换一次，最后运行另一个模型的剩余层。一旦适配器训练完成，即可无需重新训练获得多个在不同层连接的组合模型。以循环的RWKV-4-Raven-7B和基于Transformer的Tulu-Pythia-6.9b（简称RWKV和Pythia）为例，本研究探讨了来自不同家族的冻结模型是否可在事后重新组合。组合模型回答多项选择题，其生成文本语法上均正确。配置上将Pythia的前5层与RWKV的剩余27层结合，使Transformer键值缓存减少84.4%，且准确率与单独使用RWKV无显著差异。然而，在多项选择准确率上，任何组合模型均未达到父模型Pythia的水平，且在WikiText（非训练域的维基百科文章语料）上的语言建模性能急剧下降。在一种有利情况下，通过共享分词器、相同深度和隐藏维度，获得了中间表示之间的对应关系，但这并不表明这些模型共享一个通用语义空间。

summary: Values such as honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality are often regarded as general principles underpinning AI alignment. However, what it means to act in accordance with these values can depend on the context in which a decision is made. In this paper, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) appropriately adapt the application of a value across professional settings, while remaining consistent when contextual changes do not alter the relevant professional norm. To study this, we introduce ContextAdapt, an evaluation framework covering honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality across medicine, law, finance, and national security. Drawing on primary-source professional and regulatory documents, we construct a value x domain framework and use this to develop scenarios testing both default professional rules and recognised exceptions. We evaluate 12 LLMs on both the actions they recommend and the justifications they provide. In our main experiment, models achieve 95.6% mean appropriateness, although the use of the correct domain-specific justification varies substantially across models, from 25.6% to 76.9%. In a separate factorial experiment, explicitly naming the professional domain and changing the role of the model have limited effect on behaviour. Varying stakes, however, reveals severe but localised failures: in some cases, models alter their responses even though the underlying professional obligation remains unchanged. In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. These results show that evaluating value alignment requires us to consider not only whether models follow abstract principles, but whether they apply them appropriately across different contexts.
title: ContextAdapt: Evaluating Contextual Adaptation and Value Alignment in LLMs
title_translated: ContextAdapt：评估大语言模型中的情境适应性与价值对齐
summary_translated: 诚实、自主性和保密性等价值观常被视为人工智能对齐的基础通用原则。然而，遵循这些价值观的具体含义可能取决于决策所处的情境。本文探讨大语言模型（LLMs）是否能在不同专业领域中恰当地调整价值观的应用，同时在情境变化不改变相关专业规范时保持一致性。为此，我们提出了ContextAdapt评估框架，涵盖医学、法律、金融和国家安全领域的诚实、自主性和保密性。基于原始的专业与监管文件，我们构建了“价值×领域”框架，并据此设计测试场景，检验默认专业规则及公认例外情况。我们在12个LLMs上评估了其推荐行为及其理由。主实验中，模型平均适当性达95.6%，但使用正确领域特定理由的比例在不同模型间差异显著，介于25.6%至76.9%之间。在独立因子实验中，明确提及专业领域或改变模型角色对行为影响有限；但提高风险程度则暴露出严重但局部的失败：某些情况下，尽管基础职业义务未变，模型仍改变了回应。特别是，感知严重性似乎成为诚实与保密场景中披露行为的提示信号。这些结果表明，评估价值对齐不仅需关注模型是否遵循抽象原则，还需考察其在不同情境下的恰当应用。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer questions about politically contentious issues, yet evaluations typically treat a model's stance as a relatively stable property. Real users, however, communicate political signals through their terminology, assumptions, and personal context. We investigate whether such signals produce ideological mimicry: systematic shifts in the political stance expressed by an LLM toward the position conveyed by the interaction. If LLMs adapt their responses to these signals, they risk creating personalised political information environments in which users with opposing views receive systematically different accounts of the same issue, potentially reinforcing existing divisions. We build the Poli-SHIFT dataset and evaluation framework and assess seven open-weight LLMs across ten contentious political topics in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, systematically manipulating contested terminology, politically valenced premises, and user information, and eliciting responses in both multiple-choice and open-text formats. Across models, we find robust evidence that prompt framing shapes the political stance of LLM outputs. Changing terminology alone reverses which side of an issue a model supports in 16.9% of matched comparisons. Stated political ideology also systematically shifts responses toward the user's position. These findings show that political stance is not a fixed property of LLMs; the views expressed are conditional on the interaction with the user. As LLMs become increasingly personalised sources of information, such interaction-dependent adaptation could contribute to political information environments that reinforce users' existing perspectives.
title: Framing the Narrative: Ideological Mimicry in Large Language Models
title_translated: 叙事建构：大语言模型中的意识形态模仿现象
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于回答涉及政治争议问题，但现有评估通常将模型立场视为相对稳定的属性。然而，真实用户通过术语、假设和个人背景传递政治信号。我们研究这些信号是否引发意识形态模仿：即LLM在表达的政治立场上系统性地向交互中传达的位置靠拢。若LLMs会根据这些信号调整回应，可能造成个性化政治信息环境，使持对立观点的用户接收到同一议题的不同叙述，从而强化既有分歧。我们构建了Poli-SHIFT数据集与评估框架，评估七种开源权重LLMs在美、英、澳十项政治争议话题上的表现，系统操纵争议性术语、带有政治倾向的前提和用户信息，并以多项选择和开放式文本格式获取响应。结果显示，提示框架显著影响LLM输出的政治立场。仅改变术语便在16.9%的匹配比较中逆转了模型支持的一方。陈述的政治意识形态也系统性地使回应向用户立场倾斜。这些发现表明，政治立场并非LLMs的固定属性，其所表达的观点取决于与用户的互动。随着LLMs日益成为个性化信息来源，这种依赖交互的适应性可能加剧用户已有观点的信息茧房。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvement is strongly selective: only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty at the 95% target. These results show that conformal factuality extends to multi-hop RAG, while demonstrating that nominal reliability must be interpreted jointly with claim retention and abstention.
title: Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Code available at this https URL
title_translated: 多跳检索增强生成中的保真性校准控制
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）可将大语言模型锚定在外部证据上，但检索到的上下文并不能保证生成主张的客观真实性。这一问题在多跳RAG中尤为突出，因为检索与推理需经过多个相互依赖的阶段。我们研究此前为单跳RAG开发的逐条保真性校准控制方法在多跳RAG中的有效性。我们将分裂-校准（split-conformal）主张过滤方法应用于多跳RAG，并在HotpotQA、Natural Questions和TriviaQA上使用Llama 3.1 8B和GPT-4o-mini进行评估，同时设置单跳参考实验。在所有六种多跳模型-数据集配置中，随着校准目标越来越严格，保留主张完全得到支持的响应比例持续上升。在95%的目标下，该比例范围为95.80%至97.20%，而无过滤时仅为55.60%至76.03%。然而，改进具有高度选择性：仅有4.41%至31.09%的生成主张被保留，且在95%目标下仅9.70%至51.40%的响应仍非空。这些结果表明，校准保真性可扩展至多跳RAG，同时揭示名义可靠性必须与主张保留率和弃权率联合解读。

summary: Tamazight (Amazigh) is, together with Arabic, one of the two official languages of Morocco, yet it remains severely under-resourced for speech technology: pub licly available labelled audio is scarce, generally lacks information on the regional variety spoken, and is often of uneven transcription quality. This article describes the TutlAit dataset, a corpus of Moroccan Tamazight speech paired with Modern Standard Arabic text and explicit regional accent labels. The data were collected with TutlAit, a purpose-built crowdsourcing web application (React 18 front end, Django 5 / Django REST Framework back-end, PostgreSQL database). Native speakers recruited through targeted LinkedIn and Instagram campaigns created an account, declared their regional variety (Atlas, Souss, Rif or other) and demographic information, and then contributed through two workflows: Text-to Audio, in which an Arabic sentence is displayed and the volunteer records its oral Tamazight rendering in the browser, and Audio-to-Text, in which a Tamazight excerpt is played and the volunteer types its Arabic transcription. A complemen tary set of segments was obtained from freely accessible Tamazight audiovisual media, segmented and annotated with ELAN and imported through a bulk CSV/ZIP pipeline. Every upload is converted server-side to 16kHz mono WAV, hashed with SHA-256 for duplicate rejection, checked for duration bounds and validated by an administrator. The dataset contains 13,384 audio files totalling 75,231 seconds (approximately 20.9 hours, about 3.01GB). The Atlas variety accounts for 9,956 files (14.08h) and the Souss variety for 3,378 files (6.75h); small Rif (22 files) and Kabyle (28 files) subsets are also included. The corpus can be reused for speech recognition, speech translation and accent identification for Moroccan Tamazight.
title: TutlAit v1: a crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels
title_translated: TutlAit v1：一个带有阿拉伯语转录和区域口音标签的众包摩洛哥塔马齐格特语语音数据集
summary_translated: 塔马齐格特语（阿马齐格语）是摩洛哥的两种官方语言之一，但其语音技术资源严重不足：公开可用的带标注音频稀缺，通常缺乏关于所讲地区变体的信息，且转录质量参差不齐。本文介绍了TutlAit数据集，这是一个包含摩洛哥塔马齐格特语语音及其现代标准阿拉伯语文本并带有明确区域口音标签的语料库。数据通过专为众包设计的Web应用TutlAit收集（前端使用React 18，后端采用Django 5 / Django REST Framework，数据库为PostgreSQL）。通过定向LinkedIn和Instagram活动招募母语者，注册后声明其地区变体（阿特拉斯、苏斯、里夫或其他）及人口统计信息，随后通过两种工作流贡献数据：文本转语音（显示一段阿拉伯语句子，志愿者在浏览器中录制其口头塔马齐格特语表达）和语音转文本（播放一段塔马齐格特语片段，志愿者输入其阿拉伯语转录）。此外，还从可自由获取的塔马齐格特语视听媒体中获取了补充片段，使用ELAN进行分割和标注，并通过批量CSV/ZIP管道导入。每次上传均在服务器端转换为16kHz单声道WAV格式，使用SHA-256哈希去重，检查时长范围，并由管理员验证。该数据集包含13,384个音频文件，总计75,231秒（约20.9小时，约3.01GB），其中阿特拉斯变体占9,956个文件（14.08小时），苏斯变体占3,378个文件（6.75小时）；还包括少量里夫（22个）和卡比勒（28个）子集。该语料库可用于塔马齐格特语的语音识别、语音翻译和口音识别研究。

summary: System prompts are the primary lever practitioners use to control language model behavior, yet what they actually do to the computation inside the transformer remains poorly understood. Across 17 instruction-tuned models spanning 8 architecture families and 1.5B to 72B parameters, we use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to compare layer-wise representations under 20 system prompts in five functional categories. Effects are layer-selective and instruction-type-dependent: persona and formatting instructions deeply restructure intermediate representations, while safety instructions barely move them, producing changes statistically indistinguishable from a minimal baseline. Restrictive safety instructions and explicitly permissive ones ("you have no restrictions") engage near-identical computational pathways (mean CKA correlation 0.997), and this persists at commercial scale, where safety penetration remains below 10% even at 70B-72B. A linear probing baseline exposes the mechanism: the model encodes prompt category at every layer but restructures its computation only at a small subset, so the prompt is reliably "seen" but, for safety, not deeply "acted upon." Causal activation patching confirms these layers mediate behavioral change, and representational depth predicts behavioral effect size across the full 17-model cohort (Spearman rho = 0.761, p < 0.001). The findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the persistent jailbreak vulnerability of system-prompt-based safety. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/system-prompt-illusion-cka
title: The System Prompt Illusion: How Instruction Preambles Modify Computation in Language Models
title_translated: 系统提示幻觉：指令前缀如何改变语言模型中的计算
summary_translated: 系统提示是从业者控制语言模型行为的主要手段，但其对Transformer内部计算的实际影响仍不清楚。我们在涵盖8种架构家族、参数量从15亿到720亿的17个指令微调模型上，使用中心核对齐（CKA）方法比较五类功能指令下的逐层表示。结果表明，影响具有层选择性和指令类型依赖性：人物设定和格式化指令会深度重构中间表示，而安全类指令几乎不改变表示，其变化在统计上与最小基线无异。限制性安全指令与显式宽松指令（“你没有任何限制”）激活近乎相同的计算路径（平均CKA相关性0.997），这一现象在商业规模下依然存在，即使在700亿至720亿参数模型中，安全机制渗透率仍低于10%。线性探测基线揭示了其机制：模型在每一层都编码提示类别，但仅在少数层重构计算，因此提示被可靠“感知”，但对于安全目的却未被“深入执行”。因果激活修补确认这些层中介行为变化，且表征深度能预测全17模型组的行为效应大小（Spearman等级相关系数0.761，p < 0.001）。研究结果为基于系统提示的安全机制持续存在的越狱漏洞提供了机制解释。代码：https://github.com/Usama1002/system-prompt-illusion-cka

summary: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI. It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.
title: Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling
title_translated: 利用ASR对齐与停顿建模自动估算肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者言语流畅性指数
summary_translated: 监测肌萎缩侧索硬化症（MND）患者的认知障碍（CI）对于及时治疗和护理至关重要，但由于伴随的言语困难，这一过程极具挑战性。爱丁堡认知与行为ALS筛查（ECAS）提供了一个可靠的CI评估指标，其中言语流畅性指数（VFI）是核心组成部分。基于自动化语音分析的最新进展，本研究提出了一种估算VFI的系统。该系统利用独特的MND数据集，结合ASR（WhisperX）和VAD（Silero）以及优化的时间戳，预测VFI并提取多个临床可解释的指标。我们的方法在多种回归算法下优于基于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入的系统。受临床启发的特征始终优于其他特征集，最佳模型表现优异（P词：R² 0.9，NRMSE 0.05；S词：R² 0.8，NRMSE 0.08），证明了自动化VFI估算的可行性。

summary: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated.   We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions. Across 4,010 audited commit-validation records, it produces zero false accepts.
title: TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents
title_translated: TomasuLLM：面向大语言模型智能体的乱序推测执行
summary_translated: 长时间运行的工具会显著增加编码智能体的延迟：编译器、测试套件和仓库命令需数秒至数分钟，而智能体则处于空闲状态。这种观察到的延迟问题与推动乱序处理器发展的矛盾相同——顺序接口隐藏了可预测并提前启动的工作，但推测结果可能只有在所有先前步骤验证后才可见。我们提出了TomasuLLM，一种运行时系统，可在保持任务执行正确性的前提下，以非轨迹顺序执行智能体工具调用。它预先草拟未来动作，在隔离的写时复制沙箱中运行，追踪其依赖关系和影响，并仅在与已提交状态验证后，按轨迹顺序提交结果。在涵盖从亚秒级到数分钟级工具调用的三个基准测试中，TomasuLLM提升了报告的基准平均性能，并随工具延迟呈比例提升：在100个SWE-bench Verified任务上提升1.31倍，在28个Terminal-Bench 2.0任务上提升1.35倍，在18个SWE-Marathon会话中匹配进度提升1.27倍。在4,010条经审计的提交验证记录中，其零误接受率。

summary: Survival analysis estimates time-to-event outcomes from patient covariates and is widely used for medical risk assessment. Patients seeking prognostic information after a diagnosis may turn to large language models (LLMs), now readily accessible through consumer applications. However, whether LLMs can provide accurate survival predictions has not been rigorously evaluated. We introduce Survprompt, a framework that converts structured patient covariates into free-text clinical vignettes and prompts pre-trained LLMs to predict survival zero-shot. We benchmark Survprompt against conventional survival models, including random survival forests (RSF), across two multi-institutional pan-cancer cohorts: the publicly available MSK-CHORD cohort and a newly curated cohort from the Providence St. Joseph Health Network constructed using an LLM-based medical abstraction framework. We report censored mean absolute error (cMAE) and concordance index (c-index) and conduct feature ablations to identify variables influencing LLM predictions. Frontier LLMs achieved surprisingly competitive cMAE for individual survival times. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models specifically trained for survival prediction for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD. Feature ablations revealed that LLMs prioritized clinical variables similarly to specialized survival models. However, LLMs showed inconsistent accuracy across cancer types and institutions and poorly discriminated between high- and low-risk patients (lower c-index). Zero-shot LLMs can generate surprisingly accurate prognostic estimates without specialized training, but their variable performance across cancer types and institutions remains an important limitation for clinical use.
title: Large Language Models are Approximate Survival Estimators
title_translated: 大语言模型是近似生存估计器
summary_translated: 生存分析通过患者协变量预测事件发生时间，广泛应用于医疗风险评估。诊断后寻求预后信息的患者如今可通过消费级应用程序轻松访问大语言模型（LLMs）。然而，LLMs能否提供准确的生存预测尚未经过严格评估。我们引入Survprompt框架，将结构化患者协变量转化为自由文本的临床案例，并提示预训练LLMs进行零样本生存预测。我们在两个多机构泛癌队列上对Survprompt与传统生存模型（包括随机生存森林RSF）进行了基准测试：公开的MSK-CHORD队列和利用LLM医学抽象框架新构建的普罗维登斯圣约瑟夫健康网络队列。我们报告了截尾均方误差（cMAE）和一致性指数（c-index），并进行特征消融以识别影响LLM预测的关键变量。前沿LLMs在个体生存时间预测上表现出令人惊讶的竞争性cMAE。例如，GPT-5.6-Sol在几种癌症类型上的cMAE仅比专门训练用于生存预测的最先进RSF模型高出10%，在MSK-CHORD队列中前列腺癌的cMAE甚至低于RSF。特征消融显示，LLMs优先考虑临床变量的方式与专用生存模型类似。然而，LLMs在不同癌症类型和机构间表现不一致，且对高危与低危患者的区分能力较差（c-index较低）。零样本LLMs无需专门训练即可生成相当准确的预后估计，但其在不同癌症类型和机构间的性能波动仍是临床应用的重要局限。

summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.
title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
title_translated: 面向多模态临床诊断的排名感知提示优化
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正在快速推进临床诊断，但其适应流程仍依赖于以准确率为指标的目标。临床数据存在严重的类别不平衡问题：一个始终预测多数类的模型可以达到90%以上的准确率，但在临床上毫无用处。因此，我们评估并优化了AUROC这一不依赖阈值的评分指标，该指标能够将正例排在负例之前，并且对类别平衡不变。我们聚焦于MLLM中的提示优化。如GEPA等反思方法使用一个二值得分矩阵，每行对应一个评估实例，每列对应一个候选提示；单元格记录每个实例的正确性，因此列平均值即为准确率，并驱动候选选择。我们提出了成对级帕累托提示进化（Ranking-PE），将每个正确性行替换为针对（正例，负例）实例对的成对排序行：如果候选提示对正例的评分高于配对的负例，则单元格值为1。此时列平均值等于经验AUROC（根据Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney恒等式）。我们在提示进化搜索读取的三个层级——决定帕累托支配的得分矩阵、对反射语言模型的逐例反馈以及最终候选选择——均应用此替换，无需额外模型调用且无代理损失。在MIMIC上的三种疾病测试中，基于准确率的提示进化可能导致排名性能下降；而Ranking-PE则逆转了这一趋势，在微调后的Qwen3-VL-8B上提升了+5.8 AUROC百分点，在MedGemma-4B上提升了+16.2百分点。消融实验分析了每个设计组件，表明医学级视觉主干（通过视觉编码器微调或医学预训练）是提示搜索无法替代的前提条件；我们的方法将反思提示进化从纯文本数据扩展到了多模态临床决策领域。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights. These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment. SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone. On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024-2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively.
