summary_translated: 随着AI系统从静态知识库转向具备持续适应与学习能力的智能体，维持其可信度意味着需赋予支撑模型动态反映其技能与知识变化的能力，以生成可靠的置信度估计。我们提出了“持续校准”问题，要求置信度估计器在不依赖持续监督的前提下，忠实反映模型知识随时间变化的情况。我们通过考察开放模型不同检查点间的持续校准来实现这一目标，探究早期检查点训练的置信度估计器能否泛化到后期检查点。具体而言，我们旨在揭示置信度是否依赖于知识，这一问题对置信度估计的可靠性具有深远影响。为测量该关系，我们定义并评估了在知识对比集上的校准：即包含一个检查点正确回答而另一个检查点错误回答的问题子集，反映了知识的变化。我们发现，无论是推理时方法还是微调方法，在对比集校准上均逊于在后续检查点训练的基准方法，即使这些方法在完整数据集上已具有良好校准性。我们提供证据支持假设：持续校准之所以困难，是因为在给定检查点上存在大量可能的置信度函数都能良好校准，其中仅有少数依赖于元知识特征，这些特征才能跨检查点泛化。为改善对比集校准，我们表明多检查点训练有所帮助，提示了一条识别在知识变化下仍保持鲁棒的置信度特征的路径。

summary: LLM watermarking has become an effective approach to distinguishing AI-generated text from human-written text by embedding detectable patterns during generation. However, a small post-generation edit may change the meaning of the text without removing its overall watermark signal, creating a risk that the modified content is still attributed to the original model. We propose Anchor-ECC, which incorporates the error-correcting code (ECC) constraints and explicit boundary anchors into the watermark structure and pairs them with a dynamic-programming decoder to detect and localize post-generation edits. Across Qwen3-8B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and OPT-125M, the approximate-hard setting achieves about 99.7% block-level true positive rate (TPR) with at most 7.6% false alarm rate (FAR) for edit detection under mixed insertions, deletions, and substitutions, while preserving the distinction between watermarked outputs and unwatermarked text. Additional quality experiments identify lower-perplexity configurations that retain strong edit-detection performance. Together, these results extend LLM watermarking from source identification to local integrity verification while supporting configurable trade-offs between detection reliability and generation quality.
title: Anchor-ECC: Local Integrity Checking for Watermarked LLM Outputs via Error-Correcting Codes
comment: 18 pages, including references and appendices; 1 figure and 11 tables
title_translated: Anchor-ECC：通过纠错码实现水印LLM输出的局部完整性检测
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）水印技术已成为区分AI生成文本与人工撰写文本的有效方法，通过在生成过程中嵌入可检测的模式。然而，微小的后期编辑可能改变文本含义，同时保留整体水印信号，导致修改后的内容仍被归因于原始模型，带来风险。我们提出Anchor-ECC，将纠错码（ECC）约束和显式边界锚点融入水印结构，并搭配动态规划解码器，以检测并定位后期编辑。在Qwen3-8B、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3和OPT-125M上，近似硬设置下，混合插入、删除和替换场景中，块级真正率（TPR）达到约99.7%，假警报率（FAR）不超过7.6%，同时保持水印输出与无水印文本之间的区分性。额外的质量实验识别出低困惑度配置，可在保留强编辑检测性能的同时优化生成质量。这些结果将LLM水印从源头识别扩展至局部完整性验证，并支持检测可靠性与生成质量之间的可配置权衡。

summary: TTS systems with autoregressive semantic modeling have demonstrated strong zero-shot voice cloning performance and rich expressive variation, but their sequential decoding incurs substantial latency. Non-autoregressive alternatives offer much faster generation, yet often rely on more restrictive reference conditioning, such as requiring transcripts of the reference speech during inference. We present Tacit-TTS, an efficient transcript-free zero-shot voice cloning system distilled from IndexTTS2. Our model replaces autoregressive text-to-semantic decoding with masked non-autoregressive generation, introduces training-free acoustic length estimation, and accelerates the flow-matching renderer through ReFlow distillation. Across two English and two Mandarin datasets, Tacit-TTS achieves competitive zero-shot quality while generating speech over 10x faster than IndexTTS2 for utterances longer than 5 seconds. Its transcript-free conditioning further supports cross-lingual and non-lexical references. We validate this capability using references from eight other languages, infant babble, and synthetic gibberish, where transcript-dependent systems often degrade or fail due to unreliable ASR transcripts.
title: Tacit-TTS: From Autoregressive Decoding to Masked Prediction for Efficient Transcript-Free Voice Cloning
title_translated: Tacit-TTS：从自回归解码到掩码预测，实现高效无转录语音克隆
summary_translated: 具有自回归语义建模的TTS系统展现出强大的零样本语音克隆性能和丰富的表现力变化，但其序列解码带来了显著延迟。非自回归替代方案虽生成速度更快，但通常依赖更严格的参考条件，例如推理时需参考语音的转录文本。我们提出Tacit-TTS，一个从IndexTTS2蒸馏而来的高效无转录零样本语音克隆系统。该模型用掩码非自回归生成替代自回归文本到语义解码，引入无需训练的声学长度估计，并通过ReFlow蒸馏加速流匹配渲染器。在两个英文和两个中文数据集上，Tacit-TTS在长于5秒的语句上实现了超过10倍于IndexTTS2的生成速度，同时保持了竞争力的零样本语音质量。其无转录条件进一步支持跨语言和非词汇参考。我们通过使用来自八种其他语言、婴儿咿呀学语及合成胡言乱语的参考样本验证了这一能力，而依赖转录的系统常因不可靠的ASR转录而退化或失败。

summary: Two scientific findings can disagree without contradicting each other. Determining whether they conflict requires knowing whether they describe comparable measurements. We study how language models behave at this decision point. In a controlled task, we generate an unsatisfiable XOR constraint system and translate its constraints into scientific reports from different laboratories. One assignment satisfies more constraints, while another satisfies fewer but better matches expected biology. This creates a simple dilemma: does the model choose the assignment that best fits the constraints, or the one that better matches biological expectations? When the constraints are stated directly, GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 recover the best-supported assignment in 90% and 96% of cases, respectively. In scientific prose, however, the models behave differently. Claude Opus 5 often prefers the biologically expected assignment. Removing that biological preference increases recovery of the better-supported assignment from 27% to 79% (p<.001); recovery reaches 92% when the same Biology-favored record is accompanied by a formalization request and an explicit paired-design cue (p<.001). GPT-5.6 Sol is less sensitive, with neither corresponding change reaching statistical significance. These results suggest that reliable scientific verification depends not only on formal reasoning, but also on how models decide which findings should be compared and what relations they imply.
title: When Scientific Contradictions Are Lost in Translation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. This version is not included in the official NeurIPS proceedings
title_translated: 当科学矛盾在翻译中迷失
summary_translated: 两项科学发现可以存在分歧而不互相矛盾。判断它们是否冲突，取决于是否描述了可比的测量。我们研究语言模型在此决策点的表现。在一个受控任务中，我们生成了一个不可满足的异或（XOR）约束系统，并将其约束翻译为不同实验室的科学报告。一种赋值满足更多约束，另一种满足较少但更符合生物学预期。这形成一个简单困境：模型应选择最符合约束的赋值，还是更符合生物学预期的赋值？当约束直接陈述时，GPT-5.6 Sol和Claude Opus 5分别在90%和96%的情况下恢复了最佳支持的赋值。但在科学叙述中，模型行为不同。Claude Opus 5经常偏好生物学预期的赋值。移除这种生物学偏好后，对最佳支持赋值的恢复率从27%提升至79%（p<.001）；当同一生物学偏好记录伴随形式化请求和明确的配对设计提示时，恢复率可达92%（p<.001）。GPT-5.6 Sol则不敏感，对应变化均未达统计显著性。这些结果表明，可靠的科学验证不仅依赖形式推理，还取决于模型如何决定哪些发现应被比较以及它们隐含的关系。

summary: As vibe coding becomes increasingly capable and widespread, security vulnerabilities in even functionally correct solutions are a growing concern. When investigating functionally correct but insecure solutions, we find that the insecure agent is less than half as likely to conduct effective planning and testing for the hidden security risks behind the functional requirements. Motivated by this, we develop SECUREVIBE, a training recipe that explicitly targets planning and testing for code security. SECUREVIBE constructs training signals around these security behaviors. It includes supervised fine-tuning on the security suite with 4 security tasks, and post-training methods, SECUREVIBE_rl and SECUREVIBE_hg, to enhance security capabilities from verifiable execution feedback and hint-based self-supervision. Our SECUREVIBE outperforms the baseline on two types of security coding tasks across 4 benchmarks. Specifically, SECUREVIBE improves the security pass@1 by 6.9 points on BaxBench. The gains extend to unseen CWE categories, with improvements of 11.5 points on SusVibes. Meanwhile, it also improves functionality pass@1 by 13.6 points on the security coding task SusVibes and 4.1 points on the generic coding task SWE-bench Verified. Further analysis offers two practical insights: (i) diversifying supervision across security planning, coding, and testing strengthens security behaviors more effectively than adding coding trajectories alone, and (ii) hint-guided supervision is particularly valuable when the agent's existing security capabilities are insufficient to learn effectively from outcome feedback.
title: SecureVibe: Making Vibe Coding More Secure
title_translated: SecureVibe：让Vibe编码更安全
summary_translated: 随着Vibe编码能力日益增强且广泛应用，即使功能正确解决方案中的安全漏洞也日益成为关注焦点。在调查功能正确但不安全的解决方案时，我们发现不安全代理在针对功能需求背后的隐藏安全风险进行有效规划和测试方面，成功率不足一半。受此启发，我们开发了SECUREVIBE，一种专门针对代码安全规划与测试的训练方法。SECUREVIBE围绕这些安全行为构建训练信号，包括在包含4个安全任务的安全套件上的监督微调，以及后训练方法SECUREVIBE_rl和SECUREVIBE_hg，分别通过可验证执行反馈和基于提示的自监督来增强安全能力。我们的SECUREVIBE在四个基准上的两类安全编码任务中均优于基线。具体而言，在BaxBench上，SECUREVIBE将安全通过率@1提升了6.9分；在未见过的CWE类别上，SusVibes任务提升11.5分。同时，它在安全编码任务SusVibes上提升了13.6分的功能通过率@1，在通用编码任务SWE-bench Verified上提升了4.1分。进一步分析提供了两个实用洞见：(i) 在安全规划、编码和测试之间多样化监督，比仅增加编码轨迹更能有效强化安全行为；(ii) 当代理现有安全能力不足以从结果反馈中有效学习时，提示引导的监督尤为关键。

summary: Large language models are frequently proposed as a route to AI-powered services for African communities, but they are least reliable exactly where the need is greatest: all African languages remain low-resource by any standard measure, and models trained on scraped, standardised text systematically misrepresent the dialectal and regional variation of how people actually speak. We introduce \textbf{Model as a Library (MaaL)}, a software architecture that packages small, community-enrolled speech models as versioned on-device dependencies, enabling offline structured data collection that cannot generatively hallucinate, for populations that current language models serve worst. Rather than relying on web-scraped corpora, MaaL's vocabulary is enrolled directly from a small number of example recordings by the speakers themselves, at the point of deployment. We describe the architecture and its central mechanism - keyword spotting that turns a closed-vocabulary text form into a voice form, filled and submitted entirely on-device - and propose transpiling the closed-vocabulary elements already present in widely-deployed digital form tools into MaaL schemas, a low-friction path to voice-first, offline data collection for the low-literacy populations these tools already reach. This is a position and system-design paper: we describe the concept, the mechanism, and an analytical feasibility case, and identify what a working implementation still requires.
title: Towards Model as a Library: Offline, Community-Sourced AI for Low-Resource African Languages
title_translated: 迈向模型即库：面向低资源非洲语言的离线、社区驱动AI
summary_translated: 大型语言模型常被视为为非洲社区提供AI服务的途径，但恰恰在需求最迫切的地方最不可靠：所有非洲语言按任何标准衡量都属于低资源语言，且基于网络爬取的标准化文本训练的模型系统性地歪曲了人们实际说话中的方言和地区差异。我们提出	extbf{模型即库（MaaL）}，一种软件架构，将小型、由社区注册的语音模型打包为版本化的本地设备依赖项，实现离线结构化数据收集，避免生成式幻觉，服务于当前语言模型覆盖最差的人群。MaaL的词汇库并非依赖网络爬取语料，而是由使用者在部署时直接提供少量示例录音进行注册。我们描述了该架构及其核心机制——关键词检测，将封闭词汇文本形式转化为语音形式，并在本地完全完成填充与提交；并建议将广泛部署的数字工具中已有的封闭词汇元素转换为MaaL模式，为低识字人群提供低门槛的语音优先、离线数据收集路径。本文为立场与系统设计论文：我们阐述概念、机制与可行性分析，并指出实际实现仍需解决的问题。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and more broadly Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are often described and understood in human-like terms, a phenomenon known as \emph{anthropomorphism}. This paper provides a synthesis of recent literature on anthropomorphism in AI, covering theoretical frameworks, the role of language in framing AI as human-like, the various risks of anthropomorphizing machines, and strategies to mitigate these issues. After examining why we tend to anthropomorphize AI systems and whether we are right to do so, we highlight the impact of linguistic framing on anthropomorphism. Then, we introduce a conceptual taxonomy of risks associated with AI anthropomorphism. This taxonomy groups twenty-one concerns within five analytical categories: epistemic, affective, human agency, normative, and societal and institutional risks. Finally, we relate these concerns to proposed interventions in design, communication, education, and governance. We argue that a better understanding of AI systems requires concepts and theories grounded in their organization and demonstrated capacities. The linguistic shaping of anthropomorphic perceptions should form part of this scientific effort, since our descriptions influence both how these systems are understood and the roles we allow them to occupy in society.
title: Anthropomorphism in the age of Large Language Models: An overview of potential risks and mitigations
title_translated: 大语言模型时代的人格化：潜在风险与缓解策略综述
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）及更广泛的人工智能（AI）系统常被以类人方式描述和理解，这一现象被称为“人格化”。本文综合了近期关于AI人格化的文献，涵盖理论框架、语言在塑造类人AI认知中的作用、人格化机器的各种风险，以及相应的缓解策略。在分析我们为何倾向于人格化AI系统及其合理性之后，文章强调了语言框架对人格化的影响。随后，提出一个关于AI人格化风险的概念分类体系，将21个关切点归入五个分析类别：认识论、情感、人类能动性、规范性，以及社会与制度风险。最后，将这些关切与设计、传播、教育和治理方面的干预措施联系起来。我们认为，更好地理解AI系统需要基于其组织结构和实际能力的概念与理论。人格化认知的语言塑造应成为这一科学努力的一部分，因为我们的描述会影响这些系统如何被理解，以及我们在社会中赋予它们的角色。

summary: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles. CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.
title: Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
title_translated: 深入CHOIR：自由列举法揭示LLM集成中的独特模型声音
summary_translated: 开放式LLM的同质性可能导致虚假的多样性，即多个系统看似提供独立观点，实则返回相同的常见默认答案。单次生成的答案会掩盖由严格受限的回答空间、提示词词汇回声，或表面之下存在稳定替代方案的广阔回答空间所导致的一致性差异。我们提出CHOIR（集体分层有序查询响应）框架，将认知人类学中的自由列举法应用于LLM集成。CHOIR通过重复获取排序列表，将项目聚类为提示级别的概念，并衡量不同模型、提示变体和角色设定下的概念显著性。我们在Infinity-Chat 100（来自近期关于开放式模型同质性的外部提示库）和一个针对机制级对比设计的27题诊断库上评估CHOIR。在Infinity-Chat 100上，CHOIR重现了高表面一致性（93/100提示高于随机水平），同时区分了窄提示与宽提示并揭示其深层结构。在目标探测和外部提示库中，基础模型身份仍是最强可恢复的特征，而角色提示会改变基础模型特征中的显现概念。一种无源排名模块优先筛选稀有但稳定的候选项以供后续检查。CHOIR通过追问模型在何处一致、为何一致，以及在结构化深度探测下仍可触及的内容，将开放式同质性转化为诊断测量问题。

summary: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.
title: What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?
title_translated: 预训练与中期训练使奖励可学习的内容是什么？
summary_translated: 奖励可以识别正确答案，但无法确定处理新输入所需的计算过程。我们研究预训练和中期训练如何提供使奖励适应有效的信息与计算。在序列状态计算和上下文记忆中，我们刻画了在所有训练奖励上达成一致，却要求不同保留答案的机制。任务无关的源观察可解决此模糊性。我们从特定随机初始化出发，构建了经过源预测和奖励适应的有限采样Adam路径，证明了预测如何获得执行或检索能力，以及奖励如何学会其特定任务用途。使用预训练的Qwen2.5检查点进行实验，验证该分工机制。在八个世界中，采用正确源和首操作监督训练的序列模型达到82.61%的成功率，而私有随机源对照组仅为44.15%。记忆重放可在奖励适应过程中保持检索能力，独立的八世界验证实现75.32%的任务成功率，而匹配的替代检索训练仅达49.86%。GSM8K和HotpotQA分别分离出奖励输入时的准确率、后续提升和最终表现。这些结果共同连接了信息获取、可执行计算与奖励引导的任务学习。

summary: We introduce LoopVL to study whether Loop Transformers can be effectively extended to vision- language models. LoopVL combines Module-Loop and Model-Loop computation to iteratively update a unified vision-language state through shared modules. We train LoopVL from scratch through language pre-training, multimodal training, and post-training. LoopVL outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks. We also observe Visual Aha Moments in LoopVL, characterized by pronounced shifts in visual attention across loops. LoopVL provides practical evidence for recurrent vision-language modeling and offers an intuitive perspective on how shared parameters can support deeper multimodal computation over continuously evolving visual-language states.
title: LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence
title_translated: LoopVL：循环视觉智能
summary_translated: 我们引入LoopVL，以研究循环Transformer是否能有效扩展至视觉-语言模型。LoopVL结合模块级循环（Module-Loop）与模型级循环（Model-Loop）计算，通过共享模块迭代更新统一的视觉-语言状态。LoopVL从零开始训练，经历语言预训练、多模态训练和后训练阶段。在多模态理解和视觉推理基准测试中，LoopVL优于一系列同等规模及更大规模的非循环模型。我们还在LoopVL中观察到“视觉顿悟时刻”，表现为各循环间视觉注意力的显著变化。LoopVL为循环视觉-语言建模提供了实际证据，并从直观角度展示了共享参数如何支持对持续演化的视觉-语言状态进行更深层次的多模态计算。

summary: We introduce Type-6 logic, a variant of dynamic epistemic logic augmented with two operators (uncertainty and recurrence), designed to model the inferential dynamics of contemporary large language model (LLM) chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Type-6 accounts for common LLM reasoning pathologies such as unlicensed revision, enthymemes, loopbacks, and unverifiable/incorrect claims. We propose a verifier based on Type-6 logic that builds a graph out the trace, and checks it against Type-6's axioms and inference rules. We evaluate our framework on LLM-generated CoTs four splits spanning formal and informal reasoning. Our verifier detects structurally unsound reasoning steps that surface-level heuristics miss, and allows for easy visualisation of the model's reasoning process. In our corpus, our verifier shows that derived contradiction is the most common hard-fail category in CoT, and that only about 3\% of the propositions of a trace have impact on the final derivation. Ablation studies show that other verification methods (LLMs-as-judges, other neurosymbolic approaches, etc.) cannot be considered interchangeable: for example, agreement between LLMs-as-judges and LINC is $κ\approx 0.034$, and this persists within a method across underlying models. Type-6, however, is the most agreed-with method amongst the ones we tested. We prove our verifier runs on average-case linear time; and release our logic specification and artefacts.
title: What Was Said, Not What Was 'Thought': Type-6 Logic for CoT Verification
title_translated: 所说之言，而非所思之念：用于CoT验证的Type-6逻辑
summary_translated: 我们提出Type-6逻辑，一种增强动态认知逻辑的变体，包含两个算子（不确定性与循环性），旨在建模当代大语言模型（LLM）思维链（CoT）推理的推演动态。Type-6能够解释LLM推理路径中的常见病理，如未经授权的修订、省略前提、循环回溯以及不可验证/错误陈述。我们提出一种基于Type-6逻辑的验证器，通过追踪构建图谱，并依据Type-6的公理与推理规则进行校验。我们在涵盖形式与非形式推理的四个LLM生成CoT数据集上评估该框架。验证器检测到表层启发式方法忽略的结构不合理的推理步骤，并支持模型推理过程的可视化。在我们的语料库中，验证器显示推导矛盾是CoT中最常见的硬失败类别，且仅有约3%的推理命题对最终推导产生影响。消融研究表明，其他验证方法（如LLM作为裁判、其他神经符号方法等）不可互换：例如，LLM作为裁判与LINC之间的共识κ≈0.034，且这种差异在不同底层模型间依然存在。然而，Type-6是我们在测试中最具共识的方法。我们证明该验证器平均具有线性时间复杂度；并公开发布逻辑规范与相关工具。

summary: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.
title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
title_translated: ArgGYM：一种用于结构化可撤销推理的程序化、引擎验证基准
summary_translated: 大型语言模型推理的最新进展得益于具有自动可验证奖励的基准和强化学习环境，特别是在数学、代码和形式逻辑领域。这些场景使得模型准确性的评估与优化更为简便，但目前尚不清楚在固定问题设定和稳定评估标准下取得的成功，能否有效迁移至此类领域之外的推理任务。现实世界中的推理通常基于不完整且可修正的信息：结论可能暂时成立，被反例推翻，又因新论据重新确立，或在更强理由出现时被修改。这类推理一般称为可撤销推理。我们提出了ArgGYM，一个用于结构化可撤销推理的程序化基准和RLVR兼容的训练环境。ArgGYM将该推理过程分解为十二个任务，并通过符号论证引擎计算用于评估模型输出的形式状态，实现任务特定评分。它包含一个冻结的基准集，涵盖1,440个已验证实例，分布在十五种课程配置中，两种论证偏好顺序（最弱链与最后链），以及两种集合排序方式（精英主义与民主主义）。同时，相同的生成器和验证器可生成新的实例用于评估，减少对静态测试集的依赖，并支持可验证奖励的训练。在冻结基准上，前沿模型与开放权重模型展现出显著不同的推理特征：它们能在未完成整个任务的情况下恢复结构化答案的大部分内容，且在后期课程配置中性能下降，这些配置具有更长的依赖关系和更多交互结构。我们发布了该基准、生成器和验证器，以支持可复现的评估和RLVR训练。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that circumvent safety alignment to elicit harmful outputs. It remains unclear how harmfulness and refusal representations evolve over the course of multi-turn attacks, and why single-turn defenses are less effective in multi-turn settings. This work investigates how the geometry and temporal dynamics of harmfulness and refusal representations evolve across multi-turn attacks. We analyzed hidden-state representations from three instruction-tuned LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Gemma-2-9B-it) using three multi-turn attack frameworks (Crescendo, ActorAttack, and X-Teaming), and examined representation behavior across conversation turns, model layers, and token positions under various context configurations. Across models and frameworks, we found that (1) each attack framework traverses different geometric directions, yet each achieves comparable success in eliciting harmful outputs; (2) multi-turn harmfulness directions became increasingly linearly separable at the end-of-turn token position across turns in middle to late model layers; and (3) harmfulness representations are weakly aligned with refusal-related representations. The results indicate that multi-turn attacks do not succeed by suppressing the model's internal representation of harmfulness. Instead, harmfulness representations become increasingly separable across conversation turns, while remaining only weakly aligned with refusal-related representations. The findings are one possible explanation for why static single-turn safety probes may degrade in multi-turn settings, and suggest that robust defenses must consider temporal representation dynamics rather than identifying harmfulness with isolated or single-turn prompts.
title: The Geometry of Harmfulness in Multi-Turn Attacks
title_translated: 多轮攻击中危害性的几何结构
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）仍易受对抗性攻击的影响，这些攻击绕过安全对齐机制以诱导有害输出。目前尚不清楚危害性和拒绝响应的表征在多轮攻击过程中如何演变，以及为何单轮防御在多轮设置中效果较差。本研究探讨了多轮攻击中危害性和拒绝表征的几何结构与时间动态演变。我们分析了三个指令微调的大语言模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Gemma-2-9B-it）在三种多轮攻击框架（Crescendo、ActorAttack 和 X-Teaming）下的隐藏状态表示，考察了不同对话轮次、模型层及词元位置在各种上下文配置下的表征行为。结果表明：（1）每种攻击框架沿不同的几何方向推进，但均能实现相似的有害输出诱导成功率；（2）在中后期模型层中，多轮攻击的危害性方向在每轮结束处的词元位置变得越来越线性可分；（3）危害性表征与拒绝相关表征之间存在弱关联。结果表明，多轮攻击并非通过抑制模型内部的危害性表征来成功，而是使危害性表征在对话轮次间逐渐变得可分，同时仍与拒绝表征保持弱关联。这一发现可能是静态单轮安全探测在多轮设置中性能下降的一个可能解释，提示鲁棒防御必须考虑时间维度上的表征动态，而非仅将危害性与孤立或单轮提示等同。

summary: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.
title: Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Main text 10 pages, references and appendix follow. Project page with interactive visualizations: this https URL
title_translated: 基于上下文选择与目标加权的扩散语言模型微调
summary_translated: 离散扩散语言模型的监督微调通过掩码部分响应词元，并训练模型从可见上下文中恢复其原始值。因此，掩码模式既决定了模型可用的上下文，也决定了其需预测的词元。均匀随机掩码并未显式考虑这些选择之间的相互作用。我们提出GoldiMask，通过近似最大化一个子模目标来选择应揭示的词元作为上下文。该目标利用模型信号，在揭示词元的收益与其作为预测目标的价值之间进行权衡。GoldiMask随后根据所选上下文带来的收益及剩余学习潜力，对剩余目标进行加权。在三种骨干模型和三个训练数据集上，GoldiMask在大多数评估设置中均达到最高平均准确率，展示了在推理和代码生成方面的提升。组件消融实验表明，上下文选择与目标加权均对性能提升有贡献。此外，在GSM8K和MATH-500数据集上，GoldiMask在置信度阈值并行解码下减少了推理迭代次数，同时在更高置信度阈值下保持相当的准确性。

summary: Existing LLM-driven robot task planners rely on a taken-for-granted assumption of an ideal user whose instructions are clear, complete, and task-focused. However, when interacting with real-world users, especially those experiencing cognitive impairments, such as people living with dementia (PLWD), the planners often make mistakes and even pose physical safety risks. We proposed TALK-Dem (Talking Attributes and Linguistic Knowledge in Dementia), the first benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven robot task planning under dementia-associated verbal communication. TALK-Dem contains 4,800 instructions and covers five typical communication patterns, including Referential Imprecision, Object Substitution, Empty Speech, Topic Drift, and Intrusion, at three intensity levels. Experiments across six open-weight LLMs reveal a substantial robustness gap. Across communication patterns, open-weight models exhibited performance drops of up to 22.3 percentage points compared to ideal instructions. This revealed a critical gap and even danger for real-world applications, especially in assistive robotics, where locally deployable models are necessary due to privacy concerns and connectivity constraints. To mitigate this issue, we proposed the Context-Aware Retrieval from Experience (CARE) method, which retrieves relevant previously resolved tasks to provide task-specific interpretation and planning context. CARE generally outperformed standard prompting baselines across the six open-weight models, improving average task success by 18.1 percentage points over the vanilla prompt. These results highlighted the importance of both evaluating communication robustness and developing effective adaptation strategies for locally deployable assistive robots. The TALK-Dem dataset is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TALK-Dem-A6B3/.
title: TALK-Dem: Benchmarking Embodied Task Planning under Dementia-Associated Communication Patterns
title_translated: 针对痴呆相关沟通模式的具身任务规划基准评测
summary_translated: 现有的由大语言模型驱动的机器人任务规划器依赖于一个理所当然的假设：用户指令清晰、完整且聚焦于任务。然而，在与真实用户互动时，尤其是患有认知障碍（如痴呆症患者）的用户，规划器常出现错误，甚至带来物理安全风险。我们提出了TALK-Dem（痴呆症中的言语属性与语言知识），这是首个用于评估在痴呆相关语言沟通模式下大语言模型驱动机器人任务规划的基准。TALK-Dem包含4,800条指令，涵盖五种典型沟通模式：指称不精确、对象替代、空话、话题漂移和干扰，每种模式在三个强度级别下呈现。在六种开放权重大语言模型上的实验揭示了显著的鲁棒性差距：与理想指令相比，开放权重模型在各类沟通模式下的性能下降高达22.3个百分点。这暴露了真实应用中的关键缺陷甚至危险，尤其是在辅助机器人领域，由于隐私和连接性限制，本地部署模型是必需的。为缓解此问题，我们提出了情境感知的经验检索（CARE）方法，通过检索先前解决的相关任务，提供任务特定的解释与规划上下文。CARE在六种开放权重模型上普遍优于标准提示基线，平均任务成功率提升了18.1个百分点。这些结果凸显了评估沟通鲁棒性以及开发适用于本地部署辅助机器人的有效适应策略的重要性。TALK-Dem数据集已公开发布于 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TALK-Dem-A6B3/。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm in which the student learns from trajectories generated by its own policy under dense teacher supervision. However, OPD introduces a fundamental asymmetry: although the sampled trajectories are on-policy for the student, they are off-policy for the teacher. The teacher is typically optimized to continue from prefixes generated by its own policy, but during OPD it must instead supervise prefixes generated by the student. Empirically, we find that its continuation performance degrades as these prefixes grow longer. To address this issue, we propose Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT), a co-training framework that adapts the teacher to student-generated prefixes. Alongside standard OPD updates, SCOUT periodically optimizes the teacher's conditional ability using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where the teacher generates continuations from student prefixes and learns from outcome rewards. Controlled experiments show that SCOUT improves the teacher's ability to continue from student-generated prefixes, supporting the intended mechanism of student-conditioned teacher adaptation. Across multiple teacher--student configurations, model scales, and reasoning domains, SCOUT also consistently improves the effectiveness of on-policy distillation.
title: On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 关于在在线策略蒸馏中使用离策略教师的研究
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）作为一种新兴的后训练范式，其中学生模型在密集教师监督下从自身策略生成的轨迹中学习。然而，OPD引入了一个根本性不对称：尽管采样的轨迹对学生而言是在线策略的，但对教师而言却是离策略的。教师通常被优化为从其自身策略生成的前缀继续，但在OPD中，它必须监督由学生生成的前缀。实证发现，随着这些前缀变长，其延续性能会下降。为解决此问题，我们提出学生条件化的教师更新（SCOUT），一种协同训练框架，使教师能够适应学生生成的前缀。在标准OPD更新之外，SCOUT定期使用可验证奖励的强化学习来优化教师的条件生成能力，即教师从学生前缀生成后续内容，并从结果奖励中学习。控制实验表明，SCOUT提升了教师从学生生成前缀中继续的能力，支持了预期的学生条件化教师适应机制。在多种教师-学生配置、模型规模和推理领域中，SCOUT也一致提升了在线策略蒸馏的有效性。

summary: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.
title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks
title_translated: 超越模式崩溃：通过生成流网络生成多样化的合成专家对话
summary_translated: 高质量的合成数据对于后训练大语言模型以适应AI应用至关重要，这些应用需体现对话中多样的专家策略与决策。直接提示大语言模型或基于最终使用场景进行条件化，会产生多样性低的数据，导致其坍缩到主导模式。我们提出一种使用生成流网络（GFlowNets）生成多样化高质量合成数据的方法。我们证明，通过在关键交互特征（如困惑事件动态、支架指令平衡）上使用高斯混合密度来训练GFlowNets以生成潜在对话结构，能够按训练数据中的实际出现频率采样专家策略。在两个结构不同的领域——辅导对话和情感支持对话中，基于GFlowNets的合成数据生成方法在保真度、模式覆盖和真实性方面优于强化学习和端到端大语言模型基线，且不复制训练数据。在三个下游预测任务上的评估表明，基于合成GFlowNet对话训练的分类器提供了比竞争性合成基线更强的训练信号。

summary: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that a two-coder workflow built on OpenCollab establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation.
title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
title_translated: OpenCollab：具有可编程协作与可控运行时的多智能体编码框架
summary_translated: 多智能体编码系统旨在通过协作解决复杂的软件工程任务。然而，现有评估通常假设组织结构被严格遵循，而实际情况并非如此。这种行为差距以及底层系统组件的差异，导致难以明确归因观察到的性能提升。为此，我们提出了OpenCollab，一个提供统一基础设施的多智能体编码框架，支持可编程协作和可控运行时。具体而言，OpenCollab统一了组织设计，在共享运行时上实施实验控制，并通过细粒度事件流追踪执行过程。在此基础上，我们定义了“遵从度”来量化声明的组织是否真正实现。实验显示，不同配置下智能体的协作方式存在显著差异：改变任意单一维度，遵从度从47.2%波动至高达97.2%。此外，广泛的智能体编码基准测试表明，基于OpenCollab构建的双程序员工作流在性能上超越主流工具（如Mini-SWE-agent、Codex CLI和Claude Code），证明良好的组织设计可超越现有强大工具；同时，OpenCollab的单智能体配置在所有评估套件中使用的token最少。OpenCollab建立了一个统一的多智能体基础设施，便于可编程协作和受控因果评估。

summary: Test-time scaling improves model performance by allocating additional compute during inference. Using this compute effectively across multiple context windows requires deciding how to allocate fresh contexts and what information to carry between them. We call a model's ability to make these decisions contextual reasoning. Existing approaches largely prescribe these decisions through their harness; we instead shift them to the model. We introduce 1) Hermes, a family of simple, configurable harnesses that progressively varies model control over context allocation and reuse, and 2) Hermes-Learn, a two-stage framework for learning these capabilities. We find that capable models can exploit this flexibility to scale with additional inference-time compute, while smaller open-source models initially struggle to do so. Training with Hermes-Learn closes this gap, inducing adaptive contextual reasoning strategies that vary with both the problem and the progress of reasoning. These gains generalize across benchmarks and models, extrapolate beyond the inference-time compute seen during training, and transfer to complementary test-time scaling methods beyond Hermes.
title: Hermes: Learning Contextual Reasoning Unlocks Test-Time Scaling
title_translated: Hermes：学习上下文推理解锁测试时扩展能力
summary_translated: 测试时扩展通过在推理阶段分配额外计算资源来提升模型性能。在多个上下文窗口间有效利用这些计算资源，需要决定如何分配新上下文以及在窗口间传递哪些信息。我们称模型做出这些决策的能力为上下文推理。现有方法主要通过其调用框架预设这些决策；我们则将其转移至模型本身。我们引入了1）Hermes，一组简单且可配置的调用框架，逐步增加模型对上下文分配与复用的控制权；2）Hermes-Learn，一种两阶段框架，用于学习这些能力。我们发现，能力强的模型能够利用这种灵活性，在推理时扩展计算资源，而较小的开源模型起初难以做到。通过Hermes-Learn训练可缩小这一差距，使模型发展出随问题和推理进展而变化的自适应上下文推理策略。这些收益在不同基准和模型间具有泛化能力，可外推至训练期间未见的推理计算量，并适用于Hermes以外的互补测试时扩展方法。

summary: Multi-agent systems of LLMs add discussion to majority voting and are therefore expected to be more capable. However, empirical reports conflict on whether discussion improves accuracy or leads to an incorrect consensus. Here, we introduce a parsimonious model that explains when discussion improves accuracy and when it ends in an incorrect consensus, built from four behaviors repeatedly observed in LLM agents: (1) withholding dissent, (2) internalizing a stated answer, (3) reconsidering after seeing dissent, and (4) correcting toward the correct answer. The model shows that discussion can overturn an incorrect initial majority only when the withholding rate $c$ is below a critical rate $c^* = γ/(γ+ a)$, set by the net correction rate $γ$ and the internalization rate $a$. We estimate these rates from conversation logs with a Bayesian method and place LLM teams relative to $c^*$. As the model predicts, the gain from discussion shrinks as withholding rises, across LLMs and on a hidden profile benchmark, HiddenBench, and MedEInst. Instructing agents not to withhold dissent increases this gain. Turning reasoning off also increases the gain, because reasoning raises the internalization rate $a$ and keeps agents from reconsidering a minority answer. These findings reconcile the conflicting reports and identify when discussion outperforms majority voting.
title: Multi-agent discussion gains less when dissent is withheld
title_translated: 当异议被隐瞒时，多智能体讨论的增益更小
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通过引入讨论机制增强多数投票，因此预期具备更强能力。然而，实证报告对讨论是否提升准确率或导致错误共识存在矛盾。本文提出一个简洁模型，解释讨论何时提升准确率，何时导致错误共识，该模型基于在大语言模型智能体中反复观察到的四种行为：(1) 隐瞒异议，(2) 内化陈述答案，(3) 在看到异议后重新考虑，(4) 向正确答案修正。模型表明，只有当隐瞒率$c$低于临界值$c^* = γ/(γ+ a)$时，讨论才能纠正错误的初始多数意见，其中$c^*$由净修正率$γ$和内化率$a$决定。我们通过贝叶斯方法从对话日志中估计这些速率，并将大语言模型团队置于$c^*$相对位置。正如模型预测，随着隐瞒率上升，讨论带来的增益减小，这一现象在不同大语言模型及隐藏属性基准（HiddenBench）和MedEInst上均成立。指导智能体不要隐瞒异议可提高该增益。关闭推理功能也会增加增益，因为推理会提高内化率$a$，并阻止智能体重新考虑少数意见。这些发现调和了矛盾报告，并明确了讨论优于多数投票的条件。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to safety risks such as injected malicious instructions or misleading information, motivating runtime defenses that prevent unsafe action in execution across diverse risks while preserving benign-task utility. Existing system-level defenses either focus on risk detection rather than timely prevention or rely on predefined rules with limited flexibility across diverse risks. We propose a risk-aware harness that integrates LLM-based monitoring for flexible risk detection and structures monitor-guided execution around three core modules: trigger, monitor, and feedback, enabling targeted safety interventions while limiting disruption to benign task execution. To adapt the harness to different risks and deployment settings, we introduce HARDE, a two-stage harness optimization framework that first performs isolated probing of each module to derive an optimization guide, then uses this guide to iteratively optimize the harness based on safety and utility feedback. Experiments across three attack benchmarks show that HARDE improves runtime safety while preserving utility, outperforming manually designed harnesses and naive optimization baselines. Our analysis shows that effective runtime defense benefits from complementary safety mechanisms, attack-aware harness optimization, and harness designs matched to monitor capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/Liuz233/HARDE.
title: HARDE: Optimizing Agent Harnesses for Runtime Risk Detection and Execution Control
title_translated: HARDE：优化智能体调用框架以实现运行时风险检测与执行控制
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体易受安全风险影响，如恶意指令注入或误导性信息，因此需要运行时防御机制，在应对多种风险的同时防止不安全行为，同时保持良性任务的可用性。现有系统级防御要么侧重于风险检测而非及时预防，要么依赖预设规则，缺乏在多样化风险下的灵活性。我们提出一种风险感知的调用框架，整合基于LLM的监控以实现灵活的风险检测，并围绕三个核心模块——触发器、监控器和反馈机制——构建监控引导的执行结构，从而实现针对性的安全干预，同时最小化对良性任务执行的干扰。为使调用框架适应不同风险和部署环境，我们引入HARDE，一种两阶段调用框架优化框架：首先对各模块进行独立探测以生成优化指南，然后基于该指南结合安全性和实用性反馈迭代优化调用框架。在三个攻击基准上的实验表明，HARDE在保持任务效用的同时提升了运行时安全性，优于手动设计的调用框架和朴素优化基线。分析显示，有效的运行时防御依赖于互补的安全机制、针对攻击的调用框架优化，以及与监控能力匹配的调用设计。代码已公开于https://github.com/Liuz233/HARDE。

summary: Streaming spoken agents may take an external action before the available speech supports it, yet final-turn scores do not reveal whether each observed prefix supports that action. We introduce the Partial Speech Action Contract for Turn Taking in Speech Language Models (PACT-SLM), a controlled evaluation that assigns a first valid action time and measures action identity and timing separately. The primary diagnostic contains 80 paired contrast groups from four held-out semantic families and 1,600 prefix predictions across clean and 15 dB noise renderings. After correcting a mismatch between randomized branch codes and semantic labels, a refitted WavLM Base Plus probe reaches 26.03% pooled post-onset semantic-label accuracy (95% group-bootstrap interval: 22.14%-29.68%), exposes an action on 18.99% of pre-onset prefixes, and predicts 5.94% of complete trajectories exactly. It exceeds matched text, scalar-acoustic, and shuffled-representation probes in post-onset label accuracy, but its score is at the 96th percentile of 100 within-prefix label permutations and below the 97.5th-percentile reference (26.73%). Elapsed time is more onset-exact than WavLM Base Plus (36.25% vs. 23.13%) but less accurate about action identity (9.92% vs. 26.03%). These results show that action identity and timing measure distinct aspects of partial-speech decision behavior.
title: When Does a Spoken Agent Have Enough Evidence to Act? The PACT-SLM Contract Test
title_translated: 语音智能体何时拥有足够证据采取行动？PACT-SLM 合同测试
summary_translated: 流式语音智能体可能在语音信息尚未充分支持时就采取外部动作，但最终回合的得分无法揭示每个观察到的前缀是否支持该动作。我们提出了语音语言模型对话中的部分语音动作合同（PACT-SLM），一种受控评估方法，用于确定首次有效动作时间，并分别测量动作身份与时机。主要诊断包含来自四个独立语义类别的80对对比组，以及在干净和15 dB噪声环境下生成的1,600个前缀预测。在修正随机分支代码与语义标签之间的不匹配后，重新拟合的WavLM Base Plus探测器在动作发生后的语义标签准确率达到26.03%（95%群体自举区间：22.14%-29.68%），在18.99%的动前前缀上暴露了动作，并精确预测了5.94%的完整轨迹。其在动作发生后的标签准确率优于匹配文本、标量声学和打乱表示探测器，但在100次内部前缀标签排列中仅处于第96百分位，低于26.73%的参考基准。其耗时比WavLM Base Plus更接近动作起始点（36.25% vs. 23.13%），但在动作身份判断上准确性更低（9.92% vs. 26.03%）。结果表明，动作身份与时机分别衡量了部分语音决策行为的不同方面。

summary: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.
title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation. Preliminary Results
title_translated: Jev在医学中的基准评估：初步结果
summary_translated: Jev是一个非生成式的“系统一”模型，仅对预定义答案选项分配概率，无法回答之外的内容。其在医学问答和基于病例的诊断推理任务中的准确率与校准性尚不清楚。我们对Jev 1.13在四个医学基准上的表现进行了评估：MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ和NEJM病例挑战。以GPT-6 Sol（带中等推理和不带推理）作为参照。主要结果为Top-1准确率；关键次要结果包括校准性、选择性预测及识别不可回答问题的能力。所有8,469个请求均返回有效答案。Jev在PubMedQA上的准确率与GPT-6 Sol带中等推理相当（78.4% vs 78.2%），在MetaMedQA上较低（74.8% vs 82.7%），在DiagnosisArena-MCQ上显著更低（59.8% vs 82.4%），在NEJM病例中也明显偏低（61.8% vs 82.4%）。在MetaMedQA上，Jev的概率校准最佳（预期校准误差0.063 vs 0.146），且当概率≥0.9时，其答案准确率达93.4%（占问题的52.9%），但GPT-6 Sol在类似接受比例下同样准确。在DiagnosisArena-MCQ上，Jev的概率区分能力较差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768）。在162道正确答案为“我不知道或无法回答”的题目中，Jev选择了该选项10.5%（GPT-6 Sol为8.6%）。平均延迟为0.27–0.31秒；全部2,823项成本仅为0.08美元。Jev速度快且成本低，其在研究摘要上的准确率接近前沿大模型，但在考试题和复杂诊断案例上明显不足。在临床使用前需进行任务特定验证。

summary: A common task in legal Information Retrieval (IR) is to find relevant legal sources from case-law collections. While legal practice often requires pinpoint citations (pincites) to specific case paragraphs, most existing public legal IR datasets lack paragraph-level citation annotations. Yet, publicly available datasets with such information contain data leakage in the query text and exclude paragraphs that are neither citing nor cited from the corpora, creating an unrealistic and oversimplified retrieval setting, potentially leading to inflated performance. To address these limitations, we contribute a large-scale legal IR dataset constructed from Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) judgments. The dataset contains: (i) masked case/paragraph queries, with removed citation information; (ii) a corpus that includes all paragraphs; and (iii) case- and paragraph-level ground truth citations, with partial human expert validation. Our dataset supports both the development and rigorous evaluation of legal IR methods, at multiple query-document levels (case-to-case, paragraph-to-case, and paragraph-to-paragraph retrieval). Link to dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/theresiavr/legalpincite
title: LegalPincite: Multi-level Legal Information Retrieval Dataset
comment: Accepted for publication at the 8th Natural Legal Language Processing Workshop (NLLP 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
title_translated: LegalPincite：多层级法律信息检索数据集
summary_translated: 法律信息检索（IR）中的常见任务是从判例法集合中查找相关法律来源。尽管法律实践中常需精确定位引用（pincites）至具体判例段落，但大多数现有公开法律IR数据集缺乏段落级引用标注。而现有含此类信息的公开数据集存在查询文本中的数据泄露问题，并排除既不被引用也不引用其他段落的文本，造成不真实且过度简化的检索场景，可能导致性能虚高。为解决这些局限，我们构建了一个大规模法律IR数据集，源自欧洲联盟法院（CJEU）的判决文书。该数据集包含：(i) 去除引用信息的掩码案件/段落查询；(ii) 包含所有段落的语料库；(iii) 案件级与段落级真实引用标注，经部分人工专家验证。该数据集支持法律IR方法的开发与严格评估，涵盖多个查询-文档层级（案件到案件、段落到案件、段落到段落检索）。数据集与代码链接：https://huggingface.co/datasets/theresiavr/legalpincite

summary: As large language models increasingly power personal assistants, users expect them to reason over multimodal life histories, from recognizing people to understanding events to aggregating patterns, yet existing benchmarks primarily target concept-level recognition. We introduce Life-Bench, a fully synthetic, human-verified multimodal benchmark of over 11,800 question-answer pairs across 10 tasks, organized by required evidence scope: concept identification, event understanding, and aggregated reasoning. The benchmark's photo-centric personal histories are distributionally aligned with real user accounts under embedding statistic. The interconnected structure of personal data invites graph-based solutions; we propose LifeGraph, a personal knowledge graph framework providing structured retrieval with on-demand access to source visual evidence, showing particular promise on event and aggregated tasks. Systematic evaluation of four retrieval paradigms on Life-Bench demonstrates that accuracy degrades sharply with evidence scope, falling below 0.40 on aggregated tasks, and that no single paradigm dominates across categories. Performance beyond concept recognition remains modest for all evaluated methods, establishing personalization over multimodal histories as an open challenge and Life-Bench as a testbed for future progress.
title: Life-Bench: A Benchmark and Knowledge Graph Framework for Multimodal Personalization Beyond Concept Recognition
title_translated: Life-Bench：超越概念识别的多模态个性化基准与知识图谱框架
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地驱动个人助手，用户期望它们能基于多模态生活史进行推理，从识别人物到理解事件再到聚合模式，但现有基准主要聚焦于概念级识别。我们提出Life-Bench，一个完全合成且经人类验证的多模态基准，包含超过11,800个跨10个任务的问答对，按所需证据范围组织：概念识别、事件理解与聚合推理。该基准的以照片为中心的个人历史在嵌入统计分布上与真实用户账户对齐。个人数据的互联结构启发了基于图的解决方案；我们提出LifeGraph，一种个人知识图谱框架，提供结构化检索并按需访问源视觉证据，在事件与聚合任务上表现出显著潜力。对四种检索范式的系统评估显示，准确率随证据范围扩大急剧下降，在聚合任务上低于0.40，且无单一范式在所有类别中占优。所有方法在概念识别之外的表现仍较有限，确立了基于多模态生活史的个性化为开放挑战，Life-Bench则成为未来进展的测试平台。
